=== FILE: app\Console\Commands\PindahkanSqliteKeMysql.php ===
<?php

namespace App\Console\Commands;

use Illuminate\Console\Command;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;

class PindahkanSqliteKeMysql extends Command
{
    protected $signature = 'db:pindahkan-sqlite';
    protected $description = 'Salin semua data dari SQLite lama ke database MySQL';

    /**
     * Urutan penting: tabel induk dulu, baru tabel anak (foreign key).
     */
    private array $tabel = [
        'users',
        'sekolahs',
        'instrumens',
        'wawancaras',
        'tindak_lanjuts',
        'bcks_pengisians',
        'bcks_jawaban',
        'bk_questions',
        'bk_submissions',
        'bk_answers',
        'bk_essay_answers',
        'tendiks',
        'gembira_pengisians',
        'pkgsd_mbi_pengisians',
        'sessions',
        'cache',
        'cache_locks',
        'jobs',
        'job_batches',
        'failed_jobs',
        'password_reset_tokens',
    ];

    public function handle(): int
    {
        $sumber = DB::connection('sqlite_lama');
        $tujuan = DB::connection('mysql');

        Schema::connection('mysql')->disableForeignKeyConstraints();

        foreach ($this->tabel as $nama) {
            if (! Schema::connection('sqlite_lama')->hasTable($nama)) {
                $this->warn("Lewati {$nama} (tidak ada di SQLite)");
                continue;
            }

            if (! Schema::connection('mysql')->hasTable($nama)) {
                $this->warn("Lewati {$nama} (tidak ada di MySQL)");
                continue;
            }

            // Hanya salin kolom yang ada di kedua database.
            $kolomMysql = Schema::connection('mysql')->getColumnListing($nama);

            $tujuan->table($nama)->truncate();

            $jumlah = 0;

            $sumber->table($nama)->orderBy(
                Schema::connection('sqlite_lama')->hasColumn($nama, 'id') ? 'id' : DB::raw('1')
            )->chunk(200, function ($baris) use ($tujuan, $nama, $kolomMysql, &$jumlah) {
                $data = $baris->map(function ($row) use ($kolomMysql) {
                    return collect((array) $row)
                        ->only($kolomMysql)
                        ->all();
                })->all();

                $tujuan->table($nama)->insert($data);
                $jumlah += count($data);
            });

            $this->info("{$nama}: {$jumlah} baris disalin");
        }

        Schema::connection('mysql')->enableForeignKeyConstraints();

        $this->newLine();
        $this->info('Selesai memindahkan data.');

        return self::SUCCESS;
    }
}

=== FILE: app\Http\Controllers\BcksPengisianController.php ===
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\BcksPengisian;
use App\Models\BcksJawaban;
use App\Models\BcksJawabanLama;
use App\Support\BcksInstrumen;
use App\Support\SekolahResolver;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

class BcksPengisianController extends Controller
{
    private const STATUS_BCKS = 'BCKS';

    private const STATUS_RESPONDEN = [
        'BCKS',
        'Atasan Langsung / Pengawas Sekolah',
        'Perwakilan Guru / Tenaga Kependidikan',
    ];

    public function index()
    {
        // Gunakan eager loading
        $pengisians = BcksPengisian::with('jawaban')
            ->latest('tanggal_evaluasi')
            ->latest('id')
            ->get();

        return view('bcks.index', compact('pengisians'));
    }

    public function create()
    {
        return view('bcks.create');
    }

    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $this->validatePengisian($request);

        $skor = $this->filterSkorBerdasarkanStatus(
            $validated['skor'],
            $validated['status_responden']
        );

        $indikator = $this->prepareIndikator($skor);
        [$totalSkor, $nilaiAkhir, $predikat] =
            $this->hitungHasil($indikator);

        $pengisian = DB::transaction(function () use (
            $request,
            $validated,
            $indikator,
            $totalSkor,
            $nilaiAkhir,
            $predikat
        ) {
            $pengisian = BcksPengisian::create([
                'sekolah_id' => SekolahResolver::resolve(
                    $validated['unit_kerja_responden'] ?? null
                )?->id,
                'nama_bcks' => $validated['nama_bcks'],
                'unit_kerja' => $validated['unit_kerja'] ?? null,
                'angkatan_pelatihan' => $validated['angkatan_pelatihan'] ?? null,
                'nama_responden' => $validated['nama_responden'],
                'unit_kerja_responden' => $validated['unit_kerja_responden'] ?? null,
                'status_responden' => $validated['status_responden'],
                'nama_petugas_monev' => $validated['nama_petugas_monev'],
                'unit_kerja_petugas' => $validated['unit_kerja_petugas'] ?? null,
                'tanggal_evaluasi' => $validated['tanggal_evaluasi'],
                'total_skor' => $totalSkor,
                'nilai_akhir' => $nilaiAkhir,
                'predikat' => $predikat,
                'status_pengisian' => 'Selesai',
            ]);

            foreach ($indikator as $item) {
                $pengisian->jawabanBaru()->create($item);
            }

            return $pengisian;
        });

        return redirect()
            ->route('bcks.show', $pengisian)
            ->with('success', 'Pengisian instrumen BCKS berhasil disimpan.');
    }

    public function show(BcksPengisian $bcksPengisian)
    {
        // 1. Ambil data mentah secara langsung tanpa melalui relasi
        $jawabanBaru = BcksJawaban::where('bcks_pengisian_id', $bcksPengisian->id)->get();
        $jawabanLama = BcksJawabanLama::where('bcks_pengisian_id', $bcksPengisian->id)->get();

        // 2. Tentukan jawaban mana yang dipakai (prioritaskan data baru)
        $jawabanAktif = $jawabanBaru->isNotEmpty() ? $jawabanBaru : $jawabanLama;

        // 3. Set relasi manual agar View bisa membacanya
        $bcksPengisian->setRelation('jawaban', $jawabanAktif);
        
        // 4. Hitung ulang skor (jika data dari arsip lama)
        $indikator = [];
        foreach ($jawabanAktif as $j) {
            $indikator[] = [
                'nomor_indikator' => $j->nomor_indikator,
                'level' => $j->level,
                'skor' => $j->skor
            ];
        }
        
        if (count($indikator) > 0) {
            [$totalSkor, $nilaiAkhir, $predikat] = $this->hitungHasil($indikator);
            $bcksPengisian->total_skor = $totalSkor;
            $bcksPengisian->nilai_akhir = $nilaiAkhir;
            $bcksPengisian->predikat = $predikat;
        }

        return view('bcks.show', compact('bcksPengisian'));
    }

    public function update(Request $request, BcksPengisian $bcksPengisian)
    {
        $validated = $this->validatePengisian($request);

        $skor = $this->filterSkorBerdasarkanStatus(
            $validated['skor'],
            $validated['status_responden']
        );

        $indikator = $this->prepareIndikator($skor);
        [$totalSkor, $nilaiAkhir, $predikat] =
            $this->hitungHasil($indikator);

        DB::transaction(function () use (
            $validated,
            $bcksPengisian,
            $indikator,
            $totalSkor,
            $nilaiAkhir,
            $predikat
        ) {
            $bcksPengisian->update([
                'sekolah_id' => SekolahResolver::resolve(
                    $validated['unit_kerja_responden'] ?? null
                )?->id,
                'nama_bcks' => $validated['nama_bcks'],
                'unit_kerja' => $validated['unit_kerja'] ?? null,
                'angkatan_pelatihan' => $validated['angkatan_pelatihan'] ?? null,
                'nama_responden' => $validated['nama_responden'],
                'unit_kerja_responden' => $validated['unit_kerja_responden'] ?? null,
                'status_responden' => $validated['status_responden'],
                'nama_petugas_monev' => $validated['nama_petugas_monev'],
                'unit_kerja_petugas' => $validated['unit_kerja_petugas'] ?? null,
                'tanggal_evaluasi' => $validated['tanggal_evaluasi'],
                'total_skor' => $totalSkor,
                'nilai_akhir' => $nilaiAkhir,
                'predikat' => $predikat,
                'status_pengisian' => 'Selesai',
            ]);

            // Hapus jawaban lama dari kedua tabel
            BcksJawaban::where('bcks_pengisian_id', $bcksPengisian->id)->delete();
            BcksJawabanLama::where('bcks_pengisian_id', $bcksPengisian->id)->delete();

            // Simpan jawaban baru
            foreach ($indikator as $item) {
                $bcksPengisian->jawabanBaru()->create($item);
            }
        });

        return redirect()
            ->route('bcks.show', $bcksPengisian)
            ->with('success', 'Data pengisian BCKS berhasil diperbarui.');
    }

    public function destroy(BcksPengisian $bcksPengisian)
    {
        $bcksPengisian->delete();

        return redirect()
            ->route('instrumen.index')
            ->with('success', 'Data pengisian BCKS berhasil dihapus.');
    }

    private function validatePengisian(Request $request): array
    {
        $status = $request->input('status_responden');

        $rules = [
            'nama_bcks' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'unit_kerja' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'angkatan_pelatihan' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'nama_responden' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'unit_kerja_responden' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'status_responden' => [
                'required',
                Rule::in(self::STATUS_RESPONDEN),
            ],
            'nama_petugas_monev' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'unit_kerja_petugas' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'tanggal_evaluasi' => ['required', 'date'],
            'skor' => ['required', 'array'],
        ];

        foreach (BcksInstrumen::jumlahPerLevelAngka() as $level => $jumlah) {
            for ($nomor = 1; $nomor <= $jumlah; $nomor++) {
                $key = "skor.{$level}_{$nomor}";

                $wajib = $status === self::STATUS_BCKS || $level >= 3;

                $rules[$key] = [
                    $wajib ? 'required' : 'nullable',
                    'integer',
                    'between:1,4',
                ];
            }
        }

        $validated = $request->validate($rules);

        $validated['skor'] = $this->filterSkorBerdasarkanStatus(
            $validated['skor'],
            $validated['status_responden']
        );

        return $validated;
    }

    private function filterSkorBerdasarkanStatus(
        array $skor,
        string $status
    ): array {
        if ($status === self::STATUS_BCKS) {
            return $skor;
        }

        return array_filter(
            $skor,
            fn ($nilai, $kode) => preg_match('/^[34]_\d+$/', (string) $kode),
            ARRAY_FILTER_USE_BOTH
        );
    }

    private function prepareIndikator(array $skor): array
    {
        $indikator = [];

        foreach ($skor as $kode => $nilai) {
            if (!preg_match('/^([1-4])_(\d+)$/', (string) $kode, $match)) {
                continue;
            }

            $level = (int) $match[1];
            $nomor = (int) $match[2];

            $nomorIndikator = BcksInstrumen::nomorGlobal($level, $nomor);
            $levelNama      = BcksInstrumen::namaLevel($level);

            if ($nomorIndikator === null || $levelNama === null) {
                continue;
            }

            $indikator[] = [
                'nomor_indikator' => $nomorIndikator,
                'level'           => $levelNama,
                'skor'            => (int) $nilai,
            ];
        }

        return $indikator;
    }

    private function hitungHasil(array $indikator): array
    {
        $totalSkor = collect($indikator)->sum('skor');
        $skorMaksimum = count($indikator) * 4;

        $nilaiAkhir = $skorMaksimum > 0
            ? round(($totalSkor / $skorMaksimum) * 100, 2)
            : 0;

        $predikat = $this->getPredikat($nilaiAkhir);

        return [$totalSkor, $nilaiAkhir, $predikat];
    }

    private function getPredikat(float $nilaiAkhir): string
    {
        return match (true) {
            $nilaiAkhir >= 85 => 'Sangat Baik',
            $nilaiAkhir >= 70 => 'Baik',
            $nilaiAkhir >= 55 => 'Cukup',
            default => 'Perlu Pembinaan',
        };
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\BKQuestion;
use App\Models\BKSubmission;
use App\Support\SekolahResolver;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

class BKController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Jabatan yang diizinkan.
     */
    private const JABATAN_BK = [
        'BK',
        'Kepala Sekolah',
        'Rekan Sejawat',
        'Peserta Didik',
    ];

    /**
     * Mengambil pertanyaan aktif sesuai jabatan.
     * BK mendapat Level 1-4.
     * Jabatan lainnya mendapat Level 3-4.
     */
    private function getQuestionsForJabatan(string $jabatan)
    {
        $query = BKQuestion::where('aktif', true);

        if ($jabatan !== 'BK') {
            $query->whereIn('level', [3, 4]);
        }

        return $query->orderBy('urutan')->get();
    }

    /**
     * Memastikan jawaban hanya berisi ID pertanyaan yang berlaku.
     */
    private function validateApplicableAnswers(
        Request $request,
        array $validated,
        $questions
    ): array {
        $answers = $validated['jawaban'] ?? [];
        $allowedIds = $questions->pluck('id')
            ->map(fn($id) => (string) $id)
            ->all();

        foreach (array_keys($answers) as $id) {
            if (!in_array((string) $id, $allowedIds, true)) {
                abort(
                    422,
                    'Terdapat jawaban untuk indikator yang tidak berlaku bagi jabatan responden.'
                );
            }
        }

        foreach ($questions as $question) {
            if (!array_key_exists($question->id, $answers)) {
                return back()
                    ->withErrors([
                        'jawaban' =>
                            "Pernyataan nomor {$question->nomor} belum dijawab.",
                    ])
                    ->withInput()
                    ->throwResponse();
            }
        }

        return $answers;
    }

    /**
     * Validasi data utama pengisian.
     */
    private function validationRules(): array
    {
        return [
            'nama_petugas_monev' => [
                'required',
                'string',
                'max:255',
            ],
            'instansi_petugas' => [
                'nullable',
                'string',
                'max:255',
            ],
            'lokasi_monev' => [
                'nullable',
                'string',
                'max:255',
            ],
            'tanggal_pelaksanaan' => [
                'nullable',
                'date',
            ],
            'nama_responden' => [
                'required',
                'string',
                'max:255',
            ],
            'jabatan_responden' => [
                'required',
                Rule::in(self::JABATAN_BK),
            ],
            'jabatan_lainnya' => [
                'nullable',
                'string',
                'max:255',
            ],
            'satuan_pendidikan' => [
                'required',
                'string',
                'max:255',
            ],
            'masa_kerja' => [
                'required',
                'integer',
                'min:0',
                'max:100',
            ],
            'nama_pelatihan' => [
                'required',
                'string',
                'max:255',
            ],
            'tanggal_pengisian' => [
                'required',
                'date',
            ],
            'jawaban' => [
                'required',
                'array',
                'min:1',
            ],
            // (5a) Skala baru 1-4 â€” menggantikan Ya/Tidak (0/1)
            'jawaban.*' => [
                'required',
                Rule::in(['1', '2', '3', '4', 1, 2, 3, 4]),
            ],
            'essay' => [
                'nullable',
                'array',
            ],
            'essay.*.pertanyaan' => [
                'nullable',
                'string',
            ],
            'essay.*.jawaban' => [
                'nullable',
                'string',
            ],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Menghitung skor dari pertanyaan yang berlaku saja.
     * (5b) Skala 1â€“4 dengan total_skor / skor_maksimal.
     */
    private function calculateScore($questions, array $answers): array
    {
        $jumlahSoal = $questions->count();
        $totalSkor = 0;

        foreach ($questions as $question) {
            $totalSkor += (int) $answers[$question->id];
        }

        $skorMaksimal = $jumlahSoal * 4;

        $persen = $skorMaksimal > 0
            ? round(($totalSkor / $skorMaksimal) * 100, 2)
            : 0;

        return [
            'jumlah_soal' => $jumlahSoal,
            'total_skor' => $totalSkor,
            'skor_maksimal' => $skorMaksimal,
            'skor_persentase' => $persen,
            'kategori' => \App\Support\BkSkor::kategori($persen),
            'jumlah_ya' => 0,      // membersihkan sisa data lama saat diedit
            'jumlah_tidak' => 0,
            'status' => 'Selesai',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Simpan jawaban indikator yang berlaku.
     * (5c) Menyimpan skor 1â€“4 dan mengosongkan jawaban boolean lama.
     */
    private function saveAnswers(
        BKSubmission $submission,
        $questions,
        array $answers,
        bool $update = false
    ): void {
        $allowedIds = $questions->pluck('id')->all();

        foreach ($questions as $question) {
            $data = [
                'skor' => (int) $answers[$question->id],
                'jawaban' => null,
            ];

            if ($update) {
                $submission->answers()->updateOrCreate(
                    ['bk_question_id' => $question->id],
                    $data
                );
            } else {
                $submission->answers()->create([
                    'bk_question_id' => $question->id,
                    ...$data,
                ]);
            }
        }

        // Hapus jawaban lama yang tidak lagi berlaku.
        $submission->answers()
            ->whereNotIn('bk_question_id', $allowedIds)
            ->delete();
    }

    /**
     * Simpan jawaban uraian yang dikirimkan.
     */
    private function saveEssays(
        BKSubmission $submission,
        ?array $essays
    ): void {
        $submission->essayAnswers()->delete();

        foreach ($essays ?? [] as $nomor => $essay) {
            if (
                empty($essay['pertanyaan']) &&
                empty($essay['jawaban'])
            ) {
                continue;
            }

            $submission->essayAnswers()->create([
                'nomor' => (int) $nomor,
                'pertanyaan' => $essay['pertanyaan'] ?? '',
                'jawaban' => $essay['jawaban'] ?? null,
            ]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Riwayat pengisian BK.
     */
    public function index()
    {
        $submissions = BKSubmission::latest()->paginate(10);

        return view('bk.index', compact('submissions'));
    }

    /**
     * Form pengisian BK.
     */
    public function create()
    {
        $questions = BKQuestion::where('aktif', true)
            ->orderBy('urutan')
            ->get();

        return view('bk.create', compact('questions'));
    }

    /**
     * Simpan pengisian baru.
     */
    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate($this->validationRules());

        $questions = $this->getQuestionsForJabatan(
            $validated['jabatan_responden']
        );

        $answers = $validated['jawaban'];

        $allowedIds = $questions->pluck('id')
            ->map(fn($id) => (string) $id)
            ->all();

        foreach (array_keys($answers) as $id) {
            if (!in_array((string) $id, $allowedIds, true)) {
                return back()
                    ->withErrors([
                        'jawaban' =>
                            'Terdapat jawaban pada level yang tidak berlaku bagi jabatan ini.',
                    ])
                    ->withInput();
            }
        }

        foreach ($questions as $question) {
            if (!array_key_exists($question->id, $answers)) {
                return back()
                    ->withErrors([
                        'jawaban' =>
                            "Pernyataan nomor {$question->nomor} belum dijawab.",
                    ])
                    ->withInput();
            }
        }

        $submission = DB::transaction(function () use ($validated, $questions, $answers) {
            $score = $this->calculateScore($questions, $answers);

            $submission = BKSubmission::create([
                'sekolah_id' => SekolahResolver::resolve(
                    $validated['satuan_pendidikan'] ?? null
                )?->id,

                'nama_petugas_monev' => $validated['nama_petugas_monev'],
                'instansi_petugas' => $validated['instansi_petugas'] ?? null,
                'lokasi_monev' => $validated['lokasi_monev'] ?? null,
                'tanggal_pelaksanaan' => $validated['tanggal_pelaksanaan'] ?? null,

                'nama_responden' => $validated['nama_responden'],
                'jabatan_responden' => $validated['jabatan_responden'],
                'jabatan_lainnya' => null,

                'satuan_pendidikan' => $validated['satuan_pendidikan'],
                'masa_kerja' => $validated['masa_kerja'],
                'nama_pelatihan' => $validated['nama_pelatihan'],
                'tanggal_pengisian' => $validated['tanggal_pengisian'],

                ...$score,
            ]);

            $this->saveAnswers(
                $submission,
                $questions,
                $answers
            );

            $this->saveEssays(
                $submission,
                $validated['essay'] ?? null
            );

            return $submission;
        });

        return redirect()
            ->route('bk.show', $submission)
            ->with(
                'success',
                'Pengisian instrumen BK berhasil disimpan.'
            );
    }

    /**
     * Form edit.

    public function edit(BKSubmission $submission)

            'bk.edit',

                'submission',
                'questions',
                'answers',
                'essayAnswers'
            )
        );
    }

    /**
     * Update pengisian.
     */
    public function update(
        Request $request,
        BKSubmission $submission
    ) {
        $validated = $request->validate($this->validationRules());

        $questions = $this->getQuestionsForJabatan(
            $validated['jabatan_responden']
        );

        $answers = $validated['jawaban'];

        $allowedIds = $questions->pluck('id')
            ->map(fn($id) => (string) $id)
            ->all();

        foreach (array_keys($answers) as $id) {
            if (!in_array((string) $id, $allowedIds, true)) {
                return back()
                    ->withErrors([
                        'jawaban' =>
                            'Terdapat jawaban pada level yang tidak berlaku bagi jabatan ini.',
                    ])
                    ->withInput();
            }
        }

        foreach ($questions as $question) {
            if (!array_key_exists($question->id, $answers)) {
                return back()
                    ->withErrors([
                        'jawaban' =>
                            "Pernyataan nomor {$question->nomor} belum dijawab.",
                    ])
                    ->withInput();
            }
        }

        DB::transaction(function () use ($validated, $questions, $answers, $submission) {
            $score = $this->calculateScore($questions, $answers);

            $submission->update([
                'sekolah_id' => SekolahResolver::resolve(
                    $validated['satuan_pendidikan'] ?? null
                )?->id,

                'nama_petugas_monev' => $validated['nama_petugas_monev'],
                'instansi_petugas' => $validated['instansi_petugas'] ?? null,
                'lokasi_monev' => $validated['lokasi_monev'] ?? null,
                'tanggal_pelaksanaan' => $validated['tanggal_pelaksanaan'] ?? null,

                'nama_responden' => $validated['nama_responden'],
                'jabatan_responden' => $validated['jabatan_responden'],
                'jabatan_lainnya' => null,

                'satuan_pendidikan' => $validated['satuan_pendidikan'],
                'masa_kerja' => $validated['masa_kerja'],
                'nama_pelatihan' => $validated['nama_pelatihan'],
                'tanggal_pengisian' => $validated['tanggal_pengisian'],

                ...$score,
            ]);

            $this->saveAnswers(
                $submission,
                $questions,
                $answers,
                true
            );

            $this->saveEssays(
                $submission,
                $validated['essay'] ?? null
            );
        });

        return redirect()
            ->route('bk.show', $submission)
            ->with(
                'success',
                'Data pengisian BK berhasil diperbarui.'
            );
    }

    /**
     * Hapus data BK.
     */
    public function destroy(BKSubmission $submission)
    {
        $submission->delete();

        return redirect()
            ->route('instrumen.index')
            ->with('success', 'Data BK berhasil dihapus.');
    }

    /**
     * Hasil penilaian.
     */
    public function show(BKSubmission $submission)
    {
        $submission->load([
            'answers.question',
            'essayAnswers',
        ]);

        $answers = $submission->answers
            ->sortBy(
                fn($answer) =>
                    $answer->question?->urutan ?? 999999
            )
            ->values();

        $submission->setRelation('answers', $answers);

        $essayAnswers = $submission->essayAnswers
            ->sortBy('nomor')
            ->values();

        $submission->setRelation('essayAnswers', $essayAnswers);

        return view('bk.show', compact('submission'));
    }

    /**
     * Cetak hasil penilaian.
     */
    public function cetak(BKSubmission $submission)
    {
        $submission->load([
            'answers.question',
            'essayAnswers',
        ]);

        $answers = $submission->answers
            ->sortBy(
                fn($answer) =>
                    $answer->question?->urutan ?? 999999
            )
            ->values();

        $submission->setRelation('answers', $answers);

        $essayAnswers = $submission->essayAnswers
            ->sortBy('nomor')
            ->values();

        $submission->setRelation('essayAnswers', $essayAnswers);

        return view('bk.cetak', compact('submission'));
    }
}

=== FILE: app\Http\Controllers\CetakGabunganController.php ===
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\BcksPengisian;
use App\Models\BKSubmission;
use App\Models\GembiraPengisian;
use App\Models\PkgsdMbiPengisian;
use App\Models\Tendik;
use App\Models\Wawancara;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;

class CetakGabunganController extends Controller
{
    private const JENIS_WAWANCARA = ['BCKS', 'BK', 'TENDIK', 'GEMBIRA', 'PKGSD MBI'];

    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $instrumen = collect();

        foreach (BcksPengisian::latest('tanggal_evaluasi')->get() as $m) {
            $instrumen->push($this->item(
                'bcks-' . $m->id, 'BCKS',
                $m->nama_responden, $m->unit_kerja_responden, $m->tanggal_evaluasi
            ));
        }

        foreach (BKSubmission::latest('id')->get() as $m) {
            $instrumen->push($this->item(
                'bk-' . $m->id, 'BK',
                $m->nama_responden, $m->satuan_pendidikan,
                $m->tanggal_pelaksanaan ?? $m->tanggal_pengisian
            ));
        }

        foreach (Tendik::latest('tanggal_pengisian')->get() as $m) {
            $instrumen->push($this->item(
                'tendik-' . $m->id, 'TENDIK',
                $m->nama_responden, $m->satuan_pendidikan, $m->tanggal_pengisian
            ));
        }

        foreach (GembiraPengisian::latest('tanggal_monev')->get() as $m) {
            $instrumen->push($this->item(
                'gembira-' . $m->id, 'GEMBIRA',
                $m->nama_guru, $m->nama_sekolah, $m->tanggal_monev
            ));
        }

        foreach (PkgsdMbiPengisian::latest('tanggal_monev')->get() as $m) {
            $instrumen->push($this->item(
                'pkgsd-' . $m->id, 'PKGSD MBI',
                $m->nama_guru, $m->nama_sekolah, $m->tanggal_monev
            ));
        }

        $wawancara = Wawancara::whereIn('jenis_wawancara', self::JENIS_WAWANCARA)
            ->latest('tanggal_wawancara')
            ->get()
            ->map(fn ($m) => $this->item(
                'wwc-' . $m->id,
                strtoupper(trim($m->jenis_wawancara)),
                $m->nama_responden ?: $m->nama_narasumber,
                $m->unit_kerja_responden,
                $m->tanggal_evaluasi ?: $m->tanggal_wawancara
            ));

        $dipilih = array_map('strval', (array) $request->query('pilih', []));

        return view('cetak-gabungan.index', [
            'instrumen' => $instrumen,
            'wawancara' => $wawancara,
            'dipilih'   => $dipilih,
        ]);
    }

    public function cetak(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'pilih'   => ['required', 'array', 'min:1'],
            'pilih.*' => ['string', 'regex:/^(bcks|bk|tendik|gembira|pkgsd|wwc)-\d+$/'],
        ], [
            'pilih.required' => 'Pilih minimal satu data untuk digabungkan.',
        ]);

        $htmls = [];

        foreach ($request->input('pilih') as $key) {
            [$tipe, $id] = explode('-', $key, 2);
            $html = $this->render($tipe, (int) $id);

            if ($html) {
                $htmls[] = $html;
            }
        }

        return view('cetak-gabungan.hasil', ['htmls' => $htmls]);
    }

    private function render(string $tipe, int $id): ?string
    {
        return match ($tipe) {
            'bcks' => view('bcks.cetak', [
                'bcksPengisian' => BcksPengisian::with('jawaban')->findOrFail($id),
            ])->render(),

            'bk' => view('bk.cetak', [
                'submission' => BKSubmission::with(['answers.question', 'essayAnswers'])->findOrFail($id),
            ])->render(),

            'tendik' => view('tendik.cetak', [
                'tendik' => Tendik::findOrFail($id),
            ])->render(),

            'gembira' => view('gembira.cetak', [
                'gembira' => GembiraPengisian::findOrFail($id),
            ])->render(),

            'pkgsd' => view('pkgsd-mbi.cetak', [
                'pkgsdMbi' => PkgsdMbiPengisian::findOrFail($id),
            ])->render(),

            'wwc' => $this->renderWawancara(Wawancara::findOrFail($id)),

            default => null,
        };
    }

    private function renderWawancara(Wawancara $wawancara): ?string
    {
        $jenis = strtoupper(trim($wawancara->jenis_wawancara ?? ''));

        $metadata = json_decode($wawancara->hasil_wawancara ?? '{}', true);
        $metadata = is_array($metadata) ? $metadata : [];

        return match ($jenis) {
            'BCKS'      => view('wawancara.cetak-bcks', compact('wawancara'))->render(),
            'BK'        => view('wawancara.cetak-bk', compact('wawancara'))->render(),
            'TENDIK'    => view('wawancara.cetak-tendik', compact('wawancara', 'metadata'))->render(),
            'GEMBIRA'   => view('wawancara.cetak-gembira', compact('wawancara', 'metadata'))->render(),
            'PKGSD MBI' => view('wawancara.cetak-pkgsd-mbi', compact('wawancara', 'metadata'))->render(),
            default     => null,
        };
    }

    private function item(string $key, string $jenis, ?string $nama, ?string $sekolah, $tanggal): array
    {
        return [
            'key'     => $key,
            'jenis'   => $jenis,
            'nama'    => $nama ?: '-',
            'sekolah' => $sekolah ?: '-',
            'tanggal' => $tanggal ? Carbon::parse($tanggal)->format('d/m/Y') : '-',
        ];
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\BcksPengisian;
use App\Models\BKSubmission;
use App\Models\GembiraPengisian;
use App\Models\PkgsdMbiPengisian;
use App\Models\Sekolah;
use App\Models\Tendik;
use App\Models\TindakLanjut;
use App\Models\Wawancara;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;

class DashboardController extends Controller
{
    /** Warna konsisten dengan halaman Instrumen & Wawancara. */
    private const JENIS = [
        'BCKS'      => ['solid' => '#2563eb', 'soft' => '#eff6ff', 'text' => '#1d4ed8'],
        'BK'        => ['solid' => '#8b5cf6', 'soft' => '#f5f3ff', 'text' => '#6d28d9'],
        'TENDIK'    => ['solid' => '#059669', 'soft' => '#ecfdf5', 'text' => '#047857'],
        'GEMBIRA'   => ['solid' => '#d97706', 'soft' => '#fffbeb', 'text' => '#b45309'],
        'PKGSD MBI' => ['solid' => '#0891b2', 'soft' => '#ecfeff', 'text' => '#0e7490'],
    ];

    public function index()
    {
        $sekarang = now('Asia/Makassar');

        /* =====================================================
         | 1. KUMPULKAN SEMUA AKTIVITAS (INSTRUMEN + WAWANCARA)
         ===================================================== */
        $aktivitas = collect();

        $tambah = function (
            string $tipe, string $jenis, int $id, ?string $nama, ?string $petugas,
            $tanggal, $dibuat, ?float $nilai, ?int $sekolahId, string $url
        ) use (&$aktivitas) {
            $aktivitas->push([
                'tipe'       => $tipe,
                'jenis'      => $jenis,
                'id'         => $id,
                'nama'       => $nama ?: '-',
                'petugas'    => trim((string) $petugas),
                'tanggal'    => $tanggal ?: $dibuat,
                'dibuat'     => $dibuat,
                'nilai'      => $nilai,
                'sekolah_id' => $sekolahId,
                'url'        => $url,
            ]);
        };

        foreach (BcksPengisian::all() as $m) {
            $tambah('Instrumen', 'BCKS', $m->id, $m->nama_responden, $m->nama_petugas_monev,
                $m->tanggal_evaluasi, $m->created_at,
                $m->nilai_akhir !== null ? (float) $m->nilai_akhir : null,
                $m->sekolah_id, route('bcks.show', $m->id));
        }

        foreach (BKSubmission::all() as $m) {
            $tambah('Instrumen', 'BK', $m->id, $m->nama_responden, $m->nama_petugas_monev,
                $m->tanggal_pelaksanaan ?? $m->tanggal_pengisian, $m->created_at,
                $m->skor_persentase !== null ? (float) $m->skor_persentase : null,
                $m->sekolah_id, route('bk.show', $m->id));
        }

        foreach (Tendik::all() as $m) {
            $tambah('Instrumen', 'TENDIK', $m->id, $m->nama_responden, $m->nama_petugas_monev,
                $m->tanggal_pengisian, $m->created_at,
                $m->skor_keseluruhan !== null ? round(((float) $m->skor_keseluruhan / 4) * 100, 1) : null,
                $m->sekolah_id, route('tendik.show', $m->id));
        }

        foreach (GembiraPengisian::all() as $m) {
            $tambah('Instrumen', 'GEMBIRA', $m->id, $m->nama_guru, $m->nama_petugas_monev,
                $m->tanggal_monev, $m->created_at,
                $this->persenDariJson($m, 'Peserta Matematika GEMBIRA'),
                $m->sekolah_id, route('gembira.show', $m->id));
        }

        foreach (PkgsdMbiPengisian::all() as $m) {
            $tambah('Instrumen', 'PKGSD MBI', $m->id, $m->nama_guru, $m->nama_petugas_monev,
                $m->tanggal_monev, $m->created_at,
                $this->persenDariJson($m, 'Peserta PKGSD MBI'),
                $m->sekolah_id, route('pkgsd-mbi.show', $m->id));
        }

        foreach (Wawancara::all() as $m) {
            $jenis = strtoupper(trim((string) $m->jenis_wawancara));
            $tambah('Wawancara', $jenis !== '' ? $jenis : 'LAINNYA', $m->id,
                $m->nama_responden ?: $m->nama_narasumber,
                $m->nama_petugas_monev ?: $m->nama_pewawancara,
                $m->tanggal_evaluasi ?? $m->tanggal_wawancara, $m->created_at,
                null, $m->sekolah_id, route('wawancara.show', $m->id));
        }

        $instrumen = $aktivitas->where('tipe', 'Instrumen');
        $wawancara = $aktivitas->where('tipe', 'Wawancara');

        /* =====================================================
         | 2. KPI
         ===================================================== */
        $awalBulanIni  = $sekarang->copy()->startOfMonth();
        $awalBulanLalu = $awalBulanIni->copy()->subMonth();

        $hitungBulan = function ($koleksi) use ($awalBulanIni, $awalBulanLalu) {
            $ini  = $koleksi->filter(fn ($a) => $a['tanggal'] && $a['tanggal']->gte($awalBulanIni))->count();
            $lalu = $koleksi->filter(fn ($a) => $a['tanggal']
                && $a['tanggal']->gte($awalBulanLalu) && $a['tanggal']->lt($awalBulanIni))->count();

            return ['ini' => $ini, 'lalu' => $lalu];
        };

        $bulanInstrumen = $hitungBulan($instrumen);
        $bulanWawancara = $hitungBulan($wawancara);

        // Sekolah
        $totalSekolah   = Sekolah::count();
        $sudahDimonitor = Sekolah::where('status_monitoring', 'Sudah Dimonitor')->count();
        $belumDimonitor = Sekolah::where('status_monitoring', 'Belum Dimonitor')->count();

        $idSekolahAktif   = $aktivitas->pluck('sekolah_id')->filter()->unique()->values();
        $sekolahTerjangkau = $idSekolahAktif->count();

        // Sekolah yang sudah punya data monev tetapi statusnya masih "Belum Dimonitor"
        $perluDiperbarui = $idSekolahAktif->isEmpty() ? 0 : Sekolah::whereIn('id', $idSekolahAktif)
            ->where('status_monitoring', 'Belum Dimonitor')->count();

        // Tindak lanjut
        $tlTotal   = TindakLanjut::count();
        $tlSelesai = TindakLanjut::where('status', 'Selesai')->count();
        $tlProses  = TindakLanjut::where('status', 'Dalam Proses')->count();
        $tlBelum   = TindakLanjut::where('status', 'Belum Dimulai')->count();

        $tlMendesak = TindakLanjut::with('sekolah:id,nama_sekolah')
            ->where('status', '!=', 'Selesai')
            ->orderByRaw('target_selesai IS NULL')
            ->orderBy('target_selesai')
            ->take(5)
            ->get();

        $tlTerlambat = TindakLanjut::where('status', '!=', 'Selesai')
            ->whereNotNull('target_selesai')
            ->whereDate('target_selesai', '<', $sekarang->toDateString())
            ->count();

        /* =====================================================
         | 3. DATA GRAFIK
         ===================================================== */
        $kodeJenis = array_keys(self::JENIS);

        $perJenisInstrumen = array_map(
            fn ($k) => $instrumen->where('jenis', $k)->count(), $kodeJenis
        );

        $perJenisWawancara = array_map(
            fn ($k) => $wawancara->where('jenis', $k)->count(), $kodeJenis
        );

        $capaian = array_map(function ($k) use ($instrumen) {
            $nilai = $instrumen->where('jenis', $k)->pluck('nilai')->filter(fn ($n) => $n !== null);

            return $nilai->isEmpty() ? null : round($nilai->avg(), 1);
        }, $kodeJenis);

        $semuaNilai     = $instrumen->pluck('nilai')->filter(fn ($n) => $n !== null);
        $rataCapaian    = $semuaNilai->isEmpty() ? null : round($semuaNilai->avg(), 1);

        // Tren 6 bulan terakhir
        $labelBulan = $trenInstrumen = $trenWawancara = [];
        for ($i = 5; $i >= 0; $i--) {
            $bulan = $sekarang->copy()->startOfMonth()->subMonths($i);
            $kunci = $bulan->format('Y-m');

            $labelBulan[]     = $bulan->locale('id')->translatedFormat('M Y');
            $trenInstrumen[]  = $instrumen->filter(fn ($a) => $a['tanggal'] && $a['tanggal']->format('Y-m') === $kunci)->count();
            $trenWawancara[]  = $wawancara->filter(fn ($a) => $a['tanggal'] && $a['tanggal']->format('Y-m') === $kunci)->count();
        }

        $chart = [
            'jenis'      => $kodeJenis,
            'warna'      => array_column(self::JENIS, 'solid'),
            'instrumen'  => $perJenisInstrumen,
            'wawancara'  => $perJenisWawancara,
            'capaian'    => $capaian,
            'bulan'      => $labelBulan,
            'trenInstrumen' => $trenInstrumen,
            'trenWawancara' => $trenWawancara,
            'tl'         => [$tlBelum, $tlProses, $tlSelesai],
            'sekolah'    => [$sudahDimonitor, $belumDimonitor],
        ];

        /* =====================================================
         | 4. AKTIVITAS TERBARU & PETUGAS TERAKTIF
         ===================================================== */
        $terbaru = $aktivitas
            ->sortByDesc(fn ($a) => optional($a['dibuat'])->timestamp ?? 0)
            ->take(8)
            ->values();

        $petugasTeraktif = $aktivitas
            ->filter(fn ($a) => $a['petugas'] !== '' && $a['petugas'] !== '-')
            ->groupBy(fn ($a) => mb_strtolower($a['petugas']))
            ->map(fn ($g) => ['nama' => $g->first()['petugas'], 'jumlah' => $g->count()])
            ->sortByDesc('jumlah')
            ->take(5)
            ->values();

        $jam   = $sekarang->hour;
        $salam = $jam < 11 ? 'Selamat pagi' : ($jam < 15 ? 'Selamat siang' : ($jam < 18 ? 'Selamat sore' : 'Selamat malam'));

        return view('dashboard.index', [
            'salam'            => $salam,
            'tanggalHariIni'   => $sekarang->locale('id')->translatedFormat('l, d F Y'),
            'jenisMeta'        => self::JENIS,

            'totalInstrumen'   => $instrumen->count(),
            'totalWawancara'   => $wawancara->count(),
            'bulanInstrumen'   => $bulanInstrumen,
            'bulanWawancara'   => $bulanWawancara,
            'rataCapaian'      => $rataCapaian,

            'totalSekolah'     => $totalSekolah,
            'sudahDimonitor'   => $sudahDimonitor,
            'belumDimonitor'   => $belumDimonitor,
            'sekolahTerjangkau'=> $sekolahTerjangkau,
            'perluDiperbarui'  => $perluDiperbarui,

            'tlTotal'          => $tlTotal,
            'tlSelesai'        => $tlSelesai,
            'tlTerlambat'      => $tlTerlambat,
            'tlMendesak'       => $tlMendesak,

            'chart'            => $chart,
            'terbaru'          => $terbaru,
            'petugasTeraktif'  => $petugasTeraktif,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Rata-rata skor (1â€“4) dari jawaban JSON, dinyatakan dalam persen.
     * Level yang dihitung mengikuti jabatan penilai; "TD" tidak dihitung.
     */
    private function persenDariJson($item, string $labelPeserta): ?float
    {
        $levelAktif = $item->jabatan_penilai === $labelPeserta ? [1, 2, 3, 4] : [3, 4];
        $total = 0;
        $jumlah = 0;

        foreach ($levelAktif as $level) {
            foreach ((array) ($item->{"level_{$level}_jawaban"} ?? []) as $jawaban) {
                $skor = is_array($jawaban) ? ($jawaban['skor'] ?? null) : $jawaban;

                if (is_numeric($skor) && (int) $skor >= 1 && (int) $skor <= 4) {
                    $total += (int) $skor;
                    $jumlah++;
                }
            }
        }

        return $jumlah > 0 ? round(($total / $jumlah / 4) * 100, 1) : null;
    }
}

=== FILE: app\Http\Controllers\GembiraController.php ===
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\GembiraPengisian;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class GembiraController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Daftar pengisian instrumen Matematika GEMBIRA.
     */
    public function index()
    {
        $pengisian = GembiraPengisian::latest()->paginate(10);

        return view('gembira.index', compact('pengisian'));
    }

    /**
     * Form pengisian baru.
     */
    public function create()
    {
        return view('gembira.create');
    }

    /**
     * Simpan biodata dan jawaban instrumen baru.
     */

    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $this->validasiPengisian($request);

        $jawabanLevel = $this->ambilJawabanLevel($request);

        $namaSekolah = preg_replace(
            '/\s+/',
            ' ',
            trim($validated['nama_sekolah'])
        );

        $sekolah = \App\Models\Sekolah::query()
            ->whereRaw('LOWER(TRIM(nama_sekolah)) = ?', [
                mb_strtolower($namaSekolah),
            ])
            ->first();

        if (!$sekolah) {
            $sekolah = \App\Models\Sekolah::create([
                'nama_sekolah' => $namaSekolah,
                'status_monitoring' => 'Belum Dimonitor',
                'tahun_monitoring' => now()->year,
            ]);
        }

        $validated['nama_sekolah'] = $namaSekolah;
        $validated['sekolah_id'] = $sekolah->id;

        $pengisian = GembiraPengisian::create(array_merge(
            $validated,
            $jawabanLevel,
            ['status' => 'Selesai']
        ));

        return redirect()
            ->route('gembira.show', $pengisian)
            ->with('success', 'Pengisian Matematika GEMBIRA berhasil disimpan dan dihubungkan ke Data Sekolah.');
    }


    /**
     * Tampilkan detail pengisian.
     */
    public function show(GembiraPengisian $gembira)
    {
        return view('gembira.show', compact('gembira'));
    }

    /**
     * Tampilkan form edit pengisian.
     */
    public function edit(GembiraPengisian $gembira)
    {
        return view('gembira.edit', compact('gembira'));
    }

    /**
     * Perbarui biodata dan jawaban instrumen.
     */

    public function update(Request $request, GembiraPengisian $gembira)
    {
        $validated = $this->validasiPengisian($request);

        $jawabanLevel = $this->ambilJawabanLevel($request);

        $namaSekolah = preg_replace(
            '/\s+/',
            ' ',
            trim($validated['nama_sekolah'])
        );

        $sekolah = \App\Models\Sekolah::query()
            ->whereRaw('LOWER(TRIM(nama_sekolah)) = ?', [
                mb_strtolower($namaSekolah),
            ])
            ->first();

        if (!$sekolah) {
            $sekolah = \App\Models\Sekolah::create([
                'nama_sekolah' => $namaSekolah,
                'status_monitoring' => 'Belum Dimonitor',
                'tahun_monitoring' => now()->year,
            ]);
        }

        $validated['nama_sekolah'] = $namaSekolah;
        $validated['sekolah_id'] = $sekolah->id;

        $gembira->update(array_merge(
            $validated,
            $jawabanLevel
        ));

        return redirect()
            ->route('gembira.show', $gembira)
            ->with('success', 'Pengisian Matematika GEMBIRA berhasil diperbarui dan dihubungkan ke Data Sekolah.');
    }


    /**
     * Validasi biodata, metadata observasi, dan struktur jawaban.
     */
    private function validasiPengisian(Request $request): array
    {
        return $request->validate([
            'nama_guru' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'nama_sekolah' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'kelas_fase' => 'nullable|string|max:100',
            'topik_materi' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'nama_petugas_monev' => 'required|string|max:255',

            'jabatan_penilai' => [
                'required',
                'in:Peserta Matematika GEMBIRA,Rekan sejawat,Atasan langsung/Kepala Sekolah',
            ],

            'tanggal_monev' => 'required|date',
            'sumber_data_bukti' => 'nullable|string',

            'tanggal_observasi' => 'nullable|date',
            'durasi_pembelajaran' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'jumlah_murid_hadir' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'observasi_ke' => 'nullable|integer|min:1',

            'level_1_jawaban' => 'nullable|array',
            'level_2_jawaban' => 'nullable|array',
            'level_3_jawaban' => 'nullable|array',
            'level_4_jawaban' => 'nullable|array',
        ]);
    }
    public function cetak(GembiraPengisian $gembira)
    {
        return view('gembira.cetak', compact('gembira'));
    }

    /**
     * Ambil jawaban level yang sesuai dengan jabatan penilai.
     */
    private function ambilJawabanLevel(Request $request): array
    {
        $jabatan = $request->input('jabatan_penilai');

        $levelAktif = $jabatan === 'Peserta Matematika GEMBIRA'
            ? [1, 2, 3, 4]
            : [3, 4];

        $hasil = [];

        foreach ([1, 2, 3, 4] as $level) {
            $kolom = "level_{$level}_jawaban";

            // Level yang tidak aktif tidak diubah saat pengisian diedit.
            if (!in_array($level, $levelAktif, true)) {
                continue;
            }

            $jawaban = $request->input($kolom, []);

            if (!is_array($jawaban)) {
                $jawaban = [];
            }

            foreach ($jawaban as $nomor => $item) {
                if (!is_array($item)) {
                    unset($jawaban[$nomor]);
                    continue;
                }

                $skor = $item['skor'] ?? null;

                // Skor yang diizinkan: 1, 2, 3, 4, atau TD khusus Level 3.
                if ($skor !== null && $skor !== '') {
                    $skorValid = ['1', '2', '3', '4'];

                    if ($level === 3) {
                        $skorValid[] = 'TD';
                    }

                    if (!in_array((string) $skor, $skorValid, true)) {
                        $jawaban[$nomor]['skor'] = null;
                    }
                }

                // Alasan TD hanya berlaku untuk Level 3.
                if ($level !== 3) {
                    unset($jawaban[$nomor]['alasan_td']);
                }
            }

            $hasil[$kolom] = $jawaban;
        }

        return $hasil;
    }

    /**
     * Hapus pengisian.
     */
    public function destroy(GembiraPengisian $gembira)
    {
        $gembira->delete();

        return redirect()
            ->route('instrumen.index')
            ->with('success', 'Pengisian Matematika GEMBIRA berhasil dihapus.');
    }
}

        $bk = BKSubmission::query()

        $tendik = Tendik::query()
            ->latest('tanggal_pengisian')

            ->get();

        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------

        | Kita samakan format datanya supaya bisa ditampilkan

        |
        */

        $riwayat = collect();


        /*
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        | MASUKKAN BCKS
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        */

        foreach ($bcks as $item) {

                'responden' => $item->nama_responden,

                'status_responden' => $item->status_responden,

                'nilai' => (float) $item->nilai_akhir,

                'skor' => $item->total_skor,

                'skor_maksimal' => \App\Support\BcksInstrumen::skorMaksimum($item->status_responden === 'BCKS'),

                'predikat' => $item->predikat,

                'status' => $item->status_pengisian,

                'show_route' => route(
                    'bcks.show',
                    [
                        'bcksPengisian' => $item->id
                    ]
                ),

                'edit_route' => route(
                    'bcks.edit',
                    [
                        'bcksPengisian' => $item->id
                    ]
                ),

                /*
                |----------------------------------------------------------------
                | 'bcks.destroy' dicek dulu dengan Route::has() supaya halaman
                | tidak error kalau route-nya belum didaftarkan di web.php.
                | Setelah route 'bcks.destroy' ditambahkan, link hapus akan
                | otomatis aktif tanpa perlu ubah apa pun di sini.
                |----------------------------------------------------------------
                */
                'delete_route' => Route::has('bcks.destroy')
                    ? route('bcks.destroy', ['bcksPengisian' => $item->id])
                    : null,

                'cetak_route' => route(
                    'bcks.cetak',
                    [
                        'bcksPengisian' => $item->id
                    ]
                ),
            ]);
        }
        /*
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        | MASUKKAN BK
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        */

        foreach ($bk as $item) {

            $riwayat->push([
                'id' => $item->id,

                'jenis' => 'BK',

                'instrumen' => 'Monitoring & Evaluasi BK',
                /*
                |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
                | Untuk BK tidak ada field nama_bcks.
                | Kita gunakan nama responden sebagai nama utama.
                |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
                */

                'nama' => $item->nama_responden,

                'unit_kerja' => $item->instansi_responden,

                'responden' => $item->nama_responden,

                'status_responden' => $item->jabatan_responden
                    ?? $item->jabatan_lainnya
                    ?? '-',

                'tanggal' => $item->tanggal_pelaksanaan,

                'nilai' => (float) $item->skor_persentase,

                // ---------------------------------------------------------
                // (11) Skor: gunakan total_skor / skor_maksimal (skala 1â€“4),
                // fallback ke jumlah_ya / jumlah_soal untuk data lama.
                // ---------------------------------------------------------
                'skor' => $item->total_skor ?? $item->jumlah_ya,

                'skor_maksimal' => $item->skor_maksimal ?? $item->jumlah_soal,

                'predikat' => $item->kategori,

                'status' => $item->status,

                'show_route' => route(
                    'bk.show',
                    [
                        'submission' => $item->id
                    ]
                ),
                /*
                |----------------------------------------------------------------
                | BK belum punya halaman edit saat ini. Tetap dicek dengan
                | Route::has() supaya begitu route 'bk.edit' dibuat, link
                | ini otomatis aktif tanpa perlu ubah controller lagi.
                |----------------------------------------------------------------
                */
                'edit_route' => Route::has('bk.edit')
                    ? route('bk.edit', ['submission' => $item->id])
                    : null,

                'delete_route' => Route::has('bk.destroy')
                    ? route('bk.destroy', ['submission' => $item->id])
                    : null,

                'cetak_route' => null,
            ]);
        }

        /*
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        | MASUKKAN TENDIK
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        */

        foreach ($tendik as $item) {
            $nomorJawaban = range(1, 43);
            $totalSkor = 0;
            $jumlahTerisi = 0;

            foreach ($nomorJawaban as $nomor) {
                $kolomJawaban = 'jawaban_' . $nomor;
                $nilaiJawaban = $item->{$kolomJawaban};

                if ($nilaiJawaban !== null && $nilaiJawaban !== '') {
                    $totalSkor += (int) $nilaiJawaban;
                    $jumlahTerisi++;
                }
            }

            $nilaiRataRata = $jumlahTerisi > 0
                ? $totalSkor / $jumlahTerisi
                : 0;

            $riwayat->push([
                'id' => $item->id,

                'jenis' => 'TENDIK',

                'instrumen' => 'Monitoring & Evaluasi TENDIK',

                'nama' => $item->nama_kegiatan
                    ?? $item->nama_pelatihan
                    ?? '-',

                'unit_kerja' => $item->satuan_pendidikan ?? '-',

                'responden' => $item->nama_responden ?? '-',

                'status_responden' => $item->jabatan_responden
                    ?? $item->jabatan_lainnya
                    ?? '-',

                'tanggal' => $item->tanggal_pengisian
                    ? \Illuminate\Support\Carbon::parse($item->tanggal_pengisian)
                    : null,

                'nilai' => $nilaiRataRata,

                'skor' => $totalSkor,

                'skor_maksimal' => 172,

                'predikat' => $item->predikat ?? '-',

                'status' => 'Selesai',

                'show_route' => route('tendik.show', [
                    'tendik' => $item->id,
                ]),

                'edit_route' => \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route::has('tendik.edit')
                    ? route('tendik.edit', ['tendik' => $item->id])
                    : null,

                'delete_route' => \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route::has('tendik.destroy')
                    ? route('tendik.destroy', ['tendik' => $item->id])
                    : null,

                'cetak_route' => null,
            ]);
        }
        $gembiraList = GembiraPengisian::query()
            ->latest('tanggal_monev')
            ->latest('id')
            ->get();

        foreach ($gembiraList as $item) {
            $levelAktif = $item->jabatan_penilai === 'Peserta Matematika GEMBIRA'
                ? [1, 2, 3, 4]
                : [3, 4];

            $jawabanPerLevel = [
                1 => $item->level_1_jawaban ?? [],
                2 => $item->level_2_jawaban ?? [],
                3 => $item->level_3_jawaban ?? [],
                4 => $item->level_4_jawaban ?? [],
            ];

            $totalSkor = 0;
            $jumlahDinilai = 0;

            foreach ($levelAktif as $level) {
                foreach ($jawabanPerLevel[$level] as $jawaban) {
                    $skor = is_array($jawaban)
                        ? ($jawaban['skor'] ?? $jawaban['jawaban'] ?? null)
                        : $jawaban;

                    if ($skor === 'TD' || $skor === 'td') {
                        continue;
                    }

                    if (is_numeric($skor) && (int) $skor >= 1 && (int) $skor <= 4) {
                        $totalSkor += (int) $skor;
                        $jumlahDinilai++;
                    }
                }
            }

            $rataRata = $jumlahDinilai > 0
                ? $totalSkor / $jumlahDinilai
                : 0;

            $predikat = match (true) {
                $jumlahDinilai === 0 => '-',
                $rataRata >= 3.50 => 'Sangat Baik',
                $rataRata >= 2.75 => 'Baik',
                $rataRata >= 2.00 => 'Cukup',
                default => 'Perlu pendampingan intensif',

            $riwayat->push([
                'id' => $item->id,
                'jenis' => 'GEMBIRA',
                'instrumen' => 'Matematika GEMBIRA',

                'tanggal' => $item->tanggal_monev
                    ? \Illuminate\Support\Carbon::parse($item->tanggal_monev)
                    : null,
                'nilai' => $rataRata,
                'skor' => $totalSkor,
                'skor_maksimal' => $jumlahDinilai * 4,
                'predikat' => $predikat,
                'status' => in_array($item->status, ['Final', 'Selesai'], true)
                    ? 'Selesai'
                    : ($item->status ?: 'Draft'),
                'show_route' => route('gembira.show', ['gembira' => $item->id]),
                'edit_route' => route('gembira.edit', ['gembira' => $item->id]),
                'delete_route' => route('gembira.destroy', [
                    'gembira' => $item->id,
                ]),
                'cetak_route' => route('gembira.cetak', ['gembira' => $item->id]),
            ]);
        }

        /*
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        | MASUKKAN PKGSD MBI
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        */

        $pkgsdMbiList = PkgsdMbiPengisian::query()
            ->latest('tanggal_monev')
            ->latest('id')
            ->get();

        foreach ($pkgsdMbiList as $item) {
            $levelAktif = $item->jabatan_penilai === 'Peserta PKGSD MBI'
                ? [1, 2, 3, 4]
                : [3, 4];

            $jawabanPerLevel = [
                1 => $item->level_1_jawaban ?? [],
                2 => $item->level_2_jawaban ?? [],
                3 => $item->level_3_jawaban ?? [],
                4 => $item->level_4_jawaban ?? [],
            ];

            $totalSkor = 0;
            $jumlahDinilai = 0;

            foreach ($levelAktif as $level) {
                foreach ($jawabanPerLevel[$level] as $jawaban) {
                    $skor = is_array($jawaban)
                        ? ($jawaban['skor'] ?? null)
                        : $jawaban;

                    // TD tidak dihitung sebagai skor numerik.
                    if (strtoupper((string) $skor) === 'TD') {
                        continue;
                    }

                    if (
                        is_numeric($skor)
                        && (int) $skor >= 1
                        && (int) $skor <= 4
                    ) {
                        $totalSkor += (int) $skor;
                        $jumlahDinilai++;
                    }
                }
            }

            $rataRata = $jumlahDinilai > 0
                ? $totalSkor / $jumlahDinilai
                : 0;

            $predikat = match (true) {
                $jumlahDinilai === 0 => '-',
                $rataRata >= 3.50 => 'Sangat Baik',
                $rataRata >= 2.75 => 'Baik',
                $rataRata >= 2.00 => 'Cukup',
                default => 'Perlu pendampingan intensif',

            $riwayat->push([

                    ? \Illuminate\Support\Carbon::parse($item->tanggal_monev)
                    : null,
                'nilai' => $rataRata,
                'skor' => $totalSkor,
                'skor_maksimal' => $jumlahDinilai * 4,
                'predikat' => $predikat,
                'status' => in_array($item->status, ['Final', 'Selesai'], true)
                    ? 'Selesai'
                    : ($item->status ?: 'Draft'),
                'show_route' => route('pkgsd-mbi.show', [
                    'pkgsdMbi' => $item->id,
                ]),
                'edit_route' => route('pkgsd-mbi.edit', [
                    'pkgsdMbi' => $item->id,
                ]),
                'delete_route' => route('pkgsd-mbi.destroy', [
                    'pkgsdMbi' => $item->id,
                ]),
                'cetak_route' => route('pkgsd-mbi.cetak', [

        /*
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------

        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        */
        if ($request->filled('jenis_instrumen')) {

            $jenis = $request->jenis_instrumen;

            $riwayat = $riwayat
                ->filter(

                )

        }
        /*
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        | FILTER STATUS
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        */
        if ($request->filled('status')) {

            $status = $request->status;

            $riwayat = $riwayat
                ->filter(function ($item) use ($status) {

                    if ($status === 'Draft') {

                        return $item['status'] === 'Draft';
                    }

                    if ($status === 'Dalam Proses') {

                        return $item['status'] === 'Draft';
                    }

                    if ($status === 'Final') {

                        return $item['status'] === 'Selesai';
                    }

                    return true;
                })
                ->values();
        }
        /*
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        | FILTER PENCARIAN
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        */

        if ($request->filled('search')) {

            $search = strtolower(
                trim($request->search)
            );

            $riwayat = $riwayat
                ->filter(function ($item) use ($search) {

                    return
                        str_contains(
                            strtolower(
                                $item['jenis'] ?? ''
                            ),
                            $search
                        )
                        ||
                        str_contains(
                            strtolower(
                                $item['nama'] ?? ''
                            ),
                            $search
                        )
                        ||
                        str_contains(
                            strtolower(
                                $item['responden'] ?? ''
                            ),
                            $search
                        )
                        ||
                        str_contains(
                            strtolower(
                                $item['unit_kerja'] ?? ''
                            ),
                            $search
                        )
                        ||
                        str_contains(
                            strtolower(
                                $item['status_responden'] ?? ''
                            ),
                            $search
                        );
                })
                ->values();

        /*
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        | URUTKAN RIWAYAT TERBARU
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        */

        $riwayat = $riwayat
            ->sortByDesc(function ($item) {

                if ($item['tanggal']) {

        /*

        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        |
        | Karena BCKS dan BK berasal dari dua tabel berbeda,
        | keduanya digabung dahulu kemudian dipagination.
        |
        */

        $perPage = 10;

        $currentPage = LengthAwarePaginator::resolveCurrentPage(
            'riwayat_page'
        );

        $currentItems = $riwayat
            ->slice(
                ($currentPage - 1) * $perPage,
                $perPage
            )
            ->values();

        $riwayatPengisian = new LengthAwarePaginator(
            $currentItems,
            $riwayat->count(),
            $perPage,
            $currentPage,
            [
                'path' => request()->url(),
                'pageName' => 'riwayat_page',
            ]
        );

        $riwayatPengisian->appends(
            $request->except('riwayat_page')
        );


        /*
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        | STATISTIK MASTER INSTRUMEN
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        */

        $totalInstrumen = Instrumen::count();

        $aktif = Instrumen::where(
            'status',
            'Aktif'
        )->count();

        $draft = Instrumen::where(
            'status',
            'Draft'
        )->count();

        $selesai = Instrumen::where(
            'status',
            'Selesai'
        )->count();


        /*
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        | KIRIM KE VIEW
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        */

        return view(
            'instrumen.index',
            compact(
                'instrumens',
                'riwayatPengisian',
                'totalInstrumen',
                'aktif',
                'draft',
                'selesai'
            )
        );
    }


    /**
     * =========================================================
     * TAMBAH INSTRUMEN
     * =========================================================
     */
    public function create()
    {
        return view('instrumen.create');
    }


    /**
     * =========================================================
     * SIMPAN INSTRUMEN
     * =========================================================
     */
    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([

            'kode_instrumen' =>
                'required|string|max:50|unique:instrumens,kode_instrumen',

            'nama_instrumen' =>
                'required|string|max:255',

            'jenis_instrumen' =>
                'required|in:Pemantauan,Evaluasi,Monitoring',

            'deskripsi' =>
                'nullable|string',

            'status' =>
                'required|in:Draft,Aktif,Selesai',

            'jumlah_pertanyaan' =>
                'required|integer|min:0',

            'capaian' =>
                'required|numeric|min:0|max:100',

            'tanggal_mulai' =>
                'nullable|date',

            'tanggal_selesai' =>
                'nullable|date|after_or_equal:tanggal_mulai',
        ]);


        Instrumen::create($validated);


        return redirect()
            ->route('instrumen.index')
            ->with(
                'success',
                'Instrumen berhasil ditambahkan.'
            );
    }


    /**
     * =========================================================
     * DETAIL INSTRUMEN
     * =========================================================
     */
    public function show(Instrumen $instrumen)
    {
        return view(
            'instrumen.show',
            compact('instrumen')
        );
    }


    /**
     * =========================================================
     * EDIT INSTRUMEN
     * =========================================================
     */
    public function edit(Instrumen $instrumen)
    {
        return view(
            'instrumen.edit',
            compact('instrumen')
        );
    }


    /**
     * =========================================================
     * UPDATE INSTRUMEN
     * =========================================================
     */
    public function update(
        Request $request,
        Instrumen $instrumen
    ) {

        $validated = $request->validate([

            'kode_instrumen' =>
                'required|string|max:50|unique:instrumens,kode_instrumen,' .
                $instrumen->id,

            'nama_instrumen' =>
                'required|string|max:255',

            'jenis_instrumen' =>
                'required|in:Pemantauan,Evaluasi,Monitoring',

            'deskripsi' =>
                'nullable|string',

            'status' =>
                'required|in:Draft,Aktif,Selesai',

            'jumlah_pertanyaan' =>
                'required|integer|min:0',

            'capaian' =>
                'required|numeric|min:0|max:100',

            'tanggal_mulai' =>
                'nullable|date',

            'tanggal_selesai' =>
                'nullable|date|after_or_equal:tanggal_mulai',
        ]);


        $instrumen->update($validated);


        return redirect()
            ->route('instrumen.index')
            ->with(
                'success',
                'Instrumen berhasil diperbarui.'
            );
    }


    /**
     * =========================================================
     * HAPUS INSTRUMEN
     * =========================================================
     */
    public function destroy(Instrumen $instrumen)
    {
        $instrumen->delete();


        return redirect()
            ->route('instrumen.index')
            ->with(
                'success',
                'Instrumen berhasil dihapus.'
            );
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rules\Password;

class ManajemenAkunController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Menampilkan daftar akun Petugas Monev.
     */
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $query = User::where('role', 'petugas_monev');

        if ($request->filled('search')) {
            $search = $request->search;

            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('name', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                    ->orWhere('username', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                    ->orWhere('nip', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            });
        }

        if ($request->status === 'aktif') {
            $query->where('is_active', true);
        } elseif ($request->status === 'nonaktif') {
            $query->where('is_active', false);
        }

        $akun = $query->orderBy('name')
            ->paginate(10)
            ->withQueryString();

        // Statistik selalu dihitung ulang dari database (tidak terpengaruh filter),
        // sehingga langsung berubah setelah akun diaktifkan / dinonaktifkan.
        $totalAkun = User::where('role', 'petugas_monev')->count();
        $akunAktif = User::where('role', 'petugas_monev')
            ->where('is_active', true)
            ->count();
        $akunNonaktif = User::where('role', 'petugas_monev')
            ->where('is_active', false)
            ->count();

        return view('manajemen-akun.index', compact(
            'akun',
            'totalAkun',
            'akunAktif',
            'akunNonaktif'
        ));
    }

    /**
     * Menampilkan formulir tambah akun.
     */
    public function create()
    {
        return view('manajemen-akun.create');
    }

    /**
     * Menyimpan akun Petugas Monev baru.
     */
    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'username' => [
                'required',
                'string',
                'max:100',
                'alpha_dash',
                'unique:users,username',
            ],
            'nip' => [
                'required',
                'string',
                'max:30',
                'unique:users,nip',
            ],
            'password' => [
                'required',
                'confirmed',
                Password::min(8),
            ],
        ], [
            'name.required' => 'Nama wajib diisi.',
            'username.required' => 'Username wajib diisi.',
            'username.unique' => 'Username sudah digunakan.',
            'username.alpha_dash' => 'Username hanya boleh berisi huruf, angka, tanda hubung, dan garis bawah.',
            'nip.required' => 'NIP wajib diisi.',
            'nip.unique' => 'NIP sudah terdaftar.',
            'password.required' => 'Password wajib diisi.',
            'password.confirmed' => 'Konfirmasi password tidak cocok.',
            'password.min' => 'Password minimal 8 karakter.',
        ]);

        User::create([
            'name' => $validated['name'],
            'username' => $validated['username'],
            'nip' => $validated['nip'],
            'email' => strtolower($validated['username'])
                . '@bgtk-monev.local',
            'password' => $validated['password'],
            'role' => 'petugas_monev',
            'is_active' => true,
        ]);

        return redirect()
            ->route('manajemen-akun.index')
            ->with('success', 'Akun Petugas Monev berhasil ditambahkan.');
    }

        abort_unless(

        abort_unless(
