    /**
     * Memperbarui data akun.
     */
    public function update(Request $request, User $manajemen_akun)
    {
        abort_unless(
            $manajemen_akun->role === 'petugas_monev',
            404
        );

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'username' => [
                'required',
                'string',
                'max:100',
                'alpha_dash',
                Rule::unique('users', 'username')->ignore($manajemen_akun->id),
            ],
            'nip' => [
                'required',
                'string',
                'max:30',
                Rule::unique('users', 'nip')->ignore($manajemen_akun->id),
            ],
            'password' => [
                'nullable',
                'confirmed',
                Password::min(8),
            ],
        ], [
            'name.required' => 'Nama wajib diisi.',
            'username.required' => 'Username wajib diisi.',
            'username.unique' => 'Username sudah digunakan.',
            'username.alpha_dash' => 'Format username tidak valid.',
            'nip.required' => 'NIP wajib diisi.',
            'nip.unique' => 'NIP sudah terdaftar.',
            'password.confirmed' => 'Konfirmasi password tidak cocok.',
            'password.min' => 'Password minimal 8 karakter.',
        ]);

        $manajemen_akun->name = $validated['name'];
        $manajemen_akun->username = $validated['username'];
        $manajemen_akun->nip = $validated['nip'];
        $manajemen_akun->email = strtolower($validated['username'])
            . '@bgtk-monev.local';

        // Password hanya diubah jika kolom diisi.
        if (!empty($validated['password'])) {
            $manajemen_akun->password = $validated['password'];
        }

        $manajemen_akun->save();

        return redirect()
            ->route('manajemen-akun.index')
            ->with('success', 'Data akun berhasil diperbarui.');
    }

    /**
     * Mengaktifkan atau menonaktifkan akun (toggle status).
     */
    public function destroy(User $manajemen_akun)
    {
        abort_unless(
            $manajemen_akun->role === 'petugas_monev',
            404
        );

        // Cegah pengguna menonaktifkan akunnya sendiri.
        if ($manajemen_akun->id === auth()->id()) {
            return redirect()
                ->route('manajemen-akun.index')
                ->with('error', 'Anda tidak dapat menonaktifkan akun yang sedang digunakan.');
        }

        $manajemen_akun->is_active = !$manajemen_akun->is_active;
        $manajemen_akun->save();

        $status = $manajemen_akun->is_active
            ? 'diaktifkan kembali'
            : 'dinonaktifkan';

        return redirect()
            ->route('manajemen-akun.index')
            ->with('success', "Akun {$manajemen_akun->name} berhasil {$status}.");
    }

    /**
     * Menghapus akun secara permanen.
     */
    public function hapus(User $manajemen_akun)
    {
        abort_unless(
            $manajemen_akun->role === 'petugas_monev',
            404
        );

        // Cegah admin menghapus akunnya sendiri.
        if ($manajemen_akun->id === auth()->id()) {
            return redirect()
                ->route('manajemen-akun.index')
                ->with('error', 'Anda tidak dapat menghapus akun yang sedang digunakan.');
        }

        $nama = $manajemen_akun->name;

        $manajemen_akun->delete();

        return redirect()
            ->route('manajemen-akun.index')
            ->with('success', "Akun {$nama} berhasil dihapus permanen.");
    }
}

=== FILE: app\Http\Controllers\PkgsdMbiController.php ===
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\PkgsdMbiPengisian;
use App\Models\Sekolah;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Validator;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class PkgsdMbiController extends Controller
{
    public function index()
    {
        $pengisian = PkgsdMbiPengisian::latest('tanggal_monev')
            ->latest('id')
            ->paginate(10);

        return view('pkgsd-mbi.index', compact('pengisian'));
    }

    public function create()
    {
        return view('pkgsd-mbi.create');
    }

    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $this->validasiPengisian($request->all());
        $jawaban = $this->ambilJawabanLevel($request);

        $namaSekolah = preg_replace(
            '/\s+/',
            ' ',
            trim($validated['nama_sekolah'])
        );

        $sekolah = $this->cariAtauBuatSekolah($namaSekolah);

        $validated['nama_sekolah'] = $namaSekolah;
        $validated['sekolah_id'] = $sekolah->id;

        $item = PkgsdMbiPengisian::create(array_merge(
            $validated,
            $jawaban,
            ['status' => 'Selesai']
        ));

        return redirect()
            ->route('pkgsd-mbi.show', $item)
            ->with('success', 'Pengisian PKGSD MBI berhasil disimpan.');
    }

    public function cetak(PkgsdMbiPengisian $pkgsdMbi)
    {
        return view('pkgsd-mbi.cetak', compact('pkgsdMbi'));
    }

    public function show(PkgsdMbiPengisian $pkgsdMbi)
    {
        return view('pkgsd-mbi.show', compact('pkgsdMbi'));
    }

    public function edit(PkgsdMbiPengisian $pkgsdMbi)
    {
        return view('pkgsd-mbi.edit', compact('pkgsdMbi'));
    }

    public function update(
        Request $request,
        PkgsdMbiPengisian $pkgsdMbi
    ) {
        $validated = $this->validasiPengisian($request->all());
        $jawaban = $this->ambilJawabanLevel($request);

        $namaSekolah = preg_replace(
            '/\s+/',
            ' ',
            trim($validated['nama_sekolah'])
        );

        $sekolah = $this->cariAtauBuatSekolah($namaSekolah);

        $validated['nama_sekolah'] = $namaSekolah;
        $validated['sekolah_id'] = $sekolah->id;

        $pkgsdMbi->update(array_merge(
            $validated,
            $jawaban
        ));

        return redirect()
            ->route('pkgsd-mbi.show', $pkgsdMbi)
            ->with('success', 'Pengisian PKGSD MBI berhasil diperbarui.');
    }

    public function destroy(PkgsdMbiPengisian $pkgsdMbi)

        $pkgsdMbi->delete();

        // PERBAIKAN: Ubah redirect ke 'instrumen.index' agar kembali ke daftar riwayat
        return redirect()
            ->route('instrumen.index')
            ->with('success', 'Pengisian PKGSD MBI berhasil dihapus.');
    }

    private function validasiPengisian(array $data): array
    {
        $rules = [
            'nama_guru' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'nama_sekolah' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'kelas_fase' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:100'],
            'topik_materi' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'nama_petugas_monev' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],

            'jabatan_penilai' => [
                'required',
                'in:Peserta PKGSD MBI,Rekan sejawat,Atasan langsung/Kepala Sekolah',
            ],

            'tanggal_monev' => ['required', 'date'],
            'sumber_data_bukti' => ['nullable', 'string'],
        ];

        $messages = [
            'required' => ':attribute wajib diisi.',
            'in' => 'Pilihan pada :attribute tidak valid.',
            'array' => 'Format jawaban :attribute tidak valid.',
            'size' => 'Jumlah indikator pada :attribute tidak lengkap.',
            'string' => ':attribute harus berupa teks.',
            'date' => ':attribute harus berupa tanggal yang valid.',
        ];

        $attributes = [
            'nama_guru' => 'Nama Guru',
            'nama_sekolah' => 'Nama Sekolah',
            'kelas_fase' => 'Kelas / Fase',
            'topik_materi' => 'Topik / Materi',
            'nama_petugas_monev' => 'Nama Petugas Monev',
            'jabatan_penilai' => 'Jabatan Penilai',
            'tanggal_monev' => 'Tanggal Monev',
            'sumber_data_bukti' => 'Sumber Data / Bukti',
        ];

        $jabatan = $data['jabatan_penilai'] ?? null;
        $peserta = $jabatan === 'Peserta PKGSD MBI';

        $levelAktif = $peserta
            ? [1 => 29, 2 => 10, 3 => 22, 4 => 12]
            : [3 => 22, 4 => 12];

        foreach ($levelAktif as $level => $jumlah) {
            $field = "level_{$level}_jawaban";

            $rules[$field] = [
                'required',
                'array',
                "size:{$jumlah}",
            ];

            for ($i = 1; $i <= $jumlah; $i++) {
                $skorField = "{$field}.{$i}.skor";

                $rules[$skorField] = $level === 3
                    ? ['required', 'in:1,2,3,4,TD']
                    : ['required', 'in:1,2,3,4'];

                $attributes[$skorField] =
                    "Skor Level {$level}, indikator {$i}";

                if (in_array($level, [3, 4], true)) {
                    $buktiField = "{$field}.{$i}.bukti";

                    $rules[$buktiField] = [
                        'nullable',
                        'string',
                        "required_if:{$skorField},3,4",
                    ];

                    $messages["{$buktiField}.required_if"] =
                        "Bukti indikator {$i} pada Level {$level} wajib diisi jika skor 3 atau 4.";

                    $attributes[$buktiField] =
                        "Bukti Level {$level}, indikator {$i}";
                }
            }
        }

        return Validator::make(
            $data,
            $rules,
            $messages,
            $attributes
        )->validate();
    }

    private function ambilJawabanLevel(Request $request): array
    {
        $peserta = $request->input('jabatan_penilai')
            === 'Peserta PKGSD MBI';

        $levelAktif = $peserta
            ? [1, 2, 3, 4]
            : [3, 4];

        $jumlahIndikator = [
            1 => 29,
            2 => 10,
            3 => 22,
            4 => 12,
        ];

        $hasil = [];
        $errors = [];

        foreach ($levelAktif as $level) {
            $field = "level_{$level}_jawaban";
            $jawaban = $request->input($field, []);

            if (!is_array($jawaban)) {
                $errors[$field] =
                    "Format jawaban Level {$level} tidak valid.";
                continue;
            }

            $skorDiizinkan = $level === 3
                ? ['1', '2', '3', '4', 'TD']
                : ['1', '2', '3', '4'];

            $jawabanBersih = [];

            for (
                $nomor = 1;
                $nomor <= $jumlahIndikator[$level];
                $nomor++
            ) {
                $item = $jawaban[$nomor] ?? [];

                if (!is_array($item)) {
                    $item = ['skor' => $item];
                }

                $skor = $item['skor'] ?? null;
                $bukti = trim((string) ($item['bukti'] ?? ''));
                $alasanTd = trim((string) ($item['alasan_td'] ?? ''));

                if ($skor === null || $skor === '') {
                    $errors["{$field}.{$nomor}.skor"] =
                        "Skor indikator {$nomor} Level {$level} wajib dipilih.";
                    continue;
                }

                $skor = strtoupper((string) $skor);

                if (!in_array($skor, $skorDiizinkan, true)) {
                    $errors["{$field}.{$nomor}.skor"] =
                        "Skor indikator {$nomor} Level {$level} tidak valid.";
                    continue;
                }

                if (
                    in_array($level, [3, 4], true)
                    && in_array($skor, ['3', '4'], true)
                    && $bukti === ''
                ) {
                    $errors["{$field}.{$nomor}.bukti"] =
                        "Bukti indikator {$nomor} Level {$level} wajib diisi untuk skor {$skor}.";
                }

                $jawabanBersih[$nomor] = [
                    'skor' => $skor,
                ];

                if (in_array($level, [3, 4], true)) {
                    $jawabanBersih[$nomor]['bukti'] = $bukti;
                }

                if ($level === 3 && $skor === 'TD') {
                    $jawabanBersih[$nomor]['alasan_td'] = $alasanTd;
                }
            }

            $hasil[$field] = $jawabanBersih;
        }

        if ($errors) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages($errors);
        }

        return $hasil;
    }

    private function cariAtauBuatSekolah(string $namaSekolah): Sekolah
    {
        $sekolah = Sekolah::query()
            ->whereRaw('LOWER(TRIM(nama_sekolah)) = ?', [
                mb_strtolower($namaSekolah),
            ])
            ->first();

        if (!$sekolah) {
            $sekolah = Sekolah::create([
                'nama_sekolah' => $namaSekolah,
                'status_monitoring' => 'Belum Dimonitor',
                'tahun_monitoring' => now()->year,
            ]);
        }

        return $sekolah;
    }
}

    {

                'bcksPengisians',

            $query->where(function ($q) use ($cari) {

                    ->orWhere('npsn', 'like', "%{$cari}%");

            'Belum Dimonitor'

            ->whereNotNull('kabupaten_kota')
            ->where('kabupaten_kota', '<>', '')
            ->distinct('kabupaten_kota')
            ->count('kabupaten_kota');

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Tendik;
use App\Support\SekolahResolver;

class TendikController extends Controller

    ];

    /**
     * Jabatan yang memperoleh seluruh level (1â€“4).
     */
    private const JABATAN_SEMUA_LEVEL = [
        'Tendik',
        'Operator',
        'Bendahara',
    ];

    /**
     * Pembagian nomor indikator berdasarkan level.
     */
    private function kelompokLevel(): array
    {
        return [
            1 => range(1, 15),
            2 => range(16, 33),
            3 => range(34, 38),
            4 => range(39, 43),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Tendik dan Operator memperoleh semua level.
     * Jabatan lainnya hanya memperoleh Level 3 dan 4.
     */
    private function levelBerlaku(string $jabatan): array
    {
        return in_array($jabatan, self::JABATAN_SEMUA_LEVEL, true)
            ? [1, 2, 3, 4]
            : [3, 4];
    }

    /**
     * Mengambil nomor indikator yang berlaku untuk jabatan.
     */
    private function nomorIndikatorBerlaku(string $jabatan): array
    {
        $kelompok = $this->kelompokLevel();
        $nomor = [];

        foreach ($this->levelBerlaku($jabatan) as $level) {
            $nomor = array_merge($nomor, $kelompok[$level]);
        }

        return $nomor;
    }

    public function index()
    {
        $tendiks = Tendik::latest()->paginate(10);

        $total = Tendik::count();

        $rataRata = round(
            (float) Tendik::whereNotNull('skor_keseluruhan')
                ->avg('skor_keseluruhan'),
            2
        );

        $sangatBaik = Tendik::where('predikat', 'Sangat Baik')->count();
        $baik = Tendik::where('predikat', 'Baik')->count();
        $cukup = Tendik::where('predikat', 'Cukup')->count();
        $kurang = Tendik::where('predikat', 'Kurang')->count();

        return view('tendik.index', compact(
            'tendiks',
            'total',
            'rataRata',
            'sangatBaik',
            'baik',
            'cukup',
            'kurang'
        ));
    }

    public function create()
    {
        return view('tendik.create');
    }

    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $this->validasiDanHitungSkor($request);

        $sekolah = SekolahResolver::resolve(
            $validated['satuan_pendidikan'] ?? null
        );

        $validated['sekolah_id'] = $sekolah?->id;

        $tendik = Tendik::create($validated);

        return redirect()
            ->route('tendik.show', $tendik->id)
            ->with('success', 'Data evaluasi TENDIK berhasil disimpan.');
    }

    public function show(Tendik $tendik)
    {
        return view('tendik.show', compact('tendik'));
    }

    public function cetak(Tendik $tendik)
    {
        return view('tendik.cetak', compact('tendik'));
    }

    public function edit(Tendik $tendik)
    {
        return view('tendik.edit', compact('tendik'));
    }

    public function update(Request $request, Tendik $tendik)
    {
        $validated = $this->validasiDanHitungSkor($request);

        $sekolah = SekolahResolver::resolve(
            $validated['satuan_pendidikan'] ?? null
        );

        $validated['sekolah_id'] = $sekolah?->id;

        $tendik->update($validated);

        return redirect()
            ->route('tendik.show', $tendik->id)
            ->with('success', 'Data evaluasi TENDIK berhasil diperbarui.');
    }

    public function destroy(Tendik $tendik)
    {
        $tendik->delete();

        return redirect()
            ->route('instrumen.index')
            ->with('success', 'Data evaluasi TENDIK berhasil dihapus.');
    }

    /**
     * Memvalidasi identitas dan hanya indikator yang berlaku,
     * kemudian menghitung skor berdasarkan level yang berlaku.
     */
    private function validasiDanHitungSkor(Request $request): array
    {
        $request->validate([
            'jabatan_responden' => [
                'required',
                Rule::in(self::JABATAN_TENDIK),
            ],
        ], [
            'jabatan_responden.required' => 'Jabatan responden wajib dipilih.',
            'jabatan_responden.in' => 'Pilih jabatan responden yang tersedia.',
        ]);

        $jabatan = $request->input('jabatan_responden');
        $nomorBerlaku = $this->nomorIndikatorBerlaku($jabatan);

        $rules = [
            'nama_petugas_monev' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'instansi_petugas' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'lokasi_monev' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'nama_responden' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'jabatan_responden' => [
                'required',
                Rule::in(self::JABATAN_TENDIK),
            ],
            'satuan_pendidikan' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'masa_kerja' => ['required', 'integer', 'min:0', 'max:100'],
            'nama_pelatihan' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'tanggal_pengisian' => ['required', 'date'],
        ];

        foreach ($nomorBerlaku as $nomor) {
            $rules['jawaban_' . $nomor] = [
                'required',
                'integer',
                'between:1,4',
            ];
        }

        $validated = $request->validate($rules, [
            'required' => 'Bagian ini wajib diisi.',
            'integer' => 'Jawaban harus berupa angka.',
            'between' => 'Pilih salah satu jawaban dengan skor 1 sampai 4.',
        ]);

        // Hitung skor hanya dari indikator yang berlaku.
        $kelompok = $this->kelompokLevel();
        $skorLevel = [];

        foreach ($this->levelBerlaku($jabatan) as $level) {
            $nilai = [];

            foreach ($kelompok[$level] as $nomor) {
                $nilai[] = (int) $validated['jawaban_' . $nomor];
            }

            $skorLevel[$level] = round(
                array_sum($nilai) / count($nilai),
                2
            );

            $validated['skor_level_' . $level] = $skorLevel[$level];
        }

        // Level yang tidak berlaku tidak dimasukkan ke rata-rata.
        // Nilai null memerlukan kolom database yang mengizinkan NULL.
        foreach ([1, 2, 3, 4] as $level) {
            if (!array_key_exists($level, $skorLevel)) {
                $validated['skor_level_' . $level] = null;
            }
        }

        // Setiap level yang berlaku memiliki bobot yang sama.
        $skorKeseluruhan = round(
            array_sum($skorLevel) / count($skorLevel),
            2
        );

        $validated['skor_keseluruhan'] = $skorKeseluruhan;

        $validated['predikat'] = match (true) {
            $skorKeseluruhan >= 3.26 => 'Sangat Baik',
            $skorKeseluruhan >= 2.51 => 'Baik',
            $skorKeseluruhan >= 1.76 => 'Cukup',
            default => 'Kurang',
        };

        // Field lama tidak lagi diperlukan karena jabatan sudah ditentukan.
        $validated['jabatan_lainnya'] = null;

        return $validated;
    }
}

=== FILE: app\Http\Controllers\WawancaraController.php ===
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Instrumen;
use App\Models\Sekolah;
use App\Models\Wawancara;
use App\Support\SekolahResolver;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

class WawancaraController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Konstanta jenis wawancara PKGSD MBI.
     */
    private const JENIS_PKGSD = 'PKGSD MBI';

    /**
     * Daftar wawancara, pencarian, filter, dan statistik.
     */
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $query = Wawancara::with(['instrumen', 'sekolah']);

        // Filter jenis wawancara.
        if ($request->filled('jenis_instrumen')) {
            $jenis = $request->jenis_instrumen;

            $query->where(function ($q) use ($jenis) {
                $q->where('jenis_wawancara', $jenis)
                    ->orWhere(function ($legacy) use ($jenis) {
                        $legacy->whereNull('jenis_wawancara')
                            ->whereHas('instrumen', function ($i) use ($jenis) {
                                if ($jenis === 'BCKS') {
                                    $i->where(function ($sub) {
                                        $sub->where(
                                            'nama_instrumen',
                                            'like',
                                            '%BCKS%'
                                        )->orWhere(
                                                'kode_instrumen',
                                                'like',
                                                '%BCKS%'
                                            );
                                    });
                                } elseif ($jenis === 'BK') {
                                    $i->where(function ($sub) {
                                        $sub->where(
                                            'nama_instrumen',
                                            'like',
                                            '%BK%'
                                        )->orWhere(
                                                'kode_instrumen',
                                                'like',
                                                '%BK%'
                                            );
                                    })
                                        ->where(function ($sub) {
                                            $sub->whereNull('nama_instrumen')
                                                ->orWhere(
                                                    'nama_instrumen',
                                                    'not like',
                                                    '%BCKS%'
                                                );
                                        })
                                        ->where(function ($sub) {
                                            $sub->whereNull('kode_instrumen')
                                                ->orWhere(
                                                    'kode_instrumen',
                                                    'not like',
                                                    '%BCKS%'
                                                );
                                        });
                                } elseif ($jenis === 'TENDIK') {
                                    $i->where(function ($sub) {
                                        $sub->where(
                                            'nama_instrumen',
                                            'like',
                                            '%TENDIK%'
                                        )->orWhere(
                                                'kode_instrumen',
                                                'like',
                                                '%TENDIK%'
                                            );
                                    });
                                }
                            });
                    });
            });
        }

        // Filter status.
        if ($request->filled('status')) {
            $status = $request->status;

            if (in_array($status, ['Draft', 'Dalam Proses'], true)) {
                $query->where('status', 'Belum Dilaksanakan');
            } elseif ($status === 'Final') {
                $query->where('status', 'Selesai');
            } elseif (
                in_array(
                    $status,
                    ['Belum Dilaksanakan', 'Selesai'],
                    true
                )
            ) {
                $query->where('status', $status);
            }
        }

        // Pencarian.
        if ($request->filled('search')) {
            $search = trim($request->search);

            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $fields = [
                    'jenis_wawancara',
                    'nama_bcks',
                    'unit_kerja_bcks',
                    'angkatan_pelatihan_bcks',
                    'nama_responden',
                    'unit_kerja_responden',
                    'status_responden',
                    'nama_petugas_monev',
                    'unit_kerja_petugas',
                    'nama_narasumber',
                    'jabatan_narasumber',
                    'nama_pewawancara',
                    'hasil_wawancara',
                    'catatan',
                ];

                foreach ($fields as $field) {
                    $q->orWhere($field, 'like', "%{$search}%");
                }

                $q->orWhereHas('instrumen', function ($i) use ($search) {
                    $i->where('nama_instrumen', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                        ->orWhere(
                            'kode_instrumen',
                            'like',
                            "%{$search}%"
                        );
                });

                $q->orWhereHas('sekolah', function ($s) use ($search) {
                    $s->where('nama_sekolah', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                        ->orWhere('npsn', 'like', "%{$search}%");
                });
            });
        }

        $wawancaras = (clone $query)
            ->latest('tanggal_wawancara')
            ->latest('id')
            ->paginate(10)
            ->withQueryString();

        $totalWawancara = (clone $query)->count();

        $selesai = (clone $query)
            ->where('status', 'Selesai')
            ->count();

        $belumDilaksanakan = (clone $query)
            ->where('status', 'Belum Dilaksanakan')
            ->count();

        $sekolahTerlibat = (clone $query)
            ->whereNotNull('sekolah_id')
            ->distinct()
            ->count('sekolah_id');

        return view('wawancara.index', compact(
            'wawancaras',
            'totalWawancara',
            'selesai',
            'belumDilaksanakan',
            'sekolahTerlibat'
        ));
    }

    /**
     * Menyimpan hasil wawancara PKGSD MBI.
     */
    public function storePkgsdMbi(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate($this->rulesPkgsdMbi());

        $wawancara = Wawancara::create($this->payloadPkgsdMbi($validated));

        return redirect()
            ->route('wawancara.show', $wawancara->id)
            ->with('success', 'Data wawancara PKGSD MBI berhasil disimpan.');
    }

    /**
     * Aturan validasi wawancara PKGSD MBI.
     */
    private function rulesPkgsdMbi(): array
    {
        $rules = [
            'nama_petugas_monev' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'instansi_petugas' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'lokasi_monev' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'tanggal_pelaksanaan' => ['required', 'date'],
            'tanggal_wawancara' => ['required', 'date'],

            'nama_responden' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'jabatan_responden' => [
                'required',
                'string',
                Rule::in(config('pkgsd_wawancara.jabatan')),
            ],
            'satuan_pendidikan' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'masa_kerja' => ['required', 'numeric', 'min:0', 'max:100'],
            'nama_pelatihan' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
        ];

        foreach (array_keys(config('pkgsd_wawancara.pertanyaan')) as $nomor) {
            $rules['jawaban_' . $nomor] = ['required', 'string'];
        }

        return $rules;
    }

    /**
     * Payload penyimpanan wawancara PKGSD MBI.
     */
    private function payloadPkgsdMbi(array $v): array
    {
        $metadata = [
            'instansi_petugas' => $v['instansi_petugas'],
            'lokasi_monev' => $v['lokasi_monev'],
            'tanggal_pelaksanaan' => $v['tanggal_pelaksanaan'],
            'jabatan_responden' => $v['jabatan_responden'],
            'satuan_pendidikan' => $v['satuan_pendidikan'],
            'masa_kerja' => $v['masa_kerja'],
            'nama_pelatihan' => $v['nama_pelatihan'],
        ];

        $payload = [
            'jenis_wawancara' => self::JENIS_PKGSD,
            'instrumen_id' => null,
            'sekolah_id' => SekolahResolver::resolve($v['satuan_pendidikan'])?->id,

            'tanggal_wawancara' => $v['tanggal_wawancara'],
            'tanggal_evaluasi' => $v['tanggal_pelaksanaan'],
            'status' => 'Selesai',

            'nama_petugas_monev' => $v['nama_petugas_monev'],
            'unit_kerja_petugas' => $v['instansi_petugas'],
            'nama_pewawancara' => $v['nama_petugas_monev'],

            'nama_responden' => $v['nama_responden'],
            'unit_kerja_responden' => $v['satuan_pendidikan'],
            'status_responden' => $v['jabatan_responden'],

            'nama_narasumber' => $v['nama_responden'],
            'jabatan_narasumber' => $v['jabatan_responden'],

            'hasil_wawancara' => json_encode($metadata, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE),
        ];

        foreach (array_keys(config('pkgsd_wawancara.pertanyaan')) as $nomor) {
            $payload['jawaban_' . $nomor] = $v['jawaban_' . $nomor];
        }

        return $payload;
    }

    /**
     * Mendekode metadata wawancara dari kolom hasil_wawancara.
     */
    private function metadataWawancara(Wawancara $wawancara): array
    {
        $metadata = json_decode($wawancara->hasil_wawancara ?? '{}', true);

        return is_array($metadata) ? $metadata : [];
    }

    /**
     * Menyimpan wawancara terbuka Matematika GEMBIRA.
     */
    public function storeGembira(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'nama_guru' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'nama_sekolah' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'kelas_fase' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'topik_materi' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],

            'nama_petugas_monev' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'jabatan_penilai' => [
                'required',
                'string',
                'in:Peserta Matematika GEMBIRA,Rekan sejawat,Atasan langsung/Kepala Sekolah',
            ],
            'tanggal_monev' => ['required', 'date'],
            'sumber_data_bukti' => ['nullable', 'string'],
            'catatan' => ['nullable', 'string'],

            'jawaban_1' => ['required', 'string'],
            'jawaban_2' => ['required', 'string'],
            'jawaban_3' => ['required', 'string'],
            'jawaban_4' => ['required', 'string'],
            'jawaban_5_a' => ['required', 'string'],
            'jawaban_5_b' => ['required', 'string'],
            'jawaban_5_c' => ['required', 'string'],
            'jawaban_5_d' => ['required', 'string'],
            'jawaban_5_e' => ['required', 'string'],
            'jawaban_6' => ['required', 'string'],
            'jawaban_7' => ['required', 'string'],
        ]);

        // Simpan identitas dan seluruh jawaban dalam metadata JSON.
        $metadata = [
            'program' => 'Matematika GEMBIRA',
            'nama_guru' => $validated['nama_guru'],
            'nama_sekolah' => $validated['nama_sekolah'],
            'kelas_fase' => $validated['kelas_fase'] ?? null,
            'topik_materi' => $validated['topik_materi'] ?? null,
            'jabatan_penilai' => $validated['jabatan_penilai'],
            'tanggal_monev' => $validated['tanggal_monev'],
            'sumber_data_bukti' => $validated['sumber_data_bukti'] ?? null,

            'jawaban_terbuka' => [
                '1' => $validated['jawaban_1'],
                '2' => $validated['jawaban_2'],
                '3' => $validated['jawaban_3'],
                '4' => $validated['jawaban_4'],
                '5' => [
                    'a' => $validated['jawaban_5_a'],
                    'b' => $validated['jawaban_5_b'],
                    'c' => $validated['jawaban_5_c'],
                    'd' => $validated['jawaban_5_d'],
                    'e' => $validated['jawaban_5_e'],
                ],
                '6' => $validated['jawaban_6'],
                '7' => $validated['jawaban_7'],
            ],
        ];

        $sekolah = SekolahResolver::resolve($validated['nama_sekolah']);

        $wawancara = Wawancara::create([
            'jenis_wawancara' => 'GEMBIRA',
            'instrumen_id' => null,
            'sekolah_id' => $sekolah?->id,

            'tanggal_wawancara' => $validated['tanggal_monev'],
            'tanggal_evaluasi' => $validated['tanggal_monev'],
            'status' => 'Selesai',

            'nama_petugas_monev' => $validated['nama_petugas_monev'],
            'unit_kerja_petugas' => '-',
            'nama_pewawancara' => $validated['nama_petugas_monev'],

            'nama_responden' => $validated['nama_guru'],
            'unit_kerja_responden' => $validated['nama_sekolah'],
            'status_responden' => $validated['jabatan_penilai'],

            'nama_narasumber' => $validated['nama_guru'],
            'jabatan_narasumber' => $validated['jabatan_penilai'],

            // Kolom jawaban yang sudah digunakan oleh controller lama.
            'jawaban_1' => $validated['jawaban_1'],
            'jawaban_2' => $validated['jawaban_2'],
            'jawaban_3' => $validated['jawaban_3'],
            'jawaban_4' => $validated['jawaban_4'],
            'jawaban_5' => json_encode([
                'a' => $validated['jawaban_5_a'],
                'b' => $validated['jawaban_5_b'],
                'c' => $validated['jawaban_5_c'],
                'd' => $validated['jawaban_5_d'],
                'e' => $validated['jawaban_5_e'],
            ], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE),

            'hasil_wawancara' => json_encode(
                $metadata,
                JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE
            ),
            'catatan' => $validated['catatan'] ?? null,
        ]);

        return redirect()
            ->route('wawancara.show', $wawancara->id)
            ->with('success', 'Wawancara terbuka Matematika GEMBIRA berhasil disimpan.');
    }

    /**
     * Menyimpan hasil wawancara TENDIK.
     */
    public function storeTendik(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'nama_petugas_monev' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'instansi_petugas' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'lokasi_monev' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],

            'tanggal_pelaksanaan' => ['required', 'date'],
            'tanggal_wawancara' => ['required', 'date'],

            'nama_responden' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'jabatan_responden' => [
                'required',
                'string',
                'in:Tendik,Operator,Bendahara,Kepala Sekolah,Rekan Sejawat/Guru',
            ],

            'satuan_pendidikan' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'masa_kerja' => ['required', 'numeric', 'min:0', 'max:100'],
            'nama_pelatihan' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],

            'jawaban_1' => ['required', 'string'],
            'jawaban_2' => ['required', 'string'],
            'jawaban_3' => ['required', 'string'],
            'jawaban_4' => ['required', 'string'],
            'jawaban_5' => ['required', 'string'],
        ]);

        $metadata = [
            'instansi_petugas' => $validated['instansi_petugas'],
            'lokasi_monev' => $validated['lokasi_monev'],
            'tanggal_pelaksanaan' => $validated['tanggal_pelaksanaan'],
            'jabatan_responden' => $validated['jabatan_responden'],
            'satuan_pendidikan' => $validated['satuan_pendidikan'],
            'masa_kerja' => $validated['masa_kerja'],
            'nama_pelatihan' => $validated['nama_pelatihan'],
        ];

        $wawancara = Wawancara::create([
            'jenis_wawancara' => 'TENDIK',
            'instrumen_id' => null,

            'sekolah_id' => SekolahResolver::resolve(
                $validated['satuan_pendidikan']
            )?->id,

            'tanggal_wawancara' => $validated['tanggal_wawancara'],
            'tanggal_evaluasi' => $validated['tanggal_pelaksanaan'],
            'status' => 'Selesai',

            'nama_petugas_monev' => $validated['nama_petugas_monev'],
            'unit_kerja_petugas' => $validated['instansi_petugas'],
            'nama_pewawancara' => $validated['nama_petugas_monev'],

            'nama_responden' => $validated['nama_responden'],
            'unit_kerja_responden' => $validated['satuan_pendidikan'],
            'status_responden' => $validated['jabatan_responden'],

            // Mempertahankan kolom lama agar kompatibel dengan data sebelumnya.
            'nama_narasumber' => $validated['nama_responden'],
            'jabatan_narasumber' => $validated['jabatan_responden'],

            'jawaban_1' => $validated['jawaban_1'],
            'jawaban_2' => $validated['jawaban_2'],
            'jawaban_3' => $validated['jawaban_3'],
            'jawaban_4' => $validated['jawaban_4'],
            'jawaban_5' => $validated['jawaban_5'],

            'hasil_wawancara' => json_encode(
                $metadata,
                JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE
            ),
        ]);

        return redirect()
            ->route('wawancara.show', $wawancara->id)
            ->with('success', 'Data wawancara TENDIK berhasil disimpan.');
    }

    /**
     * Form BCKS.
     */
    private function formBcks()
    {
        return view('wawancara.create');
    }

    /**
     * Menyimpan wawancara BCKS.
     */
    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $this->validasiBcksBaru($request);

        Wawancara::create($validated);

        return redirect()
            ->route('wawancara.index')
            ->with('success', 'Data wawancara BCKS berhasil disimpan.');
    }

    /**
     * Validasi dan persiapan data BCKS.
     */
    private function validasiBcksBaru(Request $request): array
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'tanggal_evaluasi' => ['required', 'date'],

            'nama_bcks' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'unit_kerja_bcks' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'angkatan_pelatihan_bcks' => [
                'required',
                'string',
                'max:255',
            ],

            'nama_responden' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'unit_kerja_responden' => [
                'required',
                'string',
                'max:255',
            ],
            'status_responden' => [
                'required',
                'string',
                Rule::in([
                    'BCKS',
                    'Atasan Langsung / Pengawas Sekolah',
                    'Perwakilan Guru / Tenaga Kependidikan',
                ]),
            ],

            'nama_petugas_monev' => [
                'required',
                'string',
                'max:255',
            ],
            'unit_kerja_petugas' => [
                'required',
                'string',
                'max:255',
            ],

            'jawaban_1' => ['nullable', 'string'],
            'jawaban_2' => ['nullable', 'string'],
            'jawaban_3' => ['nullable', 'string'],
            'jawaban_4' => ['nullable', 'string'],
            'jawaban_5' => ['nullable', 'string'],

            'hasil_wawancara' => ['nullable', 'string'],
            'catatan' => ['nullable', 'string'],
        ]);

        $validated['jenis_wawancara'] = 'BCKS';
        $validated['instrumen_id'] = null;
        $validated['sekolah_id'] = SekolahResolver::resolve(
            $validated['unit_kerja_responden']
        )?->id;

        $validated['tanggal_wawancara'] =
            $validated['tanggal_evaluasi'];

        $validated['nama_narasumber'] =
            $validated['nama_responden'];

        $validated['jabatan_narasumber'] =
            $validated['status_responden'];

        $validated['nama_pewawancara'] =
            $validated['nama_petugas_monev'];

        $validated['status'] = 'Selesai';

        return $validated;
    }

    /**
     * Menyimpan wawancara BK.
     */
    public function storeBk(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            // Identitas petugas Monev
            'nama_petugas_monev' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'instansi_petugas' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'lokasi_monev' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'tanggal_wawancara' => ['required', 'date'],

            // Identitas responden
            'nama_responden' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'jabatan' => [
                'required',
                'string',
                Rule::in([
                    'BK',
                    'Kepala Sekolah',
                    'Rekan Sejawat',
                    'Peserta Didik',
                ]),
            ],
            'satuan_pendidikan' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'masa_kerja' => ['required', 'numeric', 'min:0', 'max:100'],
            'nama_kegiatan' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'tanggal_pengisian' => ['required', 'date'],

            // Jawaban wawancara (DIPERBARUI MENJADI 5)
            'jawaban_wawancara' => ['required', 'array'],
            'jawaban_wawancara.1' => ['required', 'string'],
            'jawaban_wawancara.2' => ['required', 'string'],
            'jawaban_wawancara.3' => ['required', 'string'],
            'jawaban_wawancara.4' => ['required', 'string'],
            'jawaban_wawancara.5' => ['required', 'string'],
        ]);

        $namaPetugas = $validated['nama_petugas_monev'];
        $namaResponden = $validated['nama_responden'];
        $tanggal = $validated['tanggal_wawancara'];

        $instansiPetugas = $validated['instansi_petugas'] ?? '-';
        $satuanPendidikan = $validated['satuan_pendidikan'];

        // Metadata tambahan disimpan dalam JSON.
        $metadata = [
            'instansi_petugas' => $instansiPetugas,
            'lokasi_monev' => $validated['lokasi_monev'] ?? null,
            'jabatan' => $validated['jabatan'],
            'satuan_pendidikan' => $satuanPendidikan,
            'masa_kerja' => $validated['masa_kerja'],
            'nama_kegiatan' => $validated['nama_kegiatan'],
            'tanggal_pengisian' => $validated['tanggal_pengisian'],
        ];

        Wawancara::create([
            'jenis_wawancara' => 'BK',
            'instrumen_id' => null,

            'sekolah_id' => SekolahResolver::resolve(
                $satuanPendidikan
            )?->id,

            'tanggal_wawancara' => $tanggal,
            'tanggal_evaluasi' => $tanggal,
            'status' => 'Selesai',

            // Identitas petugas Monev
            'nama_petugas_monev' => $namaPetugas,
            'unit_kerja_petugas' => $instansiPetugas,
            'nama_pewawancara' => $namaPetugas,

            // Identitas responden pada kolom yang tersedia
            'nama_responden' => $namaResponden,
            'unit_kerja_responden' => $satuanPendidikan,
            'status_responden' => $validated['jabatan'],

            // Kompatibilitas dengan kolom lama
            'nama_narasumber' => $namaResponden,
            'jabatan_narasumber' => $validated['jabatan'],

            // Lima jawaban wawancara (DIPERBARUI)
            'jawaban_1' => $validated['jawaban_wawancara'][1],
            'jawaban_2' => $validated['jawaban_wawancara'][2],
            'jawaban_3' => $validated['jawaban_wawancara'][3],
            'jawaban_4' => $validated['jawaban_wawancara'][4],
            'jawaban_5' => $validated['jawaban_wawancara'][5],

            'hasil_wawancara' => json_encode(
                $metadata,
                JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE
            ),
        ]);

        return redirect()
            ->route('wawancara.index')
            ->with('success', 'Data wawancara BK berhasil disimpan.');
    }

    /**
     * Menampilkan detail wawancara.
     */
    public function show(Wawancara $wawancara)
    {
        $wawancara->load([
            'instrumen',
            'sekolah',
            'tindakLanjut',
        ]);

        $jenis = strtoupper(trim($wawancara->jenis_wawancara ?? ''));

        // Detail wawancara Matematika GEMBIRA.
        if ($jenis === 'GEMBIRA') {
            $metadata = json_decode(
                $wawancara->hasil_wawancara ?? '{}',
                true
            );

            if (!is_array($metadata)) {
                $metadata = [];
            }

            return view(
                'wawancara.show-gembira',
                compact('wawancara', 'metadata')
            );
        }

        // Detail PKGSD MBI.
        if ($jenis === self::JENIS_PKGSD) {
            return view('wawancara.show-pkgsd-mbi', [
                'wawancara' => $wawancara,
                'metadata' => $this->metadataWawancara($wawancara),
            ]);
        }

        // Detail TENDIK.
        if ($jenis === 'TENDIK') {
            return view('wawancara.show-tendik', compact('wawancara'));
        }

        // Detail BK.
        if ($jenis === 'BK') {
            return view('wawancara.show-bk', compact('wawancara'));
        }

        // Detail BCKS dan wawancara lama.
        return view('wawancara.show', compact('wawancara'));
    }

    /**
     * Form edit wawancara.
     */
    public function edit(Wawancara $wawancara)
    {
        $wawancara->load([
            'instrumen',
            'sekolah',
            'tindakLanjut',
        ]);

        $jenis = strtoupper(trim($wawancara->jenis_wawancara ?? ''));

        if ($jenis === 'GEMBIRA') {
            $metadata = json_decode(
                $wawancara->hasil_wawancara ?? '{}',
                true
            );

            if (!is_array($metadata)) {
                $metadata = [];
            }

            return view(
                'wawancara.edit-gembira',
                compact('wawancara', 'metadata')
            );
        }

        // Form edit PKGSD MBI.
        if ($jenis === self::JENIS_PKGSD) {
            return view('wawancara.edit-pkgsd-mbi', [
                'wawancara' => $wawancara,
                'metadata' => $this->metadataWawancara($wawancara),
            ]);
        }

        // Form edit TENDIK.
        if ($jenis === 'TENDIK') {
            $metadata = json_decode(
                $wawancara->hasil_wawancara ?? '{}',
                true
            );

            if (!is_array($metadata)) {
                $metadata = [];
            }

            return view(
                'wawancara.edit-tendik',
                compact('wawancara', 'metadata')
            );
        }

        // Form edit BK.
        if ($jenis === 'BK') {
            return view('wawancara.edit-bk', compact('wawancara'));
        }

        // Form edit BCKS dan wawancara lama.
        $instrumens = Instrumen::orderBy('nama_instrumen')->get();
        $sekolahs = Sekolah::orderBy('nama_sekolah')->get();

        return view('wawancara.edit', compact(
            'wawancara',
            'instrumens',
            'sekolahs'
        ));
    }

    /**
     * Memperbarui data wawancara.
     */
    public function update(Request $request, Wawancara $wawancara)
    {
        $jenis = strtoupper(trim($wawancara->jenis_wawancara ?? ''));

        // Update PKGSD MBI.
        if ($jenis === self::JENIS_PKGSD) {
            $validated = $request->validate($this->rulesPkgsdMbi());

            $wawancara->update($this->payloadPkgsdMbi($validated));

            return redirect()
                ->route('wawancara.show', $wawancara->id)
                ->with('success', 'Data wawancara PKGSD MBI berhasil diperbarui.');
        }

        if ($jenis === 'GEMBIRA') {
            $validated = $request->validate([
                'nama_guru' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
                'nama_sekolah' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
                'kelas_fase' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
                'topik_materi' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],

                'nama_petugas_monev' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
                'jabatan_penilai' => [
                    'required',
                    'string',
                    'in:Peserta Matematika GEMBIRA,Rekan sejawat,Atasan langsung/Kepala Sekolah',
                ],
                'tanggal_monev' => ['required', 'date'],
                'sumber_data_bukti' => ['nullable', 'string'],
                'catatan' => ['nullable', 'string'],

                'jawaban_1' => ['required', 'string'],
                'jawaban_2' => ['required', 'string'],
                'jawaban_3' => ['required', 'string'],
                'jawaban_4' => ['required', 'string'],
                'jawaban_5_a' => ['required', 'string'],
                'jawaban_5_b' => ['required', 'string'],
                'jawaban_5_c' => ['required', 'string'],
                'jawaban_5_d' => ['required', 'string'],
                'jawaban_5_e' => ['required', 'string'],
                'jawaban_6' => ['required', 'string'],
                'jawaban_7' => ['required', 'string'],
            ]);

            // Ambil metadata sebelumnya agar informasi yang tidak diubah tetap terjaga.
            $metadata = json_decode(
                $wawancara->hasil_wawancara ?? '{}',
                true
            );

            if (!is_array($metadata)) {
                $metadata = [];
            }

            $jawabanTerbuka = [
                '1' => $validated['jawaban_1'],
                '2' => $validated['jawaban_2'],
                '3' => $validated['jawaban_3'],
                '4' => $validated['jawaban_4'],
                '5' => [
                    'a' => $validated['jawaban_5_a'],
                    'b' => $validated['jawaban_5_b'],
                    'c' => $validated['jawaban_5_c'],
                    'd' => $validated['jawaban_5_d'],
                    'e' => $validated['jawaban_5_e'],
                ],
                '6' => $validated['jawaban_6'],
                '7' => $validated['jawaban_7'],
            ];

            $metadata = array_merge($metadata, [
                'program' => 'Matematika GEMBIRA',
                'nama_guru' => $validated['nama_guru'],
                'nama_sekolah' => $validated['nama_sekolah'],
                'kelas_fase' => $validated['kelas_fase'] ?? null,
                'topik_materi' => $validated['topik_materi'] ?? null,
                'jabatan_penilai' => $validated['jabatan_penilai'],
                'tanggal_monev' => $validated['tanggal_monev'],
                'sumber_data_bukti' => $validated['sumber_data_bukti'] ?? null,
                'jawaban_terbuka' => $jawabanTerbuka,
            ]);

            $sekolah = SekolahResolver::resolve($validated['nama_sekolah']);

            $wawancara->update([
                'jenis_wawancara' => 'GEMBIRA',
                'sekolah_id' => $sekolah?->id,
                'tanggal_wawancara' => $validated['tanggal_monev'],
                'tanggal_evaluasi' => $validated['tanggal_monev'],
                'status' => 'Selesai',

                'nama_petugas_monev' => $validated['nama_petugas_monev'],
                'nama_pewawancara' => $validated['nama_petugas_monev'],
                'nama_responden' => $validated['nama_guru'],
                'unit_kerja_responden' => $validated['nama_sekolah'],
                'status_responden' => $validated['jabatan_penilai'],
                'nama_narasumber' => $validated['nama_guru'],
                'jabatan_narasumber' => $validated['jabatan_penilai'],

                'jawaban_1' => $validated['jawaban_1'],
                'jawaban_2' => $validated['jawaban_2'],
                'jawaban_3' => $validated['jawaban_3'],
                'jawaban_4' => $validated['jawaban_4'],
                'jawaban_5' => json_encode(
                    $jawabanTerbuka['5'],
                    JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE
                ),

                'hasil_wawancara' => json_encode(
                    $metadata,
                    JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE
                ),
                'catatan' => $validated['catatan'] ?? null,
            ]);

            return redirect()
                ->route('wawancara.show', $wawancara->id)
                ->with('success', 'Wawancara Matematika GEMBIRA berhasil diperbarui.');
        }

        /*
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        | 1. UPDATE WAWANCARA TENDIK
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        */
        if ($jenis === 'TENDIK') {
            $validated = $request->validate([
                'nama_petugas_monev' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
                'instansi_petugas' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
                'lokasi_monev' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
                'tanggal_pengisian' => ['required', 'date'],

                'nama_responden' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
                'jabatan_responden' => [
                    'required',
                    'string',
                    'in:Tendik,Operator,Bendahara,Kepala Sekolah,Rekan Sejawat/Guru',
                ],
                'jabatan_lainnya' => [
                    'required_if:jabatan_responden,Lainnya',
                    'nullable',
                    'string',
                    'max:255',
                ],

                'satuan_pendidikan' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
                'masa_kerja' => ['required', 'numeric', 'min:0', 'max:100'],
                'nama_pelatihan' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],

                'jawaban_1' => ['required', 'string'],
                'jawaban_2' => ['required', 'string'],
                'jawaban_3' => ['required', 'string'],
                'jawaban_4' => ['required', 'string'],
                'jawaban_5' => ['required', 'string'],
            ], [
                'jabatan_lainnya.required_if' => 'Tuliskan jabatan lainnya.',
            ]);

            $jabatanFinal = $validated['jabatan_responden'] === 'Lainnya'
                ? trim($validated['jabatan_lainnya'])
                : $validated['jabatan_responden'];

            // Ambil metadata lama agar informasi lain tidak hilang.
            $metadata = json_decode(
                $wawancara->hasil_wawancara ?? '{}',
                true
            );

            if (!is_array($metadata)) {
                $metadata = [];
            }

            // Perbarui metadata identitas TENDIK.
            $metadata = array_merge($metadata, [
                'instansi_petugas' => $validated['instansi_petugas'],
                'lokasi_monev' => $validated['lokasi_monev'],
                'tanggal_pengisian' => $validated['tanggal_pengisian'],

                'jabatan_responden' => $validated['jabatan_responden'],
                'jabatan_lainnya' => $validated['jabatan_responden'] === 'Lainnya'
                    ? trim($validated['jabatan_lainnya'])
                    : null,

                'satuan_pendidikan' => $validated['satuan_pendidikan'],
                'masa_kerja' => $validated['masa_kerja'],
                'nama_pelatihan' => $validated['nama_pelatihan'],
            ]);

            $tanggal = $validated['tanggal_pengisian'];
            $satuanPendidikan = $validated['satuan_pendidikan'];

            $wawancara->update([
                'jenis_wawancara' => 'TENDIK',

                'tanggal_wawancara' => $tanggal,
                'tanggal_evaluasi' => $tanggal,
                'status' => 'Selesai',

                // Identitas petugas.
                'nama_petugas_monev' => $validated['nama_petugas_monev'],
                'unit_kerja_petugas' => $validated['instansi_petugas'],
                'nama_pewawancara' => $validated['nama_petugas_monev'],

                // Identitas responden.
                'nama_responden' => $validated['nama_responden'],
                'unit_kerja_responden' => $satuanPendidikan,
                'status_responden' => $jabatanFinal,

                // Sinkronisasi kolom lama.
                'nama_narasumber' => $validated['nama_responden'],
                'jabatan_narasumber' => $jabatanFinal,

                // Lima jawaban wawancara.
                'jawaban_1' => $validated['jawaban_1'],
                'jawaban_2' => $validated['jawaban_2'],
                'jawaban_3' => $validated['jawaban_3'],
                'jawaban_4' => $validated['jawaban_4'],
                'jawaban_5' => $validated['jawaban_5'],

                // Simpan metadata identitas dan data tambahan.
                'hasil_wawancara' => json_encode(
                    $metadata,
                    JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE
                ),
            ]);

            // Sinkronkan sekolah jika satuan pendidikan ditemukan.
            $sekolah = SekolahResolver::resolve($satuanPendidikan);

            if ($sekolah) {
                $wawancara->update([
                    'sekolah_id' => $sekolah->id,
                ]);
            }

            return redirect()
                ->route('wawancara.show', $wawancara->id)
                ->with(
                    'success',
                    'Data wawancara TENDIK berhasil diperbarui.'
                );
        }

        /*
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        | 2. UPDATE WAWANCARA BK
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        */
        if ($jenis === 'BK') {
            $validated = $request->validate([
                'tanggal_wawancara' => ['required', 'date'],

                'nama_responden' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
                'jabatan' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
                'satuan_pendidikan' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
                'masa_kerja' => ['required', 'numeric', 'min:0', 'max:100'],
                'nama_kegiatan' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
                'tanggal_pengisian' => ['required', 'date'],

                'nama_petugas_monev' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
                'instansi_petugas' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
                'lokasi_monev' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],

                // DIPERBARUI MENJADI 5
                'jawaban_wawancara' => ['required', 'array'],
                'jawaban_wawancara.1' => ['required', 'string'],
                'jawaban_wawancara.2' => ['required', 'string'],
                'jawaban_wawancara.3' => ['required', 'string'],
                'jawaban_wawancara.4' => ['required', 'string'],
                'jawaban_wawancara.5' => ['required', 'string'],
            ]);

            $metadata = json_decode(
                $wawancara->hasil_wawancara ?? '{}',
                true
            );

            if (!is_array($metadata)) {
                $metadata = [];
            }

            $instansiPetugas = $validated['instansi_petugas'] ?? '-';
            $satuanPendidikan = $validated['satuan_pendidikan'];
            $namaResponden = $validated['nama_responden'];
            $namaPetugas = $validated['nama_petugas_monev'];
            $tanggal = $validated['tanggal_wawancara'];

            $metadata = array_merge($metadata, [
                'instansi_petugas' => $instansiPetugas,
                'lokasi_monev' => $validated['lokasi_monev'] ?? null,
                'jabatan' => $validated['jabatan'],
                'satuan_pendidikan' => $satuanPendidikan,
                'masa_kerja' => $validated['masa_kerja'],
                'nama_kegiatan' => $validated['nama_kegiatan'],
                'tanggal_pengisian' => $validated['tanggal_pengisian'],
            ]);

            $wawancara->update([
                'tanggal_wawancara' => $tanggal,
                'tanggal_evaluasi' => $tanggal,
                'status' => 'Selesai',

                'nama_petugas_monev' => $namaPetugas,
                'unit_kerja_petugas' => $instansiPetugas,
                'nama_pewawancara' => $namaPetugas,

                'nama_responden' => $namaResponden,
                'unit_kerja_responden' => $satuanPendidikan,
                'status_responden' => $validated['jabatan'],

                'nama_narasumber' => $namaResponden,
                'jabatan_narasumber' => $validated['jabatan'],

                // DIPERBARUI MENJADI 5
                'jawaban_1' => $validated['jawaban_wawancara'][1],
                'jawaban_2' => $validated['jawaban_wawancara'][2],
                'jawaban_3' => $validated['jawaban_wawancara'][3],
                'jawaban_4' => $validated['jawaban_wawancara'][4],
                'jawaban_5' => $validated['jawaban_wawancara'][5],

                'hasil_wawancara' => json_encode(
                    $metadata,
                    JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE
                ),
            ]);

            $sekolah = SekolahResolver::resolve($satuanPendidikan);

            if ($sekolah) {
                $wawancara->update(['sekolah_id' => $sekolah->id]);
            }

            return redirect()
                ->route('wawancara.show', $wawancara->id)
                ->with('success', 'Data wawancara BK berhasil diperbarui.');
        }

        /*
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        | 3. UPDATE WAWANCARA BCKS
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        */
        $fieldBcks = [
            'nama_bcks',
            'unit_kerja_bcks',
            'angkatan_pelatihan_bcks',
            'nama_responden',
            'unit_kerja_responden',
            'status_responden',
            'nama_petugas_monev',
            'unit_kerja_petugas',
            'jawaban_1',
            'jawaban_2',
            'jawaban_3',
            'jawaban_4',
            'jawaban_5',
        ];

        $isBcks = $jenis === 'BCKS';

        if (!$isBcks) {
            foreach ($fieldBcks as $field) {
                if ($request->exists($field)) {
                    $isBcks = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        if ($isBcks) {
            $validated = $request->validate([
                'nama_bcks' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
                'unit_kerja_bcks' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
                'angkatan_pelatihan_bcks' => [
                    'required',
                    'string',
                    'max:255',
                ],

                'nama_responden' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
                'unit_kerja_responden' => [
                    'required',
                    'string',
                    'max:255',
                ],
                'status_responden' => [
                    'required',
                    'string',
                    Rule::in([
                        'BCKS',
                        'Atasan Langsung / Pengawas Sekolah',
                        'Perwakilan Guru / Tenaga Kependidikan',
                    ]),
                ],

                'nama_petugas_monev' => [
                    'required',
                    'string',
                    'max:255',
                ],
                'unit_kerja_petugas' => [
                    'required',
                    'string',
                    'max:255',
                ],

                'tanggal_evaluasi' => ['sometimes', 'required', 'date'],

                'jawaban_1' => ['nullable', 'string'],
                'jawaban_2' => ['nullable', 'string'],
                'jawaban_3' => ['nullable', 'string'],
                'jawaban_4' => ['nullable', 'string'],
                'jawaban_5' => ['nullable', 'string'],

                'hasil_wawancara' => ['nullable', 'string'],
                'catatan' => ['nullable', 'string'],
            ]);

            $validated['instrumen_id'] = $wawancara->instrumen_id;
            $validated['sekolah_id'] = $wawancara->sekolah_id;

            $tanggalEvaluasi = $validated['tanggal_evaluasi']
                ?? $wawancara->tanggal_evaluasi
                ?? $wawancara->tanggal_wawancara;

            if ($tanggalEvaluasi instanceof \DateTimeInterface) {
                $tanggalEvaluasi = $tanggalEvaluasi->format('Y-m-d');
            }

            $validated['tanggal_evaluasi'] = $tanggalEvaluasi;
            $validated['tanggal_wawancara'] = $tanggalEvaluasi;
            $validated['status'] = 'Selesai';
            $validated['jenis_wawancara'] = 'BCKS';

            $validated['nama_narasumber'] = $validated['nama_responden'];
            $validated['jabatan_narasumber'] = $validated['status_responden'];
            $validated['nama_pewawancara'] = $validated['nama_petugas_monev'];

            $wawancara->update($validated);

            return redirect()
                ->route('wawancara.show', $wawancara->id)
                ->with(
                    'success',
                    'Data wawancara BCKS berhasil diperbarui.'
                );
        }

        /*
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        | 4. UPDATE WAWANCARA LAMA
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        */
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'instrumen_id' => [
                'required',
                'integer',
                Rule::exists('instrumens', 'id'),
            ],
            'sekolah_id' => [
                'required',
                'integer',
                Rule::exists('sekolahs', 'id'),
            ],
            'tanggal_wawancara' => ['required', 'date'],
            'nama_narasumber' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'jabatan_narasumber' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'nama_pewawancara' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'status' => [
                'required',
                Rule::in(['Belum Dilaksanakan', 'Selesai']),
            ],
            'hasil_wawancara' => ['nullable', 'string'],
            'catatan' => ['nullable', 'string'],
        ]);

        $wawancara->update($validated);

        return redirect()
            ->route('wawancara.show', $wawancara->id)
            ->with(
                'success',
                'Data wawancara berhasil diperbarui.'
            );
    }

    public function cetakBcks(\App\Models\Wawancara $wawancara)
    {
        abort_unless(
            strtoupper(trim($wawancara->jenis_wawancara ?? '')) === 'BCKS',
            404
        );

        return view('wawancara.cetak-bcks', compact('wawancara'));
    }

    public function cetak(Wawancara $wawancara)
    {
        $jenis = strtoupper(trim($wawancara->jenis_wawancara ?? ''));

        if ($jenis === 'GEMBIRA') {
            $metadata = json_decode(
                $wawancara->hasil_wawancara ?? '{}',
                true
            );

            if (!is_array($metadata)) {
                $metadata = [];
            }

            return view(
                'wawancara.cetak-gembira',
                compact('wawancara', 'metadata')
            );
        }

        if ($jenis === self::JENIS_PKGSD) {
            return view('wawancara.cetak-pkgsd-mbi', [
                'wawancara' => $wawancara,
                'metadata' => $this->metadataWawancara($wawancara),
            ]);
        }

        if ($jenis === 'TENDIK') {
            $metadata = json_decode(
                $wawancara->hasil_wawancara ?? '{}',
                true
            );

            if (!is_array($metadata)) {
                $metadata = [];
            }

            return view(
                'wawancara.cetak-tendik',
                compact('wawancara', 'metadata')
            );
        }

        if ($jenis === 'BK') {
            return view('wawancara.cetak-bk', compact('wawancara'));
        }

        abort(404);
    }

    /**
     * Menghapus wawancara.
     */
    public function destroy(Wawancara $wawancara)
    {
        $wawancara->delete();

        return redirect()
            ->route('wawancara.index')
            ->with('success', 'Data wawancara berhasil dihapus.');
    }
}

=== FILE: app\Http\Controllers\Auth\LoginController.php ===
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Auth;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;

class LoginController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Menampilkan halaman login.
     */
    public function showLoginForm()
    {
        if (Auth::check()) {
            return redirect()->route('dashboard');
        }

        return view('auth.login');
    }

    /**
     * Memproses login menggunakan username dan NIP.
     * NIP digunakan sebagai password sesuai kebutuhan sistem.
     */
    public function login(Request $request)
    {
        $credentials = $request->validate([
            'username' => ['required', 'string'],
            'password' => ['required', 'string'],
        ], [
            'username.required' => 'Username wajib diisi.',
            'password.required' => 'NIP wajib diisi.',
        ]);

        $remember = $request->boolean('remember');

        if (
            Auth::attempt([
                'username' => $credentials['username'],
                'password' => $credentials['password'],
                'is_active' => true,
            ], $remember)
        ) {
            $request->session()->regenerate();

            return redirect()
                ->intended(route('dashboard'))
                ->with('success', 'Selamat datang di BGTK Monev.');
        }

        return back()
            ->withErrors([
                'username' => 'Username, NIP, atau status akun tidak sesuai.',
            ])
            ->onlyInput('username');
    }

    /**
     * Memproses logout pengguna.
     */
    public function logout(Request $request)
    {
        Auth::logout();

        $request->session()->invalidate();
        $request->session()->regenerateToken();

        return redirect()
            ->route('login')
            ->with('success', 'Anda berhasil keluar dari sistem.');
    }
}


=== FILE: app\Http\Middleware\AdminMiddleware.php ===
<?php

namespace App\Http\Middleware;

use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

class AdminMiddleware
{
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
    {
        if (! auth()->check()) {
            return redirect()->route('login');
        }

        if (! auth()->user()->isAdmin()) {
            abort(403, 'Anda tidak memiliki akses ke halaman ini.');
        }

        return $next($request);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;

class BcksPengisian extends Model
{
    protected $table = 'bcks_pengisians';

    protected $fillable = [
        'nama_bcks',
        'unit_kerja',
        'angkatan_pelatihan',
        'nama_responden',
        'unit_kerja_responden',
        'status_responden',
        'nama_petugas_monev',
        'unit_kerja_petugas',
        'tanggal_evaluasi',
        'total_skor',
        'nilai_akhir',
        'predikat',
        'dampak_implementasi_rptks',
        'kendala_strategi_mitigasi',
        'perubahan_pengambilan_keputusan',
        'dukungan_lingkungan_sekolah',
        'keberlanjutan_program_inovasi',
        'status_pengisian',
        'sekolah_id',
    ];

    protected $casts = [
        'tanggal_evaluasi' => 'date',
        'total_skor' => 'integer',
        'nilai_akhir' => 'decimal:2',
    ];

    /**
     * Relasi ke jawaban setiap indikator BCKS.
     * Otomatis mengambil dari tabel arsip jika tabel baru kosong.
     */
    public function jawaban(): HasMany
    {
        // Cek apakah ada jawaban di tabel baru (format 40 soal)
        if ($this->jawabanBaru()->exists()) {
            return $this->jawabanBaru();
        }

        // Jika kosong, ambil dari tabel arsip lama (format 27 soal)
        return $this->hasMany(BcksJawabanLama::class, 'bcks_pengisian_id');
    }

    /**
     * Relasi asli ke tabel jawaban baru.
     */
    public function jawabanBaru(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(BcksJawaban::class, 'bcks_pengisian_id');
    }

    public function sekolah()
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Sekolah::class);
    }
}

=== FILE: app\Support\BcksInstrumen.php ===
<?php

namespace App\Support;

class BcksInstrumen
{
    public static function levels(): array
    {
        return config('bcks.instrumen.levels', []);
    }

    /** Urutan nama level: indeks 0 = Level 1. */
    public static function levelNames(): array
    {
        return array_keys(self::levels());
    }

    public static function namaLevel(int $level): ?string
    {
        return self::levelNames()[$level - 1] ?? null;
    }

    /** ['Reaction' => 12, 'Learning' => 8, ...] */
    public static function jumlahPerLevel(): array
    {
        return array_map(fn ($l) => count($l['indikator'] ?? []), self::levels());
    }

    /** [1 => 12, 2 => 8, 3 => 12, 4 => 8] */
    public static function jumlahPerLevelAngka(): array
    {
        $jumlah = array_values(self::jumlahPerLevel());

        return array_combine(range(1, count($jumlah)), $jumlah);
    }

    /** Nomor global tersimpan di DB: (level 3, nomor 5) => 20 + 5 = 25 */
    public static function nomorGlobal(int $level, int $nomor): ?int
    {
        $jumlah = self::jumlahPerLevelAngka();

        if (! isset($jumlah[$level]) || $nomor < 1 || $nomor > $jumlah[$level]) {
            return null;
        }

        $offset = 0;
        for ($i = 1; $i < $level; $i++) {
            $offset += $jumlah[$i];
        }

        return $offset + $nomor;
    }

    /** BCKS: semua level. Selain BCKS: Level 3 dan 4. */
    public static function levelAktif(bool $isBcks): array
    {
        $nama = self::levelNames();

        return $isBcks ? $nama : array_slice($nama, 2);
    }

    public static function jumlahIndikator(bool $isBcks): int
    {
        return array_sum(array_intersect_key(
            self::jumlahPerLevel(),
            array_flip(self::levelAktif($isBcks))
        ));
    }

    public static function skorMaksimum(bool $isBcks): int
    {
        return self::jumlahIndikator($isBcks) * 4;
    }

    /** ['Reaction' => 48, 'Learning' => 32, 'Behavior' => 48, 'Results' => 32] */
    public static function levelMaksimum(): array
    {
        return array_map(fn ($n) => $n * 4, self::jumlahPerLevel());
    }
}

=== FILE: app\Support\BkSkor.php ===
<?php

namespace App\Support;

class BkSkor
{
    public static function kategori(float $persen): string
    {
        return match (true) {
            $persen > 85 => 'Sangat Baik',
            $persen > 70 => 'Baik',
            $persen > 55 => 'Cukup',
            default => 'Perlu Pembinaan',
        };
    }

    public static function kelas(?string $kategori): string
    {
        return match ($kategori) {
            'Sangat Baik' => 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700',
            'Baik' => 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700',
            'Cukup' => 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700',
            'Perlu Pembinaan' => 'bg-red-100 text-red-700',
            default => 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600',
        };
    }
}

=== FILE: app\Support\SekolahResolver.php ===
<?php

namespace App\Support;

use App\Models\Sekolah;

class SekolahResolver
{
    /**
     * Cari sekolah berdasarkan nama.
     * Jika belum ditemukan, buat sekolah baru.
     *
     * Metadata yang belum diketahui dibiarkan null.
     */
    public static function resolve(?string $namaSekolah): ?Sekolah
    {
        $namaSekolah = trim((string) $namaSekolah);

        // Abaikan nama kosong atau placeholder.
        if (
            $namaSekolah === '' ||
            in_array(mb_strtolower($namaSekolah), [
                '-',
                'tidak ada',
                'tidak diketahui',
                'n/a',
            ], true)
        ) {
            return null;
        }

        // Rapikan spasi berulang tanpa mengubah nama asli lainnya.
        $namaSekolah = preg_replace('/\s+/u', ' ', $namaSekolah);

        // Gunakan sekolah yang sudah ada jika namanya cocok.
        $sekolah = Sekolah::query()
            ->whereRaw('LOWER(TRIM(nama_sekolah)) = ?', [
                mb_strtolower($namaSekolah),
            ])
            ->first();

        if ($sekolah) {
            return $sekolah;
        }

        // Buat sekolah baru tanpa mengarang metadata.
        return Sekolah::create([
            'nama_sekolah' => $namaSekolah,
            'npsn' => null,
            'jenjang' => null,
            'kabupaten_kota' => null,
            'status_monitoring' => 'Belum Dimonitor',
        ]);
    }
}

    /*
