<?php

use App\Models\User;

return [

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Authentication Defaults
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | This option defines the default authentication "guard" and password
    | reset "broker" for your application. You may change these values
    | as required, but they're a perfect start for most applications.
    |
    */

    'defaults' => [
        'guard' => env('AUTH_GUARD', 'web'),
        'passwords' => env('AUTH_PASSWORD_BROKER', 'users'),
    ],

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Authentication Guards
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | Next, you may define every authentication guard for your application.
    | Of course, a great default configuration has been defined for you
    | which utilizes session storage plus the Eloquent user provider.
    |
    | All authentication guards have a user provider, which defines how the
    | users are actually retrieved out of your database or other storage
    | system used by the application. Typically, Eloquent is utilized.
    |
    | Supported: "session"
    |
    */

    'guards' => [
        'web' => [
            'driver' => 'session',
            'provider' => 'users',
        ],
    ],

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | User Providers
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | All authentication guards have a user provider, which defines how the
    | users are actually retrieved out of your database or other storage
    | system used by the application. Typically, Eloquent is utilized.
    |
    | If you have multiple user tables or models you may configure multiple
    | providers to represent the model / table. These providers may then
    | be assigned to any extra authentication guards you have defined.
    |
    | Supported: "database", "eloquent"
    |
    */

    'providers' => [
        'users' => [
            'driver' => 'eloquent',
            'model' => env('AUTH_MODEL', User::class),
        ],

        // 'users' => [
        //     'driver' => 'database',
        //     'table' => 'users',
        // ],
    ],

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Resetting Passwords
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | These configuration options specify the behavior of Laravel's password
    | reset functionality, including the table utilized for token storage
    | and the user provider that is invoked to actually retrieve users.
    |
    | The expiry time is the number of minutes that each reset token will be
    | considered valid. This security feature keeps tokens short-lived so
    | they have less time to be guessed. You may change this as needed.
    |
    | The throttle setting is the number of seconds a user must wait before
    | generating more password reset tokens. This prevents the user from
    | quickly generating a very large amount of password reset tokens.
    |
    */

    'passwords' => [
        'users' => [
            'provider' => 'users',
            'table' => env('AUTH_PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN_TABLE', 'password_reset_tokens'),
            'expire' => 60,
            'throttle' => 60,
        ],
    ],

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Password Confirmation Timeout
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | Here you may define the number of seconds before a password confirmation
    | window expires and users are asked to re-enter their password via the
    | confirmation screen. By default, the timeout lasts for three hours.
    |
    */

    'password_timeout' => env('AUTH_PASSWORD_TIMEOUT', 10800),

];

<?php

use Illuminate\Support\Str;

return [

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Default Cache Store
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | This option controls the default cache store that will be used by the
    | framework. This connection is utilized if another isn't explicitly
    | specified when running a cache operation inside the application.
    |
    */

    'default' => env('CACHE_STORE', 'database'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Cache Stores
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | Here you may define all of the cache "stores" for your application as
    | well as their drivers. You may even define multiple stores for the
    | same cache driver to group types of items stored in your caches.
    |
    | Supported drivers: "array", "database", "file", "memcached",
    |                    "redis", "dynamodb", "storage", "octane",
    |                    "session", "failover", "null"
    |
    */

    'stores' => [

        'array' => [
            'driver' => 'array',
            'serialize' => false,
        ],

        'database' => [
            'driver' => 'database',
            'connection' => env('DB_CACHE_CONNECTION'),
            'table' => env('DB_CACHE_TABLE', 'cache'),
            'lock_connection' => env('DB_CACHE_LOCK_CONNECTION'),
            'lock_table' => env('DB_CACHE_LOCK_TABLE'),
        ],

        'file' => [
            'driver' => 'file',
            'path' => storage_path('framework/cache/data'),
            'lock_path' => storage_path('framework/cache/data'),
        ],

        'storage' => [
            'driver' => 'storage',
            'disk' => env('CACHE_STORAGE_DISK'),
            'path' => env('CACHE_STORAGE_PATH', 'framework/cache/data'),
        ],

        'memcached' => [
            'driver' => 'memcached',
            'persistent_id' => env('MEMCACHED_PERSISTENT_ID'),
            'sasl' => [
                env('MEMCACHED_USERNAME'),
                env('MEMCACHED_PASSWORD'),
            ],
            'options' => [
                // Memcached::OPT_CONNECT_TIMEOUT => 2000,
            ],
            'servers' => [
                [
                    'host' => env('MEMCACHED_HOST', '127.0.0.1'),
                    'port' => env('MEMCACHED_PORT', 11211),
                    'weight' => 100,
                ],
            ],
        ],

        'redis' => [
            'driver' => 'redis',
            'connection' => env('REDIS_CACHE_CONNECTION', 'cache'),
            'lock_connection' => env('REDIS_CACHE_LOCK_CONNECTION', 'default'),
        ],

        'dynamodb' => [
            'driver' => 'dynamodb',
            'key' => env('AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID'),
            'secret' => env('AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY'),
            'region' => env('AWS_DEFAULT_REGION', 'us-east-1'),
            'table' => env('DYNAMODB_CACHE_TABLE', 'cache'),
            'endpoint' => env('DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT'),
        ],

        'octane' => [
            'driver' => 'octane',
        ],

        'failover' => [
            'driver' => 'failover',
            'stores' => [
                'database',
                'array',
            ],
        ],

    ],

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Cache Key Prefix
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | When utilizing the APC, database, memcached, Redis, and DynamoDB cache
    | stores, there might be other applications using the same cache. For
    | that reason, you may prefix every cache key to avoid collisions.
    |
    */

    'prefix' => env('CACHE_PREFIX', Str::slug((string) env('APP_NAME', 'laravel')).'-cache-'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Serializable Classes
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | This value determines the classes that can be unserialized from cache
    | storage. By default, no PHP classes will be unserialized from your
    | cache to prevent gadget chain attacks if your APP_KEY is leaked.
    |
    */

    'serializable_classes' => false,

];

=== FILE: config\session.php ===
<?php

use Illuminate\Support\Str;

return [

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Default Session Driver
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | This option determines the default session driver that is utilized for
    | incoming requests. Laravel supports a variety of storage options to
    | persist session data. Database storage is a great default choice.
    |
    | Supported: "file", "cookie", "database", "memcached",
    |            "redis", "dynamodb", "array"
    |
    */

    'driver' => env('SESSION_DRIVER', 'database'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Lifetime
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | Here you may specify the number of minutes that you wish the session
    | to be allowed to remain idle before it expires. If you want them
    | to expire immediately when the browser is closed then you may
    | indicate that via the expire_on_close configuration option.
    |
    */

    'lifetime' => (int) env('SESSION_LIFETIME', 120),

    'expire_on_close' => env('SESSION_EXPIRE_ON_CLOSE', false),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Encryption
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | This option allows you to easily specify that all of your session data
    | should be encrypted before it's stored. All encryption is performed
    | automatically by Laravel and you may use the session like normal.
    |
    */

    'encrypt' => env('SESSION_ENCRYPT', false),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session File Location
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | When utilizing the "file" session driver, the session files are placed
    | on disk. The default storage location is defined here; however, you
    | are free to provide another location where they should be stored.
    |
    */

    'files' => storage_path('framework/sessions'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Database Connection
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | When using the "database" or "redis" session drivers, you may specify a
    | connection that should be used to manage these sessions. This should
    | correspond to a connection in your database configuration options.
    |
    */

    'connection' => env('SESSION_CONNECTION'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Database Table
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | When using the "database" session driver, you may specify the table to
    | be used to store sessions. Of course, a sensible default is defined
    | for you; however, you're welcome to change this to another table.
    |
    */

    'table' => env('SESSION_TABLE', 'sessions'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Cache Store
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | When using one of the framework's cache driven session backends, you may
    | define the cache store which should be used to store the session data
    | between requests. This must match one of your defined cache stores.
    |
    | Affects: "dynamodb", "memcached", "redis"
    |
    */

    'store' => env('SESSION_STORE'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Sweeping Lottery
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | Some session drivers must manually sweep their storage location to get
    | rid of old sessions from storage. Here are the chances that it will
    | happen on a given request. By default, the odds are 2 out of 100.
    |
    */

    'lottery' => [2, 100],

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Cookie Name
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | Here you may change the name of the session cookie that is created by
    | the framework. Typically, you should not need to change this value
    | since doing so does not grant a meaningful security improvement.
    |
    */

    'cookie' => env(
        'SESSION_COOKIE',
        Str::slug((string) env('APP_NAME', 'laravel')).'-session'
    ),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Cookie Path
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | The session cookie path determines the path for which the cookie will
    | be regarded as available. Typically, this will be the root path of
    | your application, but you're free to change this when necessary.
    |
    */

    'path' => env('SESSION_PATH', '/'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Cookie Domain
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | This value determines the domain and subdomains the session cookie is
    | available to. By default, the cookie will be available to the root
    | domain without subdomains. Typically, this shouldn't be changed.
    |
    */

    'domain' => env('SESSION_DOMAIN'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | HTTPS Only Cookies
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | By setting this option to true, session cookies will only be sent back
    | to the server if the browser has a HTTPS connection. This will keep
    | the cookie from being sent to you when it can't be done securely.
    |
    */

    'secure' => env('SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | HTTP Access Only
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | Setting this value to true will prevent JavaScript from accessing the
    | value of the cookie and the cookie will only be accessible through
    | the HTTP protocol. It's unlikely you should disable this option.
    |
    */

    'http_only' => env('SESSION_HTTP_ONLY', true),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Same-Site Cookies

=== FILE: database\factories\UserFactory.php ===
<?php

namespace Database\Factories;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\Factory;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

/**
 * @extends Factory<User>
 */
class UserFactory extends Factory
{
    /**
     * The current password being used by the factory.
     */
    protected static ?string $password;

    /**
     * Define the model's default state.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function definition(): array
    {
        return [
            'name' => fake()->name(),
            'email' => fake()->unique()->safeEmail(),
            'email_verified_at' => now(),
            'password' => static::$password ??= Hash::make('password'),
            'remember_token' => Str::random(10),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Indicate that the model's email address should be unverified.
     */
    public function unverified(): static
    {
        return $this->state(fn (array $attributes) => [
            'email_verified_at' => null,
        ]);
    }
}

            Schema::table('bk_submissions', function (Blueprint $table) {
                $table->unsignedSmallInteger('skor_maksimal')->nullable()->after('total_skor');
            });
        }
    }

    public function down(): void
    {
        if (Schema::hasColumn('bk_answers', 'skor')) {
            Schema::table('bk_answers', function (Blueprint $table) {
                $table->dropColumn('skor');
            });
        }

        if (Schema::hasColumn('bk_submissions', 'skor_maksimal')) {
            Schema::table('bk_submissions', function (Blueprint $table) {
                $table->dropColumn('skor_maksimal');
            });
        }

        if (Schema::hasColumn('bk_submissions', 'total_skor')) {
            Schema::table('bk_submissions', function (Blueprint $table) {
                $table->dropColumn('total_skor');
            });
        }
    }
};

                    3 => 'Siswa merasa dihargai dan diterima apa adanya sehingga mereka lebih percaya diri.',

                    2 => 'Metode pembelajaran yang digunakan guru (misalnya diskusi, proyek, atau media digital) membuat siswa lebih tertarik untuk belajar.',
                    3 => 'Guru memberikan kesempatan kepada siswa untuk bertanya atau mengungkapkan pendapat selama pembelajaran.',
                ]],
                'F' => ['Pembimbingan', [
                    1 => 'Guru memberikan bimbingan yang jelas tentang cara meningkatkan prestasi akademik atau keterampilan sosial siswa.',
                    2 => 'Siswa merasa nyaman untuk curhat atau meminta nasihat kepada guru tanpa takut dihakimi.',
                    3 => 'Guru membantu siswa mengenali potensi diri dan merencanakan langkah-langkah untuk mencapainya.',
                ]],
            ]],
        ];

        $questions = [];
        $urutan = 0;

        foreach ($struktur as $level => $lv) {
            foreach ($lv['bagian'] as $kode => [$judul, $butir]) {
                foreach ($butir as $nomor => $teks) {
                    $questions[] = [
                        'level' => $level,
                        'level_nama' => $lv['nama'],
                        'bagian' => $kode,
                        'judul_bagian' => $judul,
                        'nomor' => $nomor,
                        'pernyataan' => $teks,
                        'urutan' => ++$urutan,
                    ];
                }
            }
        }

        DB::transaction(function () use ($questions): void {
            // Nonaktifkan daftar lama; riwayat jawaban lama tetap tersimpan.
            BKQuestion::query()->update(['aktif' => false]);

            foreach ($questions as $question) {
                $existing = BKQuestion::query()
                    ->where('level', $question['level'])
                    ->where('bagian', $question['bagian'])
                    ->where('nomor', $question['nomor'])
                    ->where('pernyataan', $question['pernyataan'])
                    ->first();

                if ($existing) {
                    $existing->update(array_merge($question, ['aktif' => true]));
                } else {
                    BKQuestion::create(array_merge($question, ['aktif' => true]));
                }
            }
        });
    }
}

    {{-- =====================================================
    TOGGLE PASSWORD
    ====================================================== --}}
    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {

            const togglePassword = document.getElementById('toggle-password');
            const password = document.getElementById('password');
            const eyeOpen = document.getElementById('eye-open');
            const eyeClosed = document.getElementById('eye-closed');

            if (togglePassword && password) {

                togglePassword.addEventListener('click', function () {

                    const isPassword = password.type === 'password';

                    password.type = isPassword ? 'text' : 'password';

                    eyeOpen.classList.toggle('hidden', isPassword);
                    eyeClosed.classList.toggle('hidden', !isPassword);

                    togglePassword.setAttribute(
                        'aria-label',
                        isPassword
                            ? 'Sembunyikan NIP'

        $totalSkorAktual = (int) $jawabanBerlaku->sum('skor');

            ? round(($totalSkorAktual / $skorMaksimum) * 100, 2)

        <script>
            document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
                const statusSelect = document.getElementById('status_responden');

                const progressBar = document.getElementById('bcks-progress-bar');
                const progressPercent = document.getElementById('bcks-progress-percent');
                const progressText = document.getElementById('bcks-progress-text');
                const scoreText = document.getElementById('bcks-score-text');

                const levelCards = document.querySelectorAll('[data-bcks-level]');

                function updateBcksForm() {
                    const status = statusSelect.value;
                    const isBcks = status === 'BCKS';

                    let totalIndikator = 0;
                    let jumlahDiisi = 0;
                    let totalSkor = 0;

                    levelCards.forEach(function (card) {
                        const level = Number(card.dataset.bcksLevel);

                        const aktif = isBcks || level >= 3;

                        card.hidden = !aktif;

                        const radios = card.querySelectorAll(
                            'input[type="radio"][name^="skor["]'
                        );

                        radios.forEach(function (radio) {
                            radio.disabled = !aktif;

                            if (!aktif) {
                                radio.checked = false;
                            }
                        });

                        if (aktif) {
                            const indikatorUnik = new Set();

                            radios.forEach(function (radio) {
                                indikatorUnik.add(radio.name);
                            });

                            totalIndikator += indikatorUnik.size;
                        }
                    });

                    const checked = document.querySelectorAll(
                        'input[type="radio"][name^="skor["]:checked:not(:disabled)'
                    );

                    checked.forEach(function (radio) {
                        jumlahDiisi++;
                        totalSkor += Number(radio.value);
                    });

                    const persen = totalIndikator > 0
                        ? Math.round((jumlahDiisi / totalIndikator) * 100)
                        : 0;

                    if (progressBar) {
                        progressBar.style.width = persen + '%';
                    }

                    if (progressPercent) {
                        progressPercent.textContent = persen + '%';
                    }

                    if (progressText) {
                        progressText.textContent =
                            jumlahDiisi + ' / ' + totalIndikator + ' butir';
                    }

                    if (scoreText) {
                        if (jumlahDiisi === 0) {
                            scoreText.textContent = 'Belum ada penilaian';
                        } else {
                            scoreText.textContent =
                                totalSkor + ' / ' + (totalIndikator * 4) + ' poin';
                        }
                    }
                }

                statusSelect.addEventListener('change', updateBcksForm);

                document.querySelectorAll(
                    'input[type="radio"][name^="skor["]'
                ).forEach(function (radio) {
                    radio.addEventListener('change', updateBcksForm);
                });

                updateBcksForm();
            });
        </script>

@endsection

                <script>
                    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
                        const statusSelect = document.getElementById('status_responden');

                        const progressBar = document.getElementById('bcks-progress-bar');
                        const progressPercent = document.getElementById('bcks-progress-percent');
                        const progressText = document.getElementById('bcks-progress-text');
                        const scoreText = document.getElementById('bcks-score-text');

                        const levelCards = document.querySelectorAll('[data-bcks-level]');

                        function updateBcksForm() {
                            const status = statusSelect.value;
                            const isBcks = status === 'BCKS';

                            let totalIndikator = 0;
                            let jumlahDiisi = 0;
                            let totalSkor = 0;

                            levelCards.forEach(function (card) {
                                const level = Number(card.dataset.bcksLevel);

                                const aktif = isBcks || level >= 3;

                                card.hidden = !aktif;

                                const radios = card.querySelectorAll(
                                    'input[type="radio"][name^="skor["]'
                                );

                                radios.forEach(function (radio) {
                                    radio.disabled = !aktif;

                                    // Centang lama sengaja tidak dihapus saat level hanya disembunyikan
                                });

                                if (aktif) {
                                    const indikatorUnik = new Set();

                                    radios.forEach(function (radio) {
                                        indikatorUnik.add(radio.name);
                                    });

                                    totalIndikator += indikatorUnik.size;
                                }
                            });

                            const checked = document.querySelectorAll(
                                'input[type="radio"][name^="skor["]:checked:not(:disabled)'
                            );

                            checked.forEach(function (radio) {
                                jumlahDiisi++;
                                totalSkor += Number(radio.value);
                            });

                            const persen = totalIndikator > 0
                                ? Math.round((jumlahDiisi / totalIndikator) * 100)
                                : 0;

                            if (progressBar) {
                                progressBar.style.width = persen + '%';
                            }

                            if (progressPercent) {
                                progressPercent.textContent = persen + '%';
                            }

                            if (progressText) {
                                progressText.textContent =
                                    jumlahDiisi + ' / ' + totalIndikator + ' butir';
                            }

                            if (scoreText) {
                                if (jumlahDiisi === 0) {
                                    scoreText.textContent = 'Belum ada penilaian';
                                } else {
                                    scoreText.textContent =
                                        totalSkor + ' / ' + (totalIndikator * 4) + ' poin';
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        statusSelect.addEventListener('change', updateBcksForm);

                        document.querySelectorAll(
                            'input[type="radio"][name^="skor["]'
                        ).forEach(function (radio) {
                            radio.addEventListener('change', updateBcksForm);
                        });

                        // Panggil saat halaman pertama kali dimuat
                        updateBcksForm();
                    });
                </script>

    @endsection

    @php
        /*
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        | Konfigurasi instrumen
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------

        $levelsConfig = config('bcks.instrumen.levels', []);

        $levelConfig = [
            'Reaction' => [
                'label' => 'Level 1 - Reaction',
                'deskripsi' => 'Reaksi peserta terhadap pelaksanaan pelatihan.',
                'badge' => 'background:#dbeafe;color:#1d4ed8',
                'bar' => '#2563eb',
            ],
            'Learning' => [
                'label' => 'Level 2 - Learning',
                'deskripsi' => 'Perubahan pemahaman dan kesiapan peserta setelah pelatihan.',
                'badge' => 'background:#ede9fe;color:#6d28d9',
                'bar' => '#7c3aed',
            ],
            'Behavior' => [
                'label' => 'Level 3 - Behavior',
                'deskripsi' => 'Perubahan perilaku dan penerapan hasil pelatihan di sekolah.',
                'badge' => 'background:#d1fae5;color:#047857',
                'bar' => '#059669',
            ],
            'Results' => [
                'label' => 'Level 4 - Results',
                'deskripsi' => 'Dampak penerapan hasil pelatihan terhadap sekolah.',
                'badge' => 'background:#fef3c7;color:#b45309',
                'bar' => '#d99a0b',
            ],
        ];

        /*
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        | Filter indikator berdasarkan status responden
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        */

        $statusResponden = $bcksPengisian->status_responden ?? '';
        $isBcks = $statusResponden === 'BCKS';

        $levelAktif = $isBcks
            ? ['Reaction', 'Learning', 'Behavior', 'Results']
            : ['Behavior', 'Results'];

        /*
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        | Ambil jawaban yang berlaku (Deteksi Data Lama vs Baru)
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        */

        $jawabanSemua = $bcksPengisian->jawaban ?? collect();
        // Jika data lama, nomor indikator maksimalnya 27. Jika baru, maksimalnya 40.
        $isDataLama = $jawabanSemua->isNotEmpty() && $jawabanSemua->max('nomor_indikator') <= 27;

        $jawaban = $jawabanSemua
            ->filter(function ($item) use ($levelAktif) {
                return in_array($item->level, $levelAktif, true);
            })
            ->values();

        /*
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        | Bangun daftar indikator yang ditampilkan
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        */

        $indikatorConfig = [];
        $nomorUrut = 0;

        foreach ($levelsConfig as $level => $levelData) {
            foreach ($levelData['indikator'] ?? [] as $indikator) {
                $nomorUrut++;

                if (!in_array($level, $levelAktif, true)) {
                    continue;
                }

                $indikatorConfig[] = [
                    'nomor' => $nomorUrut,
                    'kode' => $indikator['kode'] ?? '',
                    'pertanyaan' => $indikator['pertanyaan'] ?? '-',
                    'level' => $level,
                ];
            }
        }

        /*
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        | PERBAIKAN: Perhitungan skor mengambil dari Controller (Data Arsip)
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        */
        
        $totalSkorAktual = $bcksPengisian->total_skor;
        $nilaiAkhirAktual = $bcksPengisian->nilai_akhir;

        $jumlahIndikatorBerlaku = $bcksPengisian->jawaban->count();
        $skorMaksimum = $jumlahIndikatorBerlaku * 4;

        if ($skorMaksimum == 0) {
            $jumlahIndikatorBerlaku = \App\Support\BcksInstrumen::jumlahIndikator($isBcks);
            $skorMaksimum = \App\Support\BcksInstrumen::skorMaksimum($isBcks);
        }

        /*
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        | Pemetaan jawaban berdasarkan nomor indikator global
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        */

        $jawabanByNomor = $jawaban->keyBy(
            fn($item) => (string) $item->nomor_indikator
        );

        $jawabanByKode = $jawaban->keyBy(
            fn($item) => (string) $item->nomor_indikator
        );

        /*
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        | Rekap skor per level
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        */

        $levelScores = array_fill_keys(array_keys($levelConfig), 0);
        $levelCounts = array_fill_keys(array_keys($levelConfig), 0);

        foreach ($jawaban as $item) {
            $level = $item->level;

            if (array_key_exists($level, $levelScores)) {
                $levelScores[$level] += (int) $item->skor;
                $levelCounts[$level]++;
            }
        }

        /*
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        | Predikat
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        */

        $predikat = $bcksPengisian->predikat ?: '-';

        $predikatStyle = match ($predikat) {
            'Sangat Baik' => 'background:#d1fae5;color:#047857',
            'Baik' => 'background:#dbeafe;color:#1d4ed8',
            'Cukup' => 'background:#fef3c7;color:#b45309',
            '-' => 'background:#f1f5f9;color:#475569',
            default => 'background:#ffe4e6;color:#be123c',
        };

    @php
        $levelNames = [
            1 => 'Reaction',
            2 => 'Learning',
            3 => 'Behavior',
            4 => 'Results',
        ];

        $isBK = $submission->jabatan_responden === 'BK';
        $allowedLevels = $isBK ? [1, 2, 3, 4] : [3, 4];

        // ---------------------------------------------------------
        // (a) Jawaban + perhitungan skor baru
        // ---------------------------------------------------------
        $answers = $submission->answers
            ->filter(fn($a) => $a->question)
            ->filter(fn($a) => in_array((int) $a->question->level, $allowedLevels, true))
            ->sortBy(fn($a) => [(int) $a->question->level, $a->question->urutan ?? $a->question->nomor])
            ->values();

        $answersByLevel = $answers->groupBy(fn($a) => (int) $a->question->level)->sortKeys();

        $jumlahSoal = $answers->count();
        $totalSkor = (int) $answers->sum('skor');
        $skorMaks = $jumlahSoal * 4;
        $skorPersen = $skorMaks > 0 ? round(($totalSkor / $skorMaks) * 100, 2) : 0;
        $kategori = \App\Support\BkSkor::kategori($skorPersen);

        $levelStats = [];
        foreach ($allowedLevels as $lv) {
            $items = $answers->filter(fn($a) => (int) $a->question->level === $lv);
            $max = $items->count() * 4;
            $skor = (int) $items->sum('skor');

            $levelStats[$lv] = [
                'skor' => $skor,
                'max' => $max,
                'pct' => $max > 0 ? round(($skor / $max) * 100, 2) : 0,
            ];
        }
    @endphp

    {{-- ================= JAVASCRIPT ================= --}}
    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            const form = document.getElementById('bkForm');
            const jabatanSelect = document.getElementById('jabatan_responden');

            const questions = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.question-item'));
            const levelHeaders = document.querySelectorAll('.level-header');
            const bagianHeaders = document.querySelectorAll('.bagian-header');

            const answeredCount = document.getElementById('answeredCount');
            const progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            const progressPercent = document.getElementById('progressPercent');
            const jawabanSummary = document.getElementById('jawabanSummary');
            const submitButton = document.getElementById('submitButton');

            function getAllowedLevels() {
                const jabatan = jabatanSelect.value;

                // BK mengisi Level 1-4, jabatan lain hanya Level 3-4.
                if (jabatan !== '' && jabatan !== 'BK') {
                    return [3, 4];
                }

                return [1, 2, 3, 4];
            }

            function updateVisibleLevels() {
                const allowedLevels = getAllowedLevels();
                const allowed = el => allowedLevels.includes(Number(el.dataset.level));

                levelHeaders.forEach(row => { row.hidden = !allowed(row); });
                bagianHeaders.forEach(row => { row.hidden = !allowed(row); });

                questions.forEach(function (row) {
                    const visible = allowed(row);
                    row.hidden = !visible;

                    row.querySelectorAll('input[type="radio"]').forEach(function (radio) {
                        radio.disabled = !visible;
                    });
                });

                updateProgress();
            }

            function updateProgress() {
                let answered = 0;
                let totalSkor = 0;

                const visibleQuestions = questions.filter(q => !q.hidden);

                visibleQuestions.forEach(function (question) {
                    const checked = question.querySelector('input[type="radio"]:checked');

                    if (checked) {
                        answered++;
                        totalSkor += Number(checked.value);
                    }
                });

                const total = visibleQuestions.length;
                const percentage = total > 0 ? Math.round((answered / total) * 100) : 0;

                answeredCount.textContent = answered;

                const totalLabel = answeredCount.parentElement;
                if (totalLabel) {
                    Array.from(totalLabel.childNodes).forEach(function (node) {
                        if (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE && node.textContent.includes('/ ')) {
                            node.textContent = ' / ' + total + ' butir';
                        }
                    });
                }

                progressBar.style.width = percentage + '%';
                progressPercent.textContent = percentage + '%';

                jawabanSummary.textContent = answered > 0
                    ? totalSkor + ' / ' + (total * 4) + ' poin'
                    : 'Belum ada jawaban';
            }

            form.addEventListener('change', function (event) {
                if (event.target.matches('input[type="radio"]') || event.target === jabatanSelect) {
                    updateVisibleLevels();
                }
            });

            form.addEventListener('submit', function (event) {
                updateVisibleLevels();

                if (!jabatanSelect.value) {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    alert('Silakan pilih jabatan responden terlebih dahulu.');
                    jabatanSelect.focus();
                    return;
                }

                const unanswered = questions.filter(function (question) {
                    return !question.hidden && !question.querySelector('input[type="radio"]:checked');
                });

                if (unanswered.length > 0) {
                    event.preventDefault();

                    const first = unanswered[0];
                    first.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
                    first.style.background = '#fff1f2';
                    setTimeout(function () { first.style.background = ''; }, 2500);

                    alert('Masih ada ' + unanswered.length + ' pernyataan yang belum dijawab.');
                    return;
                }

                submitButton.disabled = true;
                submitButton.lastChild.textContent = ' Menyimpan...';
            });

            updateVisibleLevels();
        });
    </script>

@endsection

    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            const form = document.getElementById('bkEditForm');
            const jabatanSelect = document.getElementById('jabatan_responden');

            const questions = Array.from(
                document.querySelectorAll('.question-item')
            );

            const levelHeaders = document.querySelectorAll('.level-header');
            const bagianHeaders = document.querySelectorAll('.bagian-header');

            const answeredCount = document.getElementById('answeredCount');
            const progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            const progressPercent = document.getElementById('progressPercent');
            const jawabanSummary = document.getElementById('jawabanSummary');
            const submitButton = document.getElementById('submitButton');

            function getAllowedLevels() {
                const jabatan = jabatanSelect.value;

                if (jabatan === 'BK') {
                    return [1, 2, 3, 4];
                }

                if (jabatan !== '') {
                    return [3, 4];
                }

                // Sebelum jabatan dipilih, pertahankan tampilan awal.
                return [1, 2, 3, 4];
            }

            function updateVisibleLevels() {
                const allowedLevels = getAllowedLevels();

                function levelIsAllowed(element) {
                    return allowedLevels.includes(
                        Number(element.dataset.level)
                    );
                }

                levelHeaders.forEach(function (row) {
                    row.hidden = !levelIsAllowed(row);
                });

                bagianHeaders.forEach(function (row) {
                    row.hidden = !levelIsAllowed(row);
                });

                questions.forEach(function (row) {
                    const visible = levelIsAllowed(row);
                    row.hidden = !visible;

                    row.querySelectorAll('input[type="radio"]').forEach(function (radio) {
                        radio.disabled = !visible;
                    });
                });

                updateProgress();
            }

            function updateProgress() {
                let answered = 0;
                let totalSkor = 0;

                const visibleQuestions = questions.filter(function (question) {
                    return !question.hidden;
                });

                visibleQuestions.forEach(function (question) {
                    const checked = question.querySelector('input[type="radio"]:checked');

                    if (checked) {
                        answered++;
                        totalSkor += Number(checked.value);
                    }
                });

                const total = visibleQuestions.length;
                const percentage = total > 0 ? Math.round((answered / total) * 100) : 0;

                answeredCount.textContent = answered;

                const totalLabel = answeredCount.parentElement;
                if (totalLabel) {
                    Array.from(totalLabel.childNodes).forEach(function (node) {
                        if (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE && node.textContent.includes('/ ')) {
                            node.textContent = ' / ' + total + ' butir';
                        }
                    });
                }

                progressBar.style.width = percentage + '%';
                progressPercent.textContent = percentage + '%';

                jawabanSummary.textContent = answered > 0
                    ? totalSkor + ' / ' + (total * 4) + ' poin'
                    : 'Belum ada jawaban';
            }

            form.addEventListener('change', function (event) {
                if (
                    event.target.matches('input[type="radio"]') ||
                    event.target === jabatanSelect
                ) {
                    updateVisibleLevels();
                }
            });

            jabatanSelect.addEventListener('change', updateVisibleLevels);

            form.addEventListener('submit', function (event) {
                updateVisibleLevels();

                const unanswered = questions.filter(function (question) {
                    if (question.hidden) {
                        return false;
                    }

                    return !question.querySelector(
                        'input[type="radio"]:checked'
                    );
                });

                if (!jabatanSelect.value) {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    alert('Silakan pilih jabatan responden terlebih dahulu.');
                    jabatanSelect.focus();
                    return;
                }

                if (unanswered.length > 0) {
                    event.preventDefault();

                    const firstQuestion = unanswered[0];

                    firstQuestion.scrollIntoView({
                        behavior: 'smooth',
                        block: 'center'
                    });

                    firstQuestion.classList.add('bg-red-50');

                    setTimeout(function () {
                        firstQuestion.classList.remove('bg-red-50');
                    }, 2500);

                    alert(
                        'Masih ada ' +
                        unanswered.length +
                        ' pernyataan yang belum dijawab.'
                    );

                    return;
                }

                submitButton.disabled = true;
                submitButton.textContent = 'Menyimpan...';
            });

            updateVisibleLevels();
        });
    </script>

@endsection

    @php
        /* ---------- DATA TURUNAN (dihitung sekali di sini) ---------- */
        $levelNames = [1 => 'Reaction', 2 => 'Learning', 3 => 'Behavior', 4 => 'Results'];

        $levelDescriptions = [
            1 => 'Reaksi peserta terhadap pelaksanaan kegiatan.',
            2 => 'Pembelajaran dan kompetensi yang diperoleh peserta.',
            3 => 'Perubahan perilaku setelah kegiatan.',
            4 => 'Dampak atau hasil dari pelaksanaan kegiatan.',
        ];

        // Warna per level (sama dengan halaman detail BCKS)
        $levelStyles = [
            1 => ['bar' => '#2563eb', 'badge' => 'background:#dbeafe;color:#1d4ed8', 'row' => '#eff4ff'],
            2 => ['bar' => '#7c3aed', 'badge' => 'background:#ede9fe;color:#6d28d9', 'row' => '#f5f1ff'],
            3 => ['bar' => '#059669', 'badge' => 'background:#d1fae5;color:#047857', 'row' => '#eefaf4'],
            4 => ['bar' => '#d99a0b', 'badge' => 'background:#fef3c7;color:#b45309', 'row' => '#fffaea'],
        ];

        $jabatanResponden = $submission->jabatan_responden;

        if ($jabatanResponden === 'Lainnya' && filled($submission->jabatan_lainnya)) {
            $jabatanResponden .= ' - ' . $submission->jabatan_lainnya;
        }

        $isBK = $submission->jabatan_responden === 'BK';
        $allowedLevels = $isBK ? [1, 2, 3, 4] : [3, 4];

        // ---------------------------------------------------------
        // (a) Jawaban + perhitungan skor baru
        // ---------------------------------------------------------
        $answers = $submission->answers
            ->filter(fn($a) => $a->question && in_array((int) $a->question->level, $allowedLevels, true))
            ->values();

        $scored = $answers->filter(fn($a) => $a->skor !== null);
        $adaSkor = $scored->isNotEmpty();

        $levelStats = [];
        foreach ($levelNames as $level => $name) {
            if (!in_array($level, $allowedLevels, true)) {
                continue;
            }

            $items = $scored->filter(fn($a) => (int) $a->question->level === $level);
            $max = $items->count() * 4;
            $skor = (int) $items->sum('skor');

            $levelStats[$level] = [
                'skor' => $skor,
                'max' => $max,
                'pct' => $max > 0 ? round(($skor / $max) * 100, 2) : 0,
            ];
        }

        $jumlahButirBk = $answers->count();
        $jumlahTerisiBk = $scored->count();
        $totalSkor = (int) $scored->sum('skor');
        $skorMaks = $jumlahButirBk * 4;
        $skorPersen = $skorMaks > 0 ? round(($totalSkor / $skorMaks) * 100, 2) : 0;

        $kategori = \App\Support\BkSkor::kategori($skorPersen);
        $kategoriClass = \App\Support\BkSkor::kelas($kategori);

        $statusPengisianLabel = $submission->status ?: 'Selesai';
        $statusSelesai = $statusPengisianLabel === 'Selesai';

        $statusStyle = $statusSelesai
            ? 'background:#d1fae5;color:#047857'
            : 'background:#fef3c7;color:#b45309';

    <script>
        const DOCS = @json($htmls, JSON_HEX_TAG | JSON_HEX_AMP | JSON_HEX_APOS | JSON_HEX_QUOT | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
        const container = document.getElementById('docs');

        DOCS.forEach(function (html) {
            const parsed = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html');

            // Buang toolbar bawaan tiap lembar cetak.
            parsed.querySelectorAll('.no-print').forEach(el => el.remove());

            let css = '';
            parsed.querySelectorAll('style').forEach(s => css += s.textContent + '\n');

            // Di dalam shadow root, selector html/body diganti :host.
            css = css.replace(/html\s*,\s*body/g, ':host').replace(/\bbody\b/g, ':host');

            const host = document.createElement('div');
            host.className = 'doc-host';
            const root = host.attachShadow({ mode: 'open' });

            const style = document.createElement('style');
            style.textContent = ':host{display:block;}\n' + css;
            root.appendChild(style);

            const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
            const main = parsed.querySelector('main');
            wrapper.innerHTML = main ? main.outerHTML : parsed.body.innerHTML;
            root.appendChild(wrapper);

            container.appendChild(host);
        });
    </script>
</body>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const cari = document.getElementById('cari');
    const filterJenis = document.getElementById('filter-jenis');
    const jumlah = document.getElementById('jumlah');
    const tombol = document.getElementById('btn-gabung');
    const baris = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-baris]')];
    const kotak = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('input[name="pilih[]"]')];

    function hitung() {
        const n = kotak().filter(c => c.checked).length;
        jumlah.textContent = n;
        tombol.disabled = n === 0;
    }

    function saring() {
        const q = cari.value.trim().toLowerCase();
        const j = filterJenis.value;
        baris.forEach(tr => {
            const cocok = (!q || tr.dataset.teks.includes(q)) && (!j || tr.dataset.jenis === j);
            tr.hidden = !cocok;
        });
    }

    cari.addEventListener('input', saring);
    filterJenis.addEventListener('change', saring);

    baris.forEach(tr => tr.addEventListener('click', e => {
        if (e.target.tagName === 'INPUT') return;
        const c = tr.querySelector('input[type="checkbox    "]');
        c.checked = !c.checked;
        hitung();
    }));

    document.querySelectorAll('[data-pilih-semua]').forEach(master => {
        master.addEventListener('change', () => {
            master.closest('[data-seksi]').querySelectorAll('[data-baris]:not([hidden]) input[name="pilih[]"]')
                .forEach(c => c.checked = master.checked);
            hitung();
        });
    });

    document.addEventListener('change', e => {
        if (e.target.matches('input[name="pilih[]"]')) hitung();
    });

    hitung();
});
</script>

    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            const D = @json($chart);

            const FONT = "'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif";
            Chart.defaults.font.family = FONT;
            Chart.defaults.color = '#64748b';
            Chart.defaults.plugins.tooltip.backgroundColor = '#0f1b3d';
            Chart.defaults.plugins.tooltip.cornerRadius = 10;
            Chart.defaults.plugins.tooltip.padding = 10;

            const grid = { color: '#eef2f7' };
            const legendBawah = {
                position: 'bottom',
                labels: { usePointStyle: true, pointStyle: 'circle', padding: 16, font: { size: 12 } }
            };
            const buat = (id, config) => {
                const el = document.getElementById(id);
                if (el) new Chart(el, config);
            };

            // Angka di atas batang (seperti pada desain)
            const angkaBatang = {
                id: 'angkaBatang',
                afterDatasetsDraw(chart) {
                    const { ctx } = chart;
                    ctx.save();
                    ctx.font = '600 11px ' + FONT;
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#475569';
                    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                    chart.data.datasets.forEach((ds, i) => {
                        chart.getDatasetMeta(i).data.forEach((bar, j) => {
                            const v = ds.data[j];
                            if (v !== null && v !== undefined) ctx.fillText(v, bar.x, bar.y - 6);
                        });
                    });
                    ctx.restore();
                }
            };

            // Tren (grafik garis dengan area, titik berlubang putih)
            buat('trenChart', {
                type: 'line',
                data: {
                    labels: D.bulan,
                    datasets: [
                        {
                            label: 'Instrumen',
                            data: D.trenInstrumen,
                            borderColor: '#2563eb',
                            backgroundColor: 'rgba(37, 99, 235, .14)',
                            fill: true,
                            tension: 0.4,
                            borderWidth: 3,
                            pointRadius: 4,
                            pointHoverRadius: 6,
                            pointBackgroundColor: '#fff',
                            pointBorderColor: '#2563eb',
                            pointBorderWidth: 2
                        },
                        {
                            label: 'Wawancara',
                            data: D.trenWawancara,
                            borderColor: '#10b981',
                            backgroundColor: 'rgba(16, 185, 129, .14)',
                            fill: true,
                            tension: 0.4,
                            borderWidth: 3,
                            pointRadius: 4,
                            pointHoverRadius: 6,
                            pointBackgroundColor: '#fff',
                            pointBorderColor: '#10b981',
                            pointBorderWidth: 2
                        }
                    ]
                },
                options: {
                    responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    interaction: { mode: 'index', intersect: false },
                    plugins: {
                        legend: {
                            position: 'top',
                            align: 'end',
                            labels: {
                                usePointStyle: true,
                                pointStyle: 'circle',
                                padding: 14,
                                font: { size: 12 },
                                generateLabels(chart) {
                                    return chart.data.datasets.map((ds, i) => ({
                                        text: ds.label,
                                        fillStyle: '#fff',
                                        strokeStyle: ds.borderColor,
                                        lineWidth: 2,
                                        pointStyle: 'circle',
                                        hidden: !chart.isDatasetVisible(i),
                                        datasetIndex: i,
                                        fontColor: '#64748b'
                                    }));
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    },
                    scales: {
                        y: { beginAtZero: true, grace: '6%', ticks: { precision: 0, stepSize: 2 }, grid },
                        x: { grid: { display: false } }
                    }
                }
            });

            // Komposisi instrumen
            buat('komposisiChart', {
                type: 'doughnut',
                data: { labels: D.jenis, datasets: [{ data: D.instrumen, backgroundColor: D.warna, borderWidth: 3, borderColor: '#fff', hoverOffset: 6 }] },
                options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, cutout: '70%', plugins: { legend: legendBawah } }
            });

            // Capaian per instrumen
            buat('capaianChart', {
                type: 'bar',
                data: { labels: D.jenis, datasets: [{ data: D.capaian, backgroundColor: D.warna, borderRadius: 8, borderSkipped: false, barThickness: 18 }] },
                options: {
                    indexAxis: 'y', responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    plugins: { legend: { display: false }, tooltip: { callbacks: { label: c => c.raw === null ? 'Belum ada data' : c.raw + '%' } } },
                    scales: { x: { min: 0, max: 100, ticks: { callback: v => v + '%' }, grid }, y: { grid: { display: false } } }
                }
            });

            // Wawancara per jenis
            buat('wawancaraChart', {
                type: 'bar',
                data: { labels: D.jenis, datasets: [{ data: D.wawancara, backgroundColor: D.warna, borderRadius: 8, borderSkipped: false, maxBarThickness: 34 }] },
                options: {
                    responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    plugins: { legend: { display: false } },
                    scales: { y: { beginAtZero: true, grace: '14%', ticks: { precision: 0 }, grid }, x: { grid: { display: false }, ticks: { font: { size: 11 } } } }
                },
                plugins: [angkaBatang]
            });

            // Tindak lanjut
            buat('tlChart', {
                type: 'doughnut',
                data: { labels: ['Belum Dimulai', 'Dalam Proses', 'Selesai'], datasets: [{ data: D.tl, backgroundColor: ['#cbd5e1', '#3b82f6', '#10b981'], borderWidth: 3, borderColor: '#fff', hoverOffset: 6 }] },
                options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, cutout: '70%', plugins: { legend: legendBawah } }
            });
        });

    @php
        $jabatan = $gembira->jabatan_penilai ?? '';

        $levelAktif = $jabatan === 'Peserta Matematika GEMBIRA'
            ? [1, 2, 3, 4]
            : [3, 4];

        /*
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        | Ambil data instrumen dari create.blade.php
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        | Dengan cara ini tidak perlu membuat file JSON terpisah.
        */
        $halamanForm = file_get_contents(resource_path('views/gembira/create.blade.php'));

        $levelData = [];
        if (
            preg_match(
                '~\$levelData\s*=\s*json_decode\(<<<\'GEMBIRA_JSON\'\s*(.*?)\s*GEMBIRA_JSON,\s*true\s*\);~s',
                $halamanForm,
                $cocok
            )
        ) {
            $levelData = json_decode(trim($cocok[1]), true) ?? [];
        }

        if (empty($levelData)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException(
                'Data instrumen tidak ditemukan. Pastikan create.blade.php memiliki blok GEMBIRA_JSON.'
            );
        }

        $levelJawaban = [
            1 => $gembira->level_1_jawaban ?? [],
            2 => $gembira->level_2_jawaban ?? [],
            3 => $gembira->level_3_jawaban ?? [],
            4 => $gembira->level_4_jawaban ?? [],
        ];

        $levelJudul = [
            1 => 'Level 1 â€” Reaction',
            2 => 'Level 2 â€” Learning',
            3 => 'Level 3 â€” Behavior',
            4 => 'Level 4 â€” Results',
        ];

        // Keterangan singkat default
        $levelDeskripsi = [
            1 => 'Reaksi peserta terhadap pelaksanaan pelatihan.',
            2 => 'Pembelajaran dan pemahaman setelah pelatihan.',
            3 => 'Penerapan hasil pelatihan dalam pekerjaan.',
            4 => 'Hasil dan dampak penerapan di sekolah.',
        ];

        // Keterangan tambahan / petunjuk penilaian per level dari instrumen
        $levelCatatan = [];

        foreach ($levelJudul as $lv => $teks) {
            $judulPanjang = $levelData[(string) $lv]['label'] ?? '';

            // Bagian setelah titik dua pada judul instrumen dipakai sebagai keterangan level
            if (str_contains($judulPanjang, ': ')) {
                $levelDeskripsi[$lv] = \Illuminate\Support\Str::after($judulPanjang, ': ');
            }

            $levelCatatan[$lv] = trim($levelData[(string) $lv]['deskripsi'] ?? '');
        }

        $totalSkor = 0;
        $totalMaksimum = 0;
        $jumlahIndikatorDinilai = 0;
        $rekapLevel = [];

        foreach ($levelAktif as $nomorLevel) {
            $skorLevel = 0;
            $jumlahDinilai = 0;
            $jumlahTD = 0;

            foreach ($levelJawaban[$nomorLevel] as $item) {
                $skor = is_array($item)
                    ? ($item['skor'] ?? $item['jawaban'] ?? null)
                    : $item;

                if ($nomorLevel === 3 && (string) $skor === 'TD') {
                    $jumlahTD++;
                    continue;
                }

                if (is_numeric($skor) && (int) $skor >= 1 && (int) $skor <= 4) {
                    $skorLevel += (int) $skor;
                    $jumlahDinilai++;
                }
            }

            $maksimumLevel = $jumlahDinilai * 4;

            $rekapLevel[$nomorLevel] = [
                'skor' => $skorLevel,
                'maksimum' => $maksimumLevel,
                'jumlah' => $jumlahDinilai,
                'td' => $jumlahTD,
                'persentase' => $maksimumLevel > 0
                    ? ($skorLevel / $maksimumLevel) * 100
                    : 0,
            ];

            $totalSkor += $skorLevel;
            $totalMaksimum += $maksimumLevel;
            $jumlahIndikatorDinilai += $jumlahDinilai;
        }

        $nilaiAkhir = $totalMaksimum > 0
            ? ($totalSkor / $totalMaksimum) * 100
            : 0;

        $rataRata = $jumlahIndikatorDinilai > 0
            ? $totalSkor / $jumlahIndikatorDinilai
            : 0;

        $predikat = match (true) {
            $jumlahIndikatorDinilai === 0 => 'Belum dinilai',
            $rataRata >= 3.50 => 'Sangat Baik',
            $rataRata >= 2.75 => 'Baik',
            $rataRata >= 2.00 => 'Cukup',
            default => 'Perlu pendampingan intensif',
        };

            <script>
                document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
                    const role = document.getElementById('jabatan_penilai');
                    const form = document.getElementById('gembira-form');
                    const levelCards = document.querySelectorAll('[data-gembira-level]');

                    function updateForm() {
                        const allLevels = role.value === 'Peserta Matematika GEMBIRA';

                        levelCards.forEach(card => {
                            const level = card.dataset.gembiraLevel;
                            const active = allLevels || level === '3' || level === '4';

                            card.hidden = !active;

                            card.querySelectorAll('input, textarea, select').forEach(el => {
                                el.disabled = !active;

                                if (!active && el.type === 'radio') {
                                    el.checked = false;
                                }
                            });
                        });

                        updateProgress();
                    }

                    function updateProgress() {
                        const activeRadios = [...form.querySelectorAll('input[type="radio"][name*="_jawaban"]')]
                            .filter(el => !el.disabled);

                        const groups = new Map();
                        activeRadios.forEach(el => {
                            if (!groups.has(el.name)) {
                                groups.set(el.name, el);
                            }
                        });

                        const names = [...groups.keys()];
                        const checked = names.filter(name =>
                            form.querySelector('input[type="radio"][name="' + CSS.escape(name) + '"]:checked')
                        );

                        let totalScore = 0;
                        let scoreCount = 0;

                        checked.forEach(name => {
                            const el = form.querySelector('input[type="radio"][name="' + CSS.escape(name) + '"]:checked');

                            if (el.value !== 'TD') {
                                totalScore += Number(el.value);
                                scoreCount++;
                            }
                        });

                        const percent = names.length ? Math.round(checked.length / names.length * 100) : 0;

                        document.getElementById('gembira-progress-percent').textContent = percent + '%';
                        document.getElementById('gembira-progress-bar').style.width = percent + '%';
                        document.getElementById('gembira-progress-text').textContent = checked.length + ' / ' + names.length + ' butir';
                        document.getElementById('gembira-score-text').textContent = scoreCount
                            ? totalScore + ' poin dari ' + scoreCount + ' indikator berskor'
                            : 'Belum ada penilaian';
                    }

                    role.addEventListener('change', updateForm);
                    form.querySelectorAll('input[type="radio"]').forEach(el => el.addEventListener('change', updateProgress));

                    updateForm();
                });
            </script>
@endsection

    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            const role = document.getElementById('jabatan_penilai');
            const form = document.getElementById('gembira-form');
            const levelCards = document.querySelectorAll('[data-gembira-level]');

            function updateForm() {
                const allLevels = role.value === 'Peserta Matematika GEMBIRA';

                levelCards.forEach(card => {
                    const level = card.dataset.gembiraLevel;
                    const active = allLevels || level === '3' || level === '4';

                    card.hidden = !active;

                    card.querySelectorAll('input, textarea, select').forEach(el => {
                        el.disabled = !active;

                        if (!active && el.type === 'radio') {
                            el.checked = false;
                        }
                    });
                });

                updateProgress();
            }

            function updateProgress() {
                const activeRadios = [...form.querySelectorAll('input[type="radio"][name*="_jawaban"]')]
                    .filter(el => !el.disabled);

                const groups = new Map();
                activeRadios.forEach(el => {
                    if (!groups.has(el.name)) {
                        groups.set(el.name, el);
                    }
                });

                const names = [...groups.keys()];
                const checked = names.filter(name =>
                    form.querySelector('input[type="radio"][name="' + CSS.escape(name) + '"]:checked')
                );

                let totalScore = 0;
                let scoreCount = 0;

                checked.forEach(name => {
                    const el = form.querySelector('input[type="radio"][name="' + CSS.escape(name) + '"]:checked');

                    if (el.value !== 'TD') {
                        totalScore += Number(el.value);
                        scoreCount++;
                    }
                });

                const percent = names.length ? Math.round(checked.length / names.length * 100) : 0;

                document.getElementById('gembira-progress-percent').textContent = percent + '%';
                document.getElementById('gembira-progress-bar').style.width = percent + '%';
                document.getElementById('gembira-progress-text').textContent = checked.length + ' / ' + names.length + ' butir';
                document.getElementById('gembira-score-text').textContent = scoreCount
                    ? totalScore + ' poin dari ' + scoreCount + ' indikator berskor'
                    : 'Belum ada penilaian';
            }

            role.addEventListener('change', updateForm);
            form.querySelectorAll('input[type="radio"]').forEach(el => el.addEventListener('change', updateProgress));

            updateForm();
        });
    </script>
@endsection

        | Penilai lainnya            : Level 3 dan 4
        */
        $jabatanPenilai = $gembira->jabatan_penilai;
        $isPeserta = blank($jabatanPenilai) || $jabatanPenilai === 'Peserta Matematika GEMBIRA';
        $levelAktif = $isPeserta ? [1, 2, 3, 4] : [3, 4];

        /*
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        | Rekap jawaban per level
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        */
        $rekap = [];

        foreach ($levelAktif as $lv) {
            $raw = $gembira->{'level_' . $lv . '_jawaban'} ?? [];

            if (is_string($raw)) {
                $raw = json_decode($raw, true);
            }

            $raw = is_array($raw) ? $raw : [];

            $daftarIndikator = $levelData[(string) $lv]['indikator'] ?? [];
            $skorLevel = 0;
            $terisi = 0;
            $jumlahTd = 0;
            $baris = [];

            foreach ($daftarIndikator as $ind) {
                $item = $raw[$ind['no']] ?? $raw['indikator_' . $ind['no']] ?? null;

                if (is_array($item)) {
                    $nilai = $item['skor'] ?? $item['jawaban'] ?? null;
                    $bukti = $item['bukti'] ?? $item['catatan'] ?? null;
                    $alasan = $item['alasan_td'] ?? null;
                } else {
                    $nilai = $item;
                    $bukti = null;
                    $alasan = null;
                }

                $isTd = $nilai === 'TD';

                if ($isTd) {
                    $jumlahTd++;
                } elseif (is_numeric($nilai)) {
                    $skorLevel += (int) $nilai;
                    $terisi++;
                }

                $baris[$ind['no']] = [
                    'nilai' => $nilai,
                    'bukti' => $bukti,
                    'alasan' => $alasan,
                    'isTd' => $isTd,
                ];
            }

            $jumlahIndikator = count($daftarIndikator);
            $maksimum = ($jumlahIndikator - $jumlahTd) * 4;

            $rekap[$lv] = [
                'skor' => $skorLevel,
                'terisi' => $terisi,
                'td' => $jumlahTd,
                'total' => $jumlahIndikator,
                'max' => $maksimum,
                'rerata' => $terisi > 0 ? $skorLevel / $terisi : 0,
                'persen' => $maksimum > 0 ? ($skorLevel / $maksimum) * 100 : 0,
                'baris' => $baris,
            ];
        }

        /*
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        | Total, nilai akhir, dan predikat
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        */
        $totalSkor = (int) collect($rekap)->sum('skor');
        $skorMaksimum = (int) collect($rekap)->sum('max');
        $terisiTotal = (int) collect($rekap)->sum('terisi');
        $tdTotal = (int) collect($rekap)->sum('td');
        $indikatorBerlaku = (int) collect($rekap)->sum('total') - $tdTotal;

        $rerataKeseluruhan = $terisiTotal > 0 ? $totalSkor / $terisiTotal : 0;
        $nilaiAkhir = $skorMaksimum > 0 ? ($totalSkor / $skorMaksimum) * 100 : 0;

        if ($terisiTotal === 0) {
            $predikat = '-';
        } elseif ($rerataKeseluruhan >= 3.5) {
            $predikat = 'Sangat Baik';
        } elseif ($rerataKeseluruhan >= 2.75) {
            $predikat = 'Baik';
        } elseif ($rerataKeseluruhan >= 2.0) {
            $predikat = 'Cukup';
        } else {
            $predikat = 'Perlu pendampingan intensif';
        }

        $predikatStyle = match ($predikat) {
            'Sangat Baik' => 'background:#d1fae5;color:#047857',
            'Baik' => 'background:#dbeafe;color:#1d4ed8',
            'Cukup' => 'background:#fef3c7;color:#b45309',
            '-' => 'background:#f1f5f9;color:#475569',
            default => 'background:#ffe4e6;color:#be123c',
        };

        $status = $gembira->status ?? 'Draft';

        $statusStyle = $status === 'Selesai'
            ? 'background:#d1fae5;color:#047857'
            : 'background:#fef3c7;color:#b45309';

        $adaObservasi = $gembira->tanggal_observasi ||
            $gembira->durasi_pembelajaran ||
            $gembira->jumlah_murid_hadir !== null ||
            $gembira->observasi_ke !== null;
    @endphp

    <script>
        (function () {
            const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
            const backdrop = document.getElementById('sidebar-backdrop');

            function buka() {
                sidebar.classList.remove('-translate-x-full');
                backdrop.classList.remove('hidden');
            }
            function tutup() {
                sidebar.classList.add('-translate-x-full');
                backdrop.classList.add('hidden');
            }

            document.getElementById('sidebar-open').addEventListener('click', buka);
            document.getElementById('sidebar-close').addEventListener('click', tutup);
            backdrop.addEventListener('click', tutup);

            // Tutup otomatis setelah menu diklik (mobile)
            sidebar.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a => a.addEventListener('click', tutup));

            // Reset bila layar diperbesar ke desktop
            window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
                if (window.innerWidth >= 1024) {
                    backdrop.classList.add('hidden');
                }
            });
        })();
    </script>

    {{-- JAM REAL TIME + CUACA (Open-Meteo, tanpa API key) --}}
    <script>
        (function () {
            const elTime = document.getElementById('rt-time');
            const elZone = document.getElementById('rt-zone');
            const elDate = document.getElementById('rt-date');
            if (!elTime) return;

            /* ---------- JAM: berdetak tiap detik ---------- */
            const fmtJam = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('id-ID', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit', hour12: false });
            const fmtTgl = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('id-ID', { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' });
            const fmtZona = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('id-ID', { timeZoneName: 'short' });

            function tick() {
                const now = new Date();
                elTime.textContent = fmtJam.format(now).replace(/:/g, '.');
                elDate.textContent = fmtTgl.format(now);
                const z = fmtZona.formatToParts(now).find(p => p.type === 'timeZoneName');
                elZone.textContent = z ? z.value : '';
            }
            tick();
            setInterval(tick, 1000);

            /* ---------- CUACA: Mataram, NTB â€” diperbarui tiap 10 menit ---------- */
            const LAT = -8.5833, LON = 116.1167;
            const elIco = document.getElementById('wx-ico');
            const elTemp = document.getElementById('wx-temp');
            const elLabel = document.getElementById('wx-label');

            // kode cuaca WMO -> [label, ikon siang, ikon malam]
            function kode(c) {
                if (c === 0) return ['Cerah', 'â˜€ï¸', 'ðŸŒ™'];
                if (c === 1) return ['Cerah berawan', 'ðŸŒ¤ï¸', 'ðŸŒ™'];
                if (c === 2) return ['Berawan', 'â›…', 'â˜ï¸'];
                if (c === 3) return ['Mendung', 'â˜ï¸', 'â˜ï¸'];
                if (c === 45 || c === 48) return ['Berkabut', 'ðŸŒ«ï¸', 'ðŸŒ«ï¸'];
                if (c >= 51 && c <= 57) return ['Gerimis', 'ðŸŒ¦ï¸', 'ðŸŒ§ï¸'];
                if (c >= 61 && c <= 67) return ['Hujan', 'ðŸŒ§ï¸', 'ðŸŒ§ï¸'];
                if (c >= 80 && c <= 82) return ['Hujan deras', 'ðŸŒ§ï¸', 'ðŸŒ§ï¸'];
                if (c >= 95) return ['Badai petir', 'â›ˆï¸', 'â›ˆï¸'];
                return ['Berawan', 'â›…', 'â˜ï¸'];
            }

            async function muatCuaca() {
                try {
                    const url = 'https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=' + LAT + '&longitude=' + LON
                        + '&current=temperature_2m,weather_code,is_day&timezone=auto';
                    const res = await fetch(url);
                    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
                    const c = (await res.json()).current;
                    const [label, siang, malam] = kode(c.weather_code);
                    elIco.textContent = c.is_day ? siang : malam;
                    elTemp.textContent = Math.round(c.temperature_2m);
                    elLabel.textContent = label;
                } catch (e) {
                    elLabel.textContent = 'Tidak tersedia';
                }
            }
            muatCuaca();
            setInterval(muatCuaca, 10 * 60 * 1000);
        })();
    </script>

            4 => $pkgsdMbi->level_4_jawaban ?? [],
