        $kategoriDari = function ($rata) {
            return match (true) {
                $rata === null => 'Belum ada skor',
                $rata >= 3.50 => 'Sangat Baik',
                $rata >= 2.75 => 'Baik',
                $rata >= 2.00 => 'Cukup',
                default => 'Perlu pendampingan intensif',
            };
        };

        /*
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        | Rekap per level dan keseluruhan
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        | Rerata hanya dari skor numerik 1â€“4. TD tidak dihitung dan
        | indikator yang belum dinilai tidak dianggap bernilai nol.
        */
        $rekap = [];
        $totalSemua = 0;
        $terisiSemua = 0;
        $jumlahIndikatorBerlaku = 0;

        foreach ($levelAktif as $level) {
            $total = 0;
            $terisi = 0;
            $jumlahTD = 0;

            foreach ((array) $jawabanLevel[$level] as $item) {
                $skor = is_array($item) ? ($item['skor'] ?? null) : $item;

                if ($skor === null || $skor === '') {
                    continue;
                }

                if (strtoupper((string) $skor) === 'TD') {
                    $jumlahTD++;
                    continue;
                }

                if (is_numeric($skor) && (int) $skor >= 1 && (int) $skor <= 4) {
                    $total += (int) $skor;
                    $terisi++;
                }
            }

            $rata = $terisi > 0 ? $total / $terisi : null;
            $jumlahLevel = count($levelData[$level]['indikator'] ?? []);

            $rekap[$level] = [
                'total' => $total,
                'terisi' => $terisi,
                'td' => $jumlahTD,
                'rata' => $rata,
                'jumlah' => $jumlahLevel,
                'kategori' => $kategoriDari($rata),
            ];

            $totalSemua += $total;
            $terisiSemua += $terisi;
            $jumlahIndikatorBerlaku += $jumlahLevel;
        }

        $rataSemua = $terisiSemua > 0 ? $totalSemua / $terisiSemua : null;
        $kategoriSemua = $kategoriDari($rataSemua);

            || filled($pkgsdMbi->observasi_ke ?? null);

    {{-- ================= JAVASCRIPT PROGRES ================= --}}
    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            const role = document.getElementById('jabatan_penilai');
            const form = document.getElementById('pkgsd-form');
            const levelCards = document.querySelectorAll('[data-pkgsd-level]');

            function updateForm() {
                const allLevels = role.value === 'Peserta PKGSD MBI';

                levelCards.forEach(card => {
                    const level = card.dataset.pkgsdLevel;
                    const active = allLevels || level === '3' || level === '4';

                    card.hidden = !active;

                    card.querySelectorAll('input, textarea, select').forEach(el => {
                        el.disabled = !active;

                        if (!active && el.type === 'radio') {
                            el.checked = false;
                        }
                    });
                });

                // Setiap kelompok indikator aktif wajib memiliki satu skor.
                // Level yang tidak berlaku sudah dinonaktifkan sehingga tidak ikut divalidasi.
                const scoreGroups = new Map();
                form.querySelectorAll('input[type="radio"][name*="_jawaban"]').forEach(input => {
                    input.required = false;
                    if (input.disabled) return;
                    if (!scoreGroups.has(input.name)) {
                        scoreGroups.set(input.name, input);
                    }
                });
                scoreGroups.forEach(firstRadio => {
                    firstRadio.required = true;
                });

                updateTD();
                updateProgress();
            }

            function updateTD() {
                // Bukti wajib ketika skor Level 3 atau Level 4 adalah 3/4.
                ['3', '4'].forEach(level => {
                    document.querySelectorAll('[data-pkgsd-level="' + level + '"] [data-pkgsd-item]').forEach(item => {
                        const checkedScore = item.querySelector('input[type="radio"][name*="[skor]"]:checked');
                        const evidence = item.querySelector('[data-pkgsd-evidence]');
                        if (evidence) {
                            const needsEvidence = !!checkedScore && ['3', '4'].includes(checkedScore.value);
                            evidence.required = needsEvidence;
                            evidence.setAttribute('aria-required', needsEvidence ? 'true' : 'false');
                        }
                    });
                });

                document.querySelectorAll('.td-reason').forEach(box => {
                    const nomor = box.dataset.reasonFor;
                    const card = box.closest('[data-pkgsd-level]');
                    const checked = form.querySelector(
                        'input[type="radio"][name="level_3_jawaban[' + nomor + '][skor]"]:checked'
                    );
                    const show = !!checked && checked.value === 'TD' && !card.hidden;
                    const textarea = box.querySelector('textarea');
                    box.hidden = !show;
                    textarea.disabled = !show;
                    textarea.required = false;
                });
            }

            function updateProgress() {
                const activeRadios = [...form.querySelectorAll('input[type="radio"][name*="_jawaban"]')]
                    .filter(el => !el.disabled);

                const names = [...new Set(activeRadios.map(el => el.name))];
                const checked = names.filter(name =>
                    form.querySelector('input[type="radio"][name="' + CSS.escape(name) + '"]:checked')
                );

                let totalScore = 0;
                let scoreCount = 0;

                checked.forEach(name => {
                    const el = form.querySelector('input[type="radio"][name="' + CSS.escape(name) + '"]:checked');

                    if (el.value !== 'TD') {
                        totalScore += Number(el.value);
                        scoreCount++;
                    }
                });

                const percent = names.length ? Math.round(checked.length / names.length * 100) : 0;

                document.getElementById('pkgsd-progress-percent').textContent = percent + '%';
                document.getElementById('pkgsd-progress-bar').style.width = percent + '%';
                document.getElementById('pkgsd-progress-text').textContent = checked.length + ' / ' + names.length + ' butir';
                document.getElementById('pkgsd-score-text').textContent = scoreCount
                    ? totalScore + ' poin dari ' + scoreCount + ' indikator berskor'
                    : 'Belum ada penilaian';
            }

            role.addEventListener('change', updateForm);

            form.querySelectorAll('input[type="radio"]').forEach(el => {
                el.addEventListener('change', function () {
                    updateTD();
                    updateProgress();
                });
            });

            updateForm();
        });
    </script>

@endsection

    {{-- ================= JAVASCRIPT PROGRES ================= --}}
    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            const role = document.getElementById('jabatan_penilai');
            const form = document.getElementById('pkgsd-form');
            const levelCards = document.querySelectorAll('[data-pkgsd-level]');

            function updateForm() {
                const allLevels = role.value === 'Peserta PKGSD MBI';

                levelCards.forEach(card => {
                    const level = card.dataset.pkgsdLevel;
                    const active = allLevels || level === '3' || level === '4';

                    card.hidden = !active;

                    card.querySelectorAll('input, textarea, select').forEach(el => {
                        el.disabled = !active;

                        if (!active && el.type === 'radio') {
                            el.checked = false;
                        }
                    });
                });

                updateTD();
                updateProgress();
            }

            function updateTD() {
                // Bukti wajib ketika skor Level 3 atau Level 4 adalah 3/4.
                ['3', '4'].forEach(level => {
                    document.querySelectorAll('[data-pkgsd-level="' + level + '"] [data-pkgsd-item]').forEach(item => {
                        const checkedScore = item.querySelector('input[type="radio"][name*="[skor]"]:checked');
                        const evidence = item.querySelector('[data-pkgsd-evidence]');
                        if (evidence) {
                            const needsEvidence = !!checkedScore && ['3', '4'].includes(checkedScore.value);
                            evidence.required = needsEvidence;
                            evidence.setAttribute('aria-required', needsEvidence ? 'true' : 'false');
                        }
                    });
                });

                document.querySelectorAll('.td-reason').forEach(box => {
                    const nomor = box.dataset.reasonFor;
                    const card = box.closest('[data-pkgsd-level]');
                    const checked = form.querySelector(
                        'input[type="radio"][name="level_3_jawaban[' + nomor + '][skor]"]:checked'
                    );
                    const show = !!checked && checked.value === 'TD' && !card.hidden;
                    const textarea = box.querySelector('textarea');
                    box.hidden = !show;
                    textarea.disabled = !show;
                    textarea.required = false;
                });
            }

            function updateProgress() {
                const activeRadios = [...form.querySelectorAll('input[type="radio"][name*="_jawaban"]')]
                    .filter(el => !el.disabled);

                const names = [...new Set(activeRadios.map(el => el.name))];
                const checked = names.filter(name =>
                    form.querySelector('input[type="radio"][name="' + CSS.escape(name) + '"]:checked')
                );

                let totalScore = 0;
                let scoreCount = 0;

                checked.forEach(name => {
                    const el = form.querySelector('input[type="radio"][name="' + CSS.escape(name) + '"]:checked');

                    if (el.value !== 'TD') {
                        totalScore += Number(el.value);
                        scoreCount++;
                    }
                });

                const percent = names.length ? Math.round(checked.length / names.length * 100) : 0;

                document.getElementById('pkgsd-progress-percent').textContent = percent + '%';
                document.getElementById('pkgsd-progress-bar').style.width = percent + '%';
                document.getElementById('pkgsd-progress-text').textContent = checked.length + ' / ' + names.length + ' butir';
                document.getElementById('pkgsd-score-text').textContent = scoreCount
                    ? totalScore + ' poin dari ' + scoreCount + ' indikator berskor'
                    : 'Belum ada penilaian';
            }

            role.addEventListener('change', updateForm);

            form.querySelectorAll('input[type="radio"]').forEach(el => {
                el.addEventListener('change', function () {
                    updateTD();
                    updateProgress();
                });
            });

            updateForm();
        });
    </script>

@endsection

        $samakanTeksIndikator = function (string $teks): string {

                    continue;
                }

                if (is_numeric($skor) && (int) $skor >= 1 && (int) $skor <= 4) {
                    $total += (int) $skor;
                    $terisi++;
                }
            }

            $rata = $terisi > 0 ? $total / $terisi : null;

            $rekap[$level] = [
                'total' => $total,
                'terisi' => $terisi,
                'td' => $jumlahTD,
                'rata' => $rata,
                'persen' => $rata !== null ? ($rata / 4) * 100 : 0,
                'kategori' => $kategoriDari($rata),
            ];

            $totalSemua += $total;
            $terisiSemua += $terisi;
            $jumlahIndikatorBerlaku += $levelConfig[$level]['jumlah'];
        }

        $rataSemua = $terisiSemua > 0 ? $totalSemua / $terisiSemua : null;
        $kategoriSemua = $kategoriDari($rataSemua);

        $adaMetadataObservasi = filled($pkgsdMbi->tanggal_observasi ?? null)
            || filled($pkgsdMbi->durasi_pembelajaran ?? null)
            || filled($pkgsdMbi->jumlah_murid_hadir ?? null)
            || filled($pkgsdMbi->observasi_ke ?? null);
    @endphp

                                    $skor = $item['skor'] ?? null;
                                    $skorAda = $skor !== null && $skor !== '';
                                    $isTD = $skorAda && strtoupper((string) $skor) === 'TD';

                                    $bukti = $item['bukti'] ?? '';
                                    $alasanTd = $item['alasan_td'] ?? '';

                                    $indikator = $indikatorList->get($nomor);
                                    $teksIndikator = $samakanTeksIndikator(
                                        $indikator['indikator'] ?? 'Indikator ' . $nomor
                                    );

                                    $deskripsiSkor = null;
                                    if ($indikator && $skorAda && !$isTD && is_numeric($skor)) {
                                        $deskripsiSkor = $indikator['rubrik'][(int) $skor - 1] ?? null;
                                    }

                                            @foreach (array_slice($bagianKelompok, 1) as $catatanKelompok)
                                                <p class="d-group-n">{{ $catatanKelompok }}</p>
                                            @endforeach
                                        </td>
                                    </tr>
                                @endif

                                <tr class="d-data">
                                    <td class="txt">{{ $nomor }}</td>

                                    <td class="q">
                                        {{ $teksIndikator }}

                                        @if ($deskripsiSkor)
                                            <p class="rubrik">
                                                <b>Skor {{ $skor }}:</b>
                                                {{ $deskripsiSkor }}
                                            </p>
                                        @endif
                                    </td>

                                    @if ($punyaBukti)
                                        <td>
                                            @if (filled($bukti))
                                                <p class="note">{{ $bukti }}</p>
                                            @endif

                                            @if ($level === 3 && $isTD)
                                                <div class="d-td-box" @if (filled($bukti)) style="margin-top:8px" @endif>
                                                    <b>Alasan TD</b>

                                                </div>
                                            @endif

                                            @if (!filled($bukti) && !($level === 3 && $isTD))
                                                <span class="faint">-</span>
                                            @endif
                                        </td>
                                    @endif

                                    <td style="text-align:center">
                                        @if ($skorAda)
                                            <span class="d-score {{ $isTD ? 'td' : '' }}">
                                                {{ strtoupper((string) $skor) }}
                                            </span>
                                        @else
                                            <span class="faint">-</span>
                                        @endif
                                    </td>
                                </tr>
                            @endfor
                        </tbody>
                    </table>
                </div>
            </section>
        @endforeach

    </div>

    /*

    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------

    | LEVEL DAN RENTANG BUTIR

    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------

    */

    $levels = [

        1 => [

            'label' => 'Level I â€” Reaksi',

            'nama' => 'Reaksi (Reaction)',

            'deskripsi' => 'Kepuasan peserta terhadap pelaksanaan pelatihan.',

            'rentang' => range(1, 15),

        ],

        2 => [

            'label' => 'Level II â€” Belajar',

            'nama' => 'Belajar (Learning)',

            'deskripsi' => 'Pengetahuan, keterampilan, dan sikap setelah pelatihan.',

            'rentang' => range(16, 33),

        ],

        3 => [

            'label' => 'Level III â€” Perilaku',

            'nama' => 'Perilaku (Behavior)',

            'deskripsi' => 'Penerapan hasil pelatihan di tempat kerja.',

            'rentang' => range(34, 38),

        ],

        4 => [

            'label' => 'Level IV â€” Hasil',

            'nama' => 'Hasil (Results)',

            'deskripsi' => 'Dampak penerapan hasil pelatihan bagi sekolah.',

            'rentang' => range(39, 43),

        ],

    ];

    /*

    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------

    | PERHITUNGAN SKOR

    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------

    */

    $jabatanResponden = $tendik->jabatan_responden
        ?? $tendik->jabatan
        ?? '-';

    $isTendik = in_array(
        $jabatanResponden,
        ['Tendik', 'Operator', 'Bendahara'],
        true
    );

    // Jabatan selain Tendik hanya menggunakan Level III dan IV.
    if (!$isTendik) {
        $levels = array_filter(
            $levels,
            fn($level, $nomorLevel) => in_array($nomorLevel, [3, 4], true),
            ARRAY_FILTER_USE_BOTH
        );
    }

    $jumlahButir = array_sum(array_map(
        fn($level) => count($level['rentang']),
        $levels
    ));

    $skorMaksimal = $jumlahButir * 4;
    $totalSkor = 0;
    $jumlahTerisi = 0;
    $levelScores = [];
    $levelCounts = [];
    $levelMaxScores = [];
    $levelPersentase = [];
    $rataRataLevel = [];

    foreach ($levels as $nomorLevel => $level) {
        $skorLevel = 0;
        $terisiLevel = 0;

        foreach ($level['rentang'] as $nomor) {
            $nilai = $tendik->{'jawaban_' . $nomor};

            if ($nilai !== null && $nilai !== '') {
                $skorLevel += (int) $nilai;
                $terisiLevel++;
            }
        }

        $jumlahButirLevel = count($level['rentang']);
        $levelScores[$nomorLevel] = $skorLevel;
        $levelCounts[$nomorLevel] = $terisiLevel;
        $levelMaxScores[$nomorLevel] = $jumlahButirLevel * 4;

        $levelPersentase[$nomorLevel] = $levelMaxScores[$nomorLevel] > 0
            ? ($skorLevel / $levelMaxScores[$nomorLevel]) * 100
            : 0;

        // Rata-rata setiap level dihitung secara terpisah.
        if ($terisiLevel > 0) {
            $rataRataLevel[$nomorLevel] = $skorLevel / $terisiLevel;
        }

        $totalSkor += $skorLevel;
        $jumlahTerisi += $terisiLevel;
    }

    // Nilai akhir memberikan bobot yang sama untuk setiap level
    // yang memiliki jawaban, bukan berdasarkan jumlah butirnya.
    $rataRata = count($rataRataLevel) > 0
        ? array_sum($rataRataLevel) / count($rataRataLevel)
        : 0;

    $persentaseTotal = ($rataRata / 4) * 100;

    $predikat = match (true) {
        $jumlahTerisi === 0 => 'Belum Dinilai',
        $rataRata >= 3.26 => 'Sangat Baik',
        $rataRata >= 2.51 => 'Baik',
        $rataRata >= 1.76 => 'Cukup',
        default => 'Kurang',
    };

    $predikatClass = match ($predikat) {
        'Sangat Baik' => 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700',
        'Baik' => 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700',
        'Cukup' => 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700',
        'Kurang' => 'bg-red-100 text-red-700',
        default => 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600',
    };

    $tanggalPengisian = $tendik->tanggal_pengisian
        ?? $tendik->tanggal_evaluasi
        ?? $tendik->created_at;

    $namaPetugas = $tendik->nama_petugas_monev
        ?? $tendik->nama_petugas
        ?? '-';

    $instansiPetugas = $tendik->instansi_petugas
        ?? $tendik->unit_kerja_petugas
        ?? $tendik->instansi
        ?? '-';

    $namaResponden = $tendik->nama_responden
        ?? $tendik->nama
        ?? '-';

    $jabatanLainnya = $tendik->jabatan_lainnya ?? null;

    if ($jabatanLainnya && $jabatanResponden === 'Lainnya') {
        $jabatanResponden .= ' - ' . $jabatanLainnya;
    }

    $lokasiMonev = $tendik->lokasi_monev ?? '-';

    $tanggalPelaksanaan = $tendik->tanggal_pelaksanaan
        ?? $tendik->tanggal_pengisian
        ?? null;

    $satuanPendidikan = $tendik->satuan_pendidikan
        ?? $tendik->nama_sekolah
        ?? '-';

    $masaKerja = $tendik->masa_kerja ?? null;

    $namaKegiatan = $tendik->nama_pelatihan
        ?? $tendik->nama_kegiatan
        ?? $tendik->nama_kegiatan_pelatihan
        ?? $tendik->kegiatan
        ?? '-';

    $statusPengisianLabel = $jumlahTerisi === $jumlahButir
        ? 'Selesai'
        : 'Belum Lengkap';

@endphp

    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            const jabatan = document.getElementById('jabatan_responden');
            const lainnyaWrap = document.getElementById('jabatan-lainnya-wrap');
            const lainnyaInput = document.getElementById('jabatan_lainnya');

            const levelSections = document.querySelectorAll('[data-level-section]');

            function updateLevelJabatan() {
                if (!jabatan) return;

                const isTendik = ['Tendik', 'Operator', 'Bendahara'].includes(jabatan.value);

                levelSections.forEach(function (section) {
                    const level = Number(section.dataset.levelSection);
                    const tampil = isTendik || (level === 3 || level === 4);

                    section.hidden = !tampil;

                    section.querySelectorAll('input[type="radio"]').forEach(function (radio) {
                        radio.disabled = !tampil;

                        if (!tampil) {
                            radio.checked = false;
                        }
                    });
                });

                if (lainnyaWrap) {
                    lainnyaWrap.style.display = 'none';
                }

                if (lainnyaInput) {
                    lainnyaInput.required = false;
                    lainnyaInput.value = '';
                }

                updateTendikProgress();
            }

            function updateTendikProgress() {
                const radioAktif = Array.from(
                    document.querySelectorAll(
                        'input[type="radio"][name^="jawaban_"]:not(:disabled)'
                    )
                );

                const namaIndikator = new Set(
                    radioAktif.map(function (radio) {
                        return radio.name;
                    })
                );

                const totalIndikator = namaIndikator.size;

                const checked = radioAktif.filter(function (radio) {
                    return radio.checked;
                });

                const jumlahDiisi = checked.length;
                const totalSkor = checked.reduce(function (total, radio) {
                    return total + Number(radio.value);
                }, 0);

                const persen = totalIndikator > 0
                    ? Math.round((jumlahDiisi / totalIndikator) * 100)
                    : 0;

                const progressBar = document.getElementById('tendik-progress-bar');
                const progressPercent = document.getElementById('tendik-progress-percent');
                const progressText = document.getElementById('tendik-progress-text');
                const scoreText = document.getElementById('tendik-score-text');

                if (progressBar) {
                    progressBar.style.width = persen + '%';
                }

                if (progressPercent) {
                    progressPercent.textContent = persen + '%';
                }

                if (progressText) {
                    progressText.textContent =
                        jumlahDiisi + ' / ' + totalIndikator + ' butir';
                }

                if (scoreText) {
                    if (jumlahDiisi === 0) {
                        scoreText.textContent = 'Belum ada penilaian';
                    } else {
                        scoreText.textContent =
                            totalSkor + ' / ' + (totalIndikator * 4) + ' poin';
                    }
                }
            }

            document.querySelectorAll(
                'input[type="radio"][name^="jawaban_"]'
            ).forEach(function (radio) {
                radio.addEventListener('change', updateTendikProgress);
            });

            if (jabatan) {
                jabatan.addEventListener('change', updateLevelJabatan);
            }

            updateLevelJabatan();
        });
    </script>

@endsection

    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            const jabatan = document.getElementById('jabatan_responden');
            const lainnyaWrap = document.getElementById('jabatan-lainnya-wrap');
            const lainnyaInput = document.getElementById('jabatan_lainnya');

            const levelSections = document.querySelectorAll('[data-level-section]');

            function updateLevelJabatan() {
                if (!jabatan) return;

                const isTendik = ['Tendik', 'Operator', 'Bendahara'].includes(jabatan.value);

                levelSections.forEach(function (section) {
                    const level = Number(section.dataset.levelSection);
                    const tampil = isTendik || (level === 3 || level === 4);

                    section.hidden = !tampil;

                    section.querySelectorAll('input[type="radio"]').forEach(function (radio) {
                        radio.disabled = !tampil;

                        if (!tampil) {
                            radio.checked = false;
                        }
                    });
                });

                if (lainnyaWrap) {
                    const tampilLainnya = jabatan.value === 'Lainnya';
                    lainnyaWrap.style.display = tampilLainnya ? '' : 'none';
                    if (lainnyaInput) {
                        lainnyaInput.required = tampilLainnya;
                        if (!tampilLainnya) lainnyaInput.value = '';
                    }
                }

                updateTendikProgress();
            }

            function updateTendikProgress() {
                const radioAktif = Array.from(
                    document.querySelectorAll(
                        'input[type="radio"][name^="jawaban_"]:not(:disabled)'
                    )
                );

                const namaIndikator = new Set(
                    radioAktif.map(function (radio) {
                        return radio.name;
                    })
                );

                const totalIndikator = namaIndikator.size;

                const checked = radioAktif.filter(function (radio) {
                    return radio.checked;
                });

                const jumlahDiisi = checked.length;
                const totalSkor = checked.reduce(function (total, radio) {
                    return total + Number(radio.value);
                }, 0);

                const persen = totalIndikator > 0
                    ? Math.round((jumlahDiisi / totalIndikator) * 100)
                    : 0;

                const progressBar = document.getElementById('tendik-progress-bar');
                const progressPercent = document.getElementById('tendik-progress-percent');
                const progressText = document.getElementById('tendik-progress-text');
                const scoreText = document.getElementById('tendik-score-text');

                if (progressBar) {
                    progressBar.style.width = persen + '%';
                }

                if (progressPercent) {
                    progressPercent.textContent = persen + '%';
                }

                if (progressText) {
                    progressText.textContent =
                        jumlahDiisi + ' / ' + totalIndikator + ' butir';
                }

                if (scoreText) {
                    if (jumlahDiisi === 0) {
                        scoreText.textContent = 'Belum ada penilaian';
                    } else {
                        scoreText.textContent =
                            totalSkor + ' / ' + (totalIndikator * 4) + ' poin';
                    }
                }
            }

            document.querySelectorAll(
                'input[type="radio"][name^="jawaban_"]'
            ).forEach(function (radio) {
                radio.addEventListener('change', updateTendikProgress);
            });

            if (jabatan) {
                jabatan.addEventListener('change', updateLevelJabatan);
            }

            updateLevelJabatan();
        });
    </script>
@endsection

        /*
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        | PERHITUNGAN SKOR
        |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
        */
        $jabatanResponden = $tendik->jabatan_responden
            ?? $tendik->jabatan
            ?? '';

        $isTendik = in_array(
            $jabatanResponden,
            ['Tendik', 'Operator', 'Bendahara'],
            true
        );

        // Tendik menggunakan Level 1-4.
        // Jabatan lainnya hanya menggunakan Level 3-4.
        if (!$isTendik) {
            $levels = array_filter(
                $levels,
                fn($level, $nomorLevel) => in_array($nomorLevel, [3, 4], true),
                ARRAY_FILTER_USE_BOTH
            );
        }

        $jumlahButir = array_sum(
            array_map(
                fn($level) => count($level['rentang']),
                $levels
            )
        );

        $skorMaksimal = $jumlahButir * 4;
        $totalSkor = 0;
        $jumlahTerisi = 0;

        $levelScores = [];
        $levelCounts = [];
        $levelMaxScores = [];
        $levelPersentase = [];

        foreach ($levels as $nomorLevel => $level) {
            $skorLevel = 0;
            $terisiLevel = 0;

            foreach ($level['rentang'] as $nomor) {
                $nilai = $tendik->{'jawaban_' . $nomor};

                if ($nilai !== null && $nilai !== '') {
                    $skorLevel += (int) $nilai;
                    $terisiLevel++;
                }
            }

            $levelScores[$nomorLevel] = $skorLevel;
            $levelCounts[$nomorLevel] = $terisiLevel;
            $levelMaxScores[$nomorLevel] = count($level['rentang']) * 4;

            $levelPersentase[$nomorLevel] = $levelMaxScores[$nomorLevel] > 0
                ? ($skorLevel / $levelMaxScores[$nomorLevel]) * 100
                : 0;

            $totalSkor += $skorLevel;
            $jumlahTerisi += $terisiLevel;
        }

        $persentaseTotal = $skorMaksimal > 0
            ? ($totalSkor / $skorMaksimal) * 100
            : 0;

        $rataRata = $jumlahTerisi > 0
            ? $totalSkor / $jumlahTerisi
            : 0;

        $predikat = match (true) {
            $jumlahTerisi === 0 => 'Belum Dinilai',
            $rataRata >= 3.26 => 'Sangat Baik',
            $rataRata >= 2.51 => 'Baik',
            $rataRata >= 1.76 => 'Cukup',
            default => 'Kurang',
        };

        $predikatStyle = match ($predikat) {
            'Sangat Baik' => 'background:#d1fae5;color:#047857',
            'Baik' => 'background:#dbeafe;color:#1d4ed8',
            'Cukup' => 'background:#fef3c7;color:#b45309',
            'Kurang' => 'background:#ffe4e6;color:#be123c',
            default => 'background:#f1f5f9;color:#475569',
        };

        $tanggalPengisian = $tendik->tanggal_pengisian
            ?? $tendik->tanggal_evaluasi
            ?? $tendik->created_at;

        $namaPetugas = $tendik->nama_petugas_monev

            ?? '-';

        $instansiPetugas = $tendik->instansi_petugas
            ?? $tendik->unit_kerja_petugas
            ?? $tendik->instansi

        $namaResponden = $tendik->nama_responden

        $satuanPendidikan = $tendik->satuan_pendidikan

        $masaKerja = $tendik->masa_kerja ?? null;

        $namaKegiatan = $tendik->nama_pelatihan

            ?? $tendik->nama_kegiatan_pelatihan
            ?? $tendik->kegiatan
            ?? '-';

        $statusSelesai = $jumlahTerisi === $jumlahButir;

            : 'Belum Lengkap';

        $statusStyle = $statusSelesai

            : 'background:#fef3c7;color:#b45309';

@section('title', 'Rencana Tindak Lanjut')

@section('page-title', 'Rencana Tindak Lanjut')

@section('content')
    @php
        $persen = fn($a, $b) => $b > 0 ? min(round(($a / $b) * 100), 100) : 0;

        $pctBelum = $persen($belumDimulai, $totalTindakLanjut);
        $pctProses = $persen($dalamProses, $totalTindakLanjut);
        $pctSelesai = $persen($selesai, $totalTindakLanjut);
    @endphp

    <style>
        /* ===================== TOKEN WARNA (sama dengan dashboard) ===================== */
        :root {
            --p-50: #eff4ff;

    $fmt = static function ($t) {
        try {

    $terisi = collect(array_keys($pertanyaan))

        ->count();

    $satuanPendidikan = $metadata['satuan_pendidikan']
        ?? $wawancara->unit_kerja_responden
        ?? $wawancara->sekolah?->nama_sekolah ?? '-';

    $masaKerja = $metadata['masa_kerja'] ?? null;

    $namaPelatihan = $metadata['nama_pelatihan']
        ?? $metadata['nama_kegiatan'] ?? '-';

    $tanggalPelaksanaan = $metadata['tanggal_pelaksanaan']
        ?? $wawancara->tanggal_evaluasi ?? null;

    $tanggalPengisian = $metadata['tanggal_pengisian']
        ?? $wawancara->tanggal_wawancara
        ?? $wawancara->created_at ?? null;

    $formatTanggal = static function ($tanggal) {
        if (!$tanggal) {
            return '-';
        }

        try {
            return Carbon::parse($tanggal)->locale('id')->translatedFormat('d F Y');
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            return '-';
        }
    };

    $jawabanTerisi = 0;

    foreach (array_keys($pertanyaan) as $nomor) {
        $jawaban = $wawancara->{'jawaban_' . $nomor};

        if (is_string($jawaban) && trim($jawaban) !== '') {
            $jawabanTerisi++;
        }
    }

    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            const fields = document.querySelectorAll('[data-wawancara-jawaban]');

            const progressBar = document.getElementById('wawancara-progress-bar');
            const progressPercent = document.getElementById('wawancara-progress-percent');
            const progressText = document.getElementById('wawancara-progress-text');

            function updateProgress() {
                const total = fields.length;
                let terisi = 0;

                fields.forEach(function (field) {
                    if (field.value.trim() !== '') {
                        terisi++;
                    }
                });

                const persen = total > 0 ? Math.round((terisi / total) * 100) : 0;

                progressBar.style.width = persen + '%';
                progressPercent.textContent = persen + '%';
                progressText.textContent = terisi + ' / ' + total + ' jawaban';
            }

            fields.forEach(function (field) {
                field.addEventListener('input', updateProgress);
            });

            updateProgress();
        });
    </script>

    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            const fields = document.querySelectorAll('[data-wawancara-jawaban]');

            const progressBar = document.getElementById('wawancara-progress-bar');
            const progressPercent = document.getElementById('wawancara-progress-percent');
            const progressText = document.getElementById('wawancara-progress-text');

            function updateProgress() {
                const total = fields.length;
                let terisi = 0;

                fields.forEach(function (field) {
                    if (field.value.trim() !== '') {
                        terisi++;
                    }
                });

                const persen = total > 0 ? Math.round((terisi / total) * 100) : 0;

                progressBar.style.width = persen + '%';
                progressPercent.textContent = persen + '%';
                progressText.textContent = terisi + ' / ' + total + ' jawaban';
            }

            fields.forEach(function (field) {
                field.addEventListener('input', updateProgress);
            });

            updateProgress();
        });
    </script>

    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            /* ---- Jabatan lainnya ---- */
            const jabatan = document.getElementById('jabatan_responden');
            const wrap = document.getElementById('jabatan-lainnya-wrap');
            const input = document.getElementById('jabatan_lainnya');

            function toggleJabatanLainnya() {
                const isLainnya = jabatan.value === 'Lainnya';

                wrap.hidden = !isLainnya;
                input.required = isLainnya;

                if (!isLainnya) {
                    input.value = '';
                }
            }

            jabatan.addEventListener('change', toggleJabatanLainnya);
            toggleJabatanLainnya();

            /* ---- Progres pengisian ---- */
            const fields = document.querySelectorAll('[data-wawancara-jawaban]');

            const progressBar = document.getElementById('wawancara-progress-bar');
            const progressPercent = document.getElementById('wawancara-progress-percent');
            const progressText = document.getElementById('wawancara-progress-text');

            function updateProgress() {
                const total = fields.length;
                let terisi = 0;

                fields.forEach(function (field) {
                    if (field.value.trim() !== '') {
                        terisi++;
                    }
                });

                const persen = total > 0 ? Math.round((terisi / total) * 100) : 0;

                progressBar.style.width = persen + '%';
                progressPercent.textContent = persen + '%';
                progressText.textContent = terisi + ' / ' + total + ' jawaban';
            }

            fields.forEach(function (field) {
                field.addEventListener('input', updateProgress);
            });

            updateProgress();
        });
    </script>

@endsection

    {{-- ================= JAVASCRIPT PROGRES ================= --}}
    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            const fields = document.querySelectorAll('[data-wawancara-jawaban]');

            const progressBar = document.getElementById('wawancara-progress-bar');
            const progressPercent = document.getElementById('wawancara-progress-percent');
            const progressText = document.getElementById('wawancara-progress-text');

            function updateProgress() {
                const total = fields.length;
                let terisi = 0;

                fields.forEach(function (field) {
                    if (field.value.trim() !== '') {
                        terisi++;
                    }
                });

                const persen = total > 0 ? Math.round((terisi / total) * 100) : 0;

                progressBar.style.width = persen + '%';
                progressPercent.textContent = persen + '%';
                progressText.textContent = terisi + ' / ' + total + ' jawaban';
            }

            fields.forEach(function (field) {
                field.addEventListener('input', updateProgress);
            });

            updateProgress();
        });
    </script>

    {{-- ================= JAVASCRIPT PROGRES ================= --}}
    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            const fields = document.querySelectorAll('[data-wawancara-jawaban]');

            const progressBar = document.getElementById('wawancara-progress-bar');
            const progressPercent = document.getElementById('wawancara-progress-percent');
            const progressText = document.getElementById('wawancara-progress-text');

            function updateProgress() {
                const total = fields.length;
                let terisi = 0;

                fields.forEach(function (field) {
                    if (field.value.trim() !== '') {
                        terisi++;
                    }
                });

                const persen = total > 0 ? Math.round((terisi / total) * 100) : 0;

                progressBar.style.width = persen + '%';
                progressPercent.textContent = persen + '%';
                progressText.textContent = terisi + ' / ' + total + ' jawaban';
            }

            fields.forEach(function (field) {
                field.addEventListener('input', updateProgress);
            });

            updateProgress();
        });
    </script>

    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            const fields = document.querySelectorAll('[data-wawancara-jawaban]');

            const progressBar = document.getElementById('wawancara-progress-bar');
            const progressPercent = document.getElementById('wawancara-progress-percent');
            const progressText = document.getElementById('wawancara-progress-text');

            function updateProgress() {
                const total = fields.length;
                let terisi = 0;

                fields.forEach(function (field) {
                    if (field.value.trim() !== '') {
                        terisi++;
                    }
                });

                const persen = total > 0 ? Math.round((terisi / total) * 100) : 0;

                progressBar.style.width = persen + '%';
                progressPercent.textContent = persen + '%';
                progressText.textContent = terisi + ' / ' + total + ' jawaban';
            }

            fields.forEach(function (field) {
                field.addEventListener('input', updateProgress);
            });

            updateProgress();
        });
    </script>

    {{-- ================= JAVASCRIPT PROGRES ================= --}}
    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            const fields = document.querySelectorAll('[data-wawancara-jawaban]');

            const progressBar = document.getElementById('wawancara-progress-bar');
            const progressPercent = document.getElementById('wawancara-progress-percent');
            const progressText = document.getElementById('wawancara-progress-text');

            function updateProgress() {
                const total = fields.length;
                let terisi = 0;

                fields.forEach(function (field) {
                    if (field.value.trim() !== '') {
                        terisi++;
                    }
                });

                const persen = total > 0 ? Math.round((terisi / total) * 100) : 0;

                progressBar.style.width = persen + '%';
                progressPercent.textContent = persen + '%';
                progressText.textContent = terisi + ' / ' + total + ' jawaban';
            }

            fields.forEach(function (field) {
                field.addEventListener('input', updateProgress);
            });

            updateProgress();
        });
    </script>

    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            const fields = document.querySelectorAll('[data-wawancara-jawaban]');

            const progressBar = document.getElementById('wawancara-progress-bar');
            const progressPercent = document.getElementById('wawancara-progress-percent');
            const progressText = document.getElementById('wawancara-progress-text');

            function updateProgress() {
                const total = fields.length;
                let terisi = 0;

                fields.forEach(function (field) {
                    if (field.value.trim() !== '') {
                        terisi++;
                    }
                });

                const persen = total > 0 ? Math.round((terisi / total) * 100) : 0;

                progressBar.style.width = persen + '%';
                progressPercent.textContent = persen + '%';
                progressText.textContent = terisi + ' / ' + total + ' jawaban';
            }

            fields.forEach(function (field) {
                field.addEventListener('input', updateProgress);
            });

            updateProgress();
        });
    </script>

    <script>
        function tutupNotifikasi(id) {
            const elemen = document.getElementById(id);

            if (!elemen) return;

            elemen.style.opacity = '0';
            elemen.style.transform = 'translateY(-6px)';

            setTimeout(() => {
                elemen.remove();
            }, 350);
        }

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            // Hilangkan notifikasi setelah 3 detik.
            ['success', 'info'].forEach(function (jenis) {
                const elemen = document.getElementById('alert-' + jenis);

                if (elemen) {
                    setTimeout(function () {
                        tutupNotifikasi('alert-' + jenis);
                    }, 3000);
                }
            });
        });
    </script>

    @php
        $metadata = is_array($metadata ?? null) ? $metadata : [];
        $jawaban = $metadata['jawaban_terbuka'] ?? [];

        if (!is_array($jawaban)) {
            $jawaban = [];
        }

        // Jawaban nomor 5 berupa sub-jawaban a-e (bisa tersimpan sebagai JSON string)
        $jawaban5 = $jawaban['5'] ?? [];

        if (is_string($jawaban5)) {
            $decoded = json_decode($jawaban5, true);
            $jawaban5 = is_array($decoded) ? $decoded : [];
        }

        if (!is_array($jawaban5)) {
            $jawaban5 = [];
        }

        // Tanggal monev: utamakan metadata, lalu tanggal wawancara
        $tanggalMonevRaw = $metadata['tanggal_monev'] ?? $wawancara->tanggal_wawancara ?? null;

        try {
            $tanggalMonev = $tanggalMonevRaw
                ? \Illuminate\Support\Carbon::parse($tanggalMonevRaw)->format('d-m-Y')
                : '-';
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            $tanggalMonev = $tanggalMonevRaw ?: '-';
        }

        $statusWawancara = $wawancara->status ?: 'Belum Dilaksanakan';
        $statusStyle = $statusWawancara === 'Selesai'
            ? 'background:#d1fae5;color:#047857'
            : 'background:#fef3c7;color:#b45309';

        $pertanyaanTerbuka = [
            '1' => 'Bagaimana pengalaman Anda selama mengikuti Pelatihan Matematika Gembira?',
            '2' => 'Kendala apa yang Anda alami selama mengikuti pelatihan?',
            '3' => 'Bagaimana pemahaman Anda tentang pembelajaran matematika berubah setelah mengikuti pelatihan?',
            '4' => 'Ceritakan contoh konkret kegiatan pembelajaran matematika yang telah Anda lakukan dengan menerapkan hasil pelatihan!',
        ];

        $subPertanyaan5 = [
            'a' => 'Keterlibatan dan keaktifan peserta didik',
            'b' => 'Motivasi dan rasa percaya diri',
            'c' => 'Pemahaman konsep',
            'd' => 'Kemampuan pemecahan masalah',
            'e' => 'Komunikasi dan kolaborasi',
        ];

        // Daftar lengkap pertanyaan 1-7 (nomor 5 memakai sub-jawaban a-e)
        $daftarPertanyaan = $pertanyaanTerbuka + [
            '5' => 'Perubahan yang diamati setelah penerapan Matematika GEMBIRA',
            '6' => 'Apakah ada peningkatan kemampuan numerasi murid setelah penerapan Matematika GEMBIRA? Jika ada, jelaskan!',
            '7' => 'Berikan saran dan masukan untuk pelatihan Matematika GEMBIRA?',
        ];
        ksort($daftarPertanyaan);

        // Ambil isi jawaban untuk pertanyaan non-sub (1-4 boleh fallback ke kolom jawaban_N)
        $ambilJawaban = function ($nomor) use ($jawaban, $wawancara) {
            if (in_array((string) $nomor, ['1', '2', '3', '4'], true)) {
                return $jawaban[$nomor] ?? $wawancara->{'jawaban_' . $nomor} ?? null;
            }

            return $jawaban[$nomor] ?? null;
        };

        // Hitung jawaban terisi (nomor 5 dianggap terisi bila ada minimal satu sub-jawaban)
        $jumlahPertanyaan = count($daftarPertanyaan);
        $jumlahTerjawab = 0;

        foreach ($daftarPertanyaan as $nomor => $teks) {
            if ((string) $nomor === '5') {
                $terisi = collect($subPertanyaan5)
                    ->keys()
                    ->contains(fn($huruf) => filled($jawaban5[$huruf] ?? null));
            } else {
                $terisi = filled($ambilJawaban($nomor));
            }

            if ($terisi) {
                $jumlahTerjawab++;
            }
        }

                    <label for="nama_pelatihan" class="d-label">Nama Kegiatan/Pelatihan <i>*</i></label>
                    <input id="nama_pelatihan" name="nama_pelatihan" type="text"
                        value="{{ $v('nama_pelatihan', 'Pelatihan PKGSD MBI') }}" required maxlength="255"
                        class="d-field">
                    @error('nama_pelatihan')
                        <p class="d-err">{{ $message }}</p>
                    @enderror
                </div>

                <div>
                    <label for="tanggal_wawancara" class="d-label">Tanggal Pengisian <i>*</i></label>
                    <input id="tanggal_wawancara" name="tanggal_wawancara" type="date"
                        value="{{ $v('tanggal_wawancara', now()->format('Y-m-d')) }}" required class="d-field">
                    @error('tanggal_wawancara')
                        <p class="d-err">{{ $message }}</p>
                    @enderror
                </div>
            </div>
        </section>

        {{-- C. PERTANYAAN WAWANCARA TERBUKA --}}
        <section class="d-card">
            <div class="d-card-top">
                <div>
                    <h2 class="d-card-h">C. Hasil Wawancara PKGSD MBI</h2>
                    <p class="d-card-s">
                        Pertanyaan esai untuk menggali pengalaman setelah mengikuti pelatihan.
                    </p>
                </div>

                <span class="d-badge" style="background:#dbeafe;color:#1d4ed8">{{ $jumlahPertanyaan }} pertanyaan</span>
            </div>

            <div>
                @foreach ($pertanyaan as $nomor => $item)
                    @php
                        // Mendukung config berupa string biasa ATAU array ['judul','isi','placeholder']
                        $isArray = is_array($item);
                        $judulTanya = $isArray ? ($item['judul'] ?? null) : null;
                        $isiTanya = $isArray ? ($item['isi'] ?? '') : $item;
                        $placeholder = $isArray
                            ? ($item['placeholder'] ?? 'Tuliskan jawaban secara jelas dan lengkap...')
                            : 'Tuliskan jawaban secara jelas dan lengkap...';
                    @endphp

                    <div class="d-q-item" @if ($loop->first) style="border-top:0" @endif>
                        <div class="d-q-head">
                            <span class="d-q-no">{{ $nomor }}</span>

                            <div>
                                @if ($judulTanya)
                                    <h3 class="d-q-title">{{ $judulTanya }} <i style="color:#e11d48;font-style:normal">*</i>
                                    </h3>
                                    <p class="d-q-text">{{ $isiTanya }}</p>
                                @else
                                    <label for="jawaban_{{ $nomor }}" class="d-q-title">
                                        {{ $isiTanya }} <i style="color:#e11d48;font-style:normal">*</i>
                                    </label>
                                @endif
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <textarea name="jawaban_{{ $nomor }}" id="jawaban_{{ $nomor }}" rows="5" required
                            placeholder="{{ $placeholder }}" class="d-field"
                            data-wawancara-jawaban>{{ $v('jawaban_' . $nomor) }}</textarea>

                        @error('jawaban_' . $nomor)
                            <p class="d-err">{{ $message }}</p>
                        @enderror
                    </div>
                @endforeach
            </div>
        </section>

        {{-- ================= TOMBOL SIMPAN ================= --}}
        <div class="d-foot">
            <button type="submit" class="d-pbtn b-mint">
                <svg width="18" height="18" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"
                    stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                    <path d="M19 21H5a2 2 0 01-2-2V5a2 2 0 012-2h11l5 5v11a2 2 0 01-2 2z" />
                    <path d="M17 21v-8H7v8M7 3v5h8" />
                </svg>
                {{ $tombol }}
            </button>
        </div>

    </form>
</div>

{{-- ================= JAVASCRIPT PROGRES ================= --}}
<script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        const fields = document.querySelectorAll('[data-wawancara-jawaban]');

        const progressBar = document.getElementById('wawancara-progress-bar');
        const progressPercent = document.getElementById('wawancara-progress-percent');
        const progressText = document.getElementById('wawancara-progress-text');

        function updateProgress() {
            const total = fields.length;
            let terisi = 0;

            fields.forEach(function (field) {
                if (field.value.trim() !== '') {
                    terisi++;
                }
            });

            const persen = total > 0 ? Math.round((terisi / total) * 100) : 0;

            progressBar.style.width = persen + '%';
            progressPercent.textContent = persen + '%';
            progressText.textContent = terisi + ' / ' + total + ' jawaban';
        }

        fields.forEach(function (field) {
            field.addEventListener('input', updateProgress);
        });

        updateProgress();
    });
</script>
